examples.en: After changing a few words, this sentence reads more smoothly.

examples.zh: 经历过失去,才更懂得珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìguò shīqù, cái gèng dǒngde zhēnxī.
examples.en: Only after experiencing loss do you cherish things more.

title: "不太" ile "pek değil"
summary: "不太" (bú tài) bir sıfatı yumuşakça olumsuzlar: "pek/çok değil". 不太好 = pek iyi değil.
explanation: "不太" bir özelliği tamamen reddetmeden yumuşakça azaltır: 不太贵 (çok pahalı değil), 不太喜欢 (pek sevmiyorum). Bu, doğrudan "不"'dan daha kibar ve dolaylıdır — Çince'de olumsuzu yumuşatmanın çok yaygın bir yoludur. "太"'nın buradaki "了"'suz kullanımına dikkat: "不太好" (pek iyi değil), "太好了" (harika!) — anlamları tamamen farklı.

examples.zh: 我今天不太舒服,想请一天假。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān bú tài shūfu, xiǎng qǐng yì tiān jià.
examples.en: I'm not feeling too well today, I'd like a day off.

examples.zh: 这个办法不太好,我们再想想别的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ bú tài hǎo, wǒmen zài xiǎngxiang biéde.
examples.en: This method isn't great, let's think of others.

examples.zh: 我不太喜欢这种颜色,太亮了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài xǐhuan zhè zhǒng yánsè, tài liàng le.
examples.en: I don't much like this color, it's too bright.

examples.zh: 他说的话我不太明白。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà wǒ bú tài míngbai.
examples.en: I don't quite understand what he said.

examples.zh: 最近生意不太好,压力有点大。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn shēngyi bú tài hǎo, yālì yǒudiǎn dà.
examples.en: Business hasn't been great lately, the pressure is high.

examples.zh: 我对这个城市还不太熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège chéngshì hái bú tài shúxī.
examples.en: I'm not very familiar with this city yet.

examples.zh: 这件事我不太确定,让我再查一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ bú tài quèdìng, ràng wǒ zài chá yíxià.
examples.en: I'm not too sure about this, let me check again.

examples.zh: 他今天心情不太好,你别惹他。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān xīnqíng bú tài hǎo, nǐ bié rě tā.
examples.en: He's in a bad mood today, don't provoke him.

examples.zh: 这个价格不太合理,我们再谈谈。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàgé bú tài hélǐ, wǒmen zài tántan.
examples.en: This price isn't quite reasonable, let's talk more.

examples.zh: 我不太会做饭,一般都在外面吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài huì zuòfàn, yìbān dōu zài wàimiàn chī.
examples.en: I'm not good at cooking, I usually eat out.

examples.zh: 他的身体最近不太好,需要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ zuìjìn bú tài hǎo, xūyào duō xiūxi.
examples.en: His health hasn't been good lately, he needs more rest.

examples.zh: 这条路我不太熟,你帮我看看地图。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ bú tài shú, nǐ bāng wǒ kànkan dìtú.
examples.en: I don't know this road well, help me check the map.

examples.zh: 我不太赞成这个计划,风险太大了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài zànchéng zhège jìhuà, fēngxiǎn tài dà le.
examples.en: I don't quite approve of this plan, the risk is too big.

examples.zh: 今天天气不太好,可能会下雨。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì bú tài hǎo, kěnéng huì xiàyǔ.
examples.en: The weather isn't great today, it might rain.

examples.zh: 他最近工作不太顺利,情绪有点低落。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò bú tài shùnlì, qíngxù yǒudiǎn dīluò.
examples.en: Work hasn't gone smoothly for him lately, he's a bit down.

examples.zh: 这家店的服务不太好,我以后不来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de fúwù bú tài hǎo, wǒ yǐhòu bù lái le.
examples.en: This shop's service isn't great, I won't come again.

examples.zh: 我不太想去,可是又不好意思拒绝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài xiǎng qù, kěshì yòu bù hǎoyìsi jùjué.
examples.en: I don't really want to go, but I feel bad refusing.

examples.zh: 他的解释不太让人信服。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì bú tài ràng rén xìnfú.
examples.en: His explanation isn't very convincing.

examples.zh: 这道菜的味道不太正宗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de wèidào bú tài zhèngzōng.
examples.en: This dish doesn't taste very authentic.

examples.zh: 我不太习惯这里的生活节奏。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài xíguàn zhèlǐ de shēnghuó jiézòu.
examples.en: I'm not quite used to the pace of life here.

examples.zh: 这件衣服的质量不太好,穿几次就坏了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de zhìliàng bú tài hǎo, chuān jǐ cì jiù huài le.
examples.en: This garment's quality isn't good, it wore out after a few uses.

examples.zh: 他对我的态度好像不太友好。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ de tàidu hǎoxiàng bú tài yǒuhǎo.
examples.en: His attitude toward me doesn't seem very friendly.

examples.zh: 我今天状态不太好,比赛可能会输。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zhuàngtài bú tài hǎo, bǐsài kěnéng huì shū.
examples.en: I'm not in good form today, I might lose the match.

examples.zh: 这个想法听起来不太现实。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ tīng qǐlái bú tài xiànshí.
examples.en: This idea doesn't sound very realistic.

examples.zh: 他俩的关系最近不太好,经常吵架。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎ de guānxi zuìjìn bú tài hǎo, jīngcháng chǎojià.
examples.en: Their relationship hasn't been good lately, they often argue.

title: "真" ile "gerçekten / ne kadar da"
summary: "真" (zhēn) bir sıfattan önce gelerek içten bir hayranlık/duygu belirtir: 真漂亮！ = Gerçekten çok güzel!
explanation: "真" bir sıfatın önüne gelip konuşanın gerçek, içten duygusunu/hayranlığını ifade eder: 你真聪明 (gerçekten çok akıllısın). "很"'den farkı: "很" tarafsız bir derece belirtir ve düz cümle kurar; "真" ise öznel bir ünlem/duygu taşır ve çoğu zaman hayranlık, şaşkınlık ya da şikâyet bildirir. Genellikle "了" almaz. Ünlem cümlelerinde çok yaygındır.

examples.zh: 这里的风景真美,像画一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng zhēn měi, xiàng huà yíyàng.
examples.en: The scenery here is truly beautiful, like a painting.

examples.zh: 你今天真漂亮,是要去约会吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zhēn piàoliang, shì yào qù yuēhuì ma?
examples.en: You look really pretty today, going on a date?

examples.zh: 这个孩子真聪明,一学就会。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi zhēn cōngming, yì xué jiù huì.
examples.en: This child is really smart, learns instantly.

examples.zh: 时间过得真快,一年又快结束了。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, yì nián yòu kuài jiéshù le.
examples.en: Time really flies, another year is nearly over.

examples.zh: 这道菜真好吃,你是怎么做的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zhēn hǎochī, nǐ shì zěnme zuò de?
examples.en: This dish is really delicious, how did you make it?

examples.zh: 你真是个好人,谢谢你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn shì ge hǎorén, xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.en: You're truly a good person, thank you for your help.

examples.zh: 今天真冷,我的手都冻僵了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zhēn lěng, wǒ de shǒu dōu dòngjiāng le.
examples.en: It's really cold today, my hands are frozen stiff.

examples.zh: 这件事真让人头疼,不知道怎么办。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhēn ràng rén tóuténg, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
examples.en: This is really a headache, I don't know what to do.

examples.zh: 你说得真对,我怎么没想到呢？

examples.zh: 这只小狗真可爱,我好想养一只。

examples.en: This puppy is so cute, I really want to get one.

examples.zh: 能见到你我真高兴。
examples.pinyin: Néng jiàndào nǐ wǒ zhēn gāoxìng.
examples.en: I'm really happy to see you.

examples.zh: 这本书真有意思,我一口气看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhēn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yì kǒu qì kànwán le.
examples.en: This book is really interesting, I read it in one go.

examples.zh: 你的中文说得真流利,像本地人一样。

examples.zh: 这个决定真不容易,他考虑了很久。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng zhēn bù róngyì, tā kǎolǜ le hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: This decision was really not easy, he considered it long.

examples.zh: 你真厉害,这么难的题都做出来了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn lìhai, zhème nán de tí dōu zuò chūlái le.
examples.en: You're really amazing, you solved such a hard problem.

examples.zh: 这里的空气真新鲜,让人很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì zhēn xīnxiān, ràng rén hěn shūfu.
examples.en: The air here is really fresh, it feels great.

examples.zh: 他对朋友真够意思,总是有求必应。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì péngyou zhēn gòu yìsi, zǒngshì yǒuqiúbìyìng.
examples.en: He's really good to friends, always ready to help.

examples.zh: 这场雨来得真突然,大家都没带伞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ lái de zhēn tūrán, dàjiā dōu méi dài sǎn.
examples.en: This rain came so suddenly, no one had an umbrella.

examples.zh: 你能坚持这么多年,真了不起。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng jiānchí zhème duō nián, zhēn liǎobuqǐ.
examples.en: That you persevered for so many years is really remarkable.

examples.zh: 这个消息真让人意外,谁也没想到。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi zhēn ràng rén yìwài, shéi yě méi xiǎngdào.
examples.en: This news is really surprising, no one expected it.

examples.zh: 你做的这个模型真精致。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò de zhège móxíng zhēn jīngzhì.
examples.en: The model you made is really exquisite.

examples.zh: 分开这么久,我真的很想你。
examples.pinyin: Fēnkāi zhème jiǔ, wǒ zhēn de hěn xiǎng nǐ.
examples.en: After being apart so long, I really miss you.

examples.zh: 这个城市的夜景真迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de yèjǐng zhēn mírén.
examples.en: This city's night view is truly enchanting.

examples.zh: 你真有耐心,换了我早就放弃了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn yǒu nàixīn, huàn le wǒ zǎo jiù fàngqì le.
examples.en: You're so patient; if it were me I'd have given up.

examples.zh: 能有这样的机会,我真的很感激。
examples.pinyin: Néng yǒu zhèyàng de jīhuì, wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎnjī.
examples.en: I'm truly grateful to have such an opportunity.

title: "离" ile mesafe belirtme
pattern: Yer 1 + 离 + Yer 2 + Zarf + 近 / 远
summary: "离" (lí) iki nokta arasındaki mesafeyi anlatır: A 离 B 很近/很远 = A, B'ye çok yakın/uzak.
explanation: İki yer (ya da zaman) arasındaki uzaklığı belirtmek için "离" kullanılır. Kalıp şudur: Yer1 + 离 + Yer2 + (很/太/不) + 近/远. Buradaki "离" bir edat gibidir ve Türkçedeki "-e uzaklıkta" mantığına yakındır: 我家离公司很近 = Evim işyerine çok yakın. Dikkat: mesafeyi sormak için "多远" (ne kadar uzak) kullanılır: 你家离这儿多远? "离" sadece fiziksel mesafede değil, zaman uzaklığında da geçer: 离考试还有三天 (Sınava daha üç gün var).

examples.zh: 我家离公司很近,走路十分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn jìn, zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le。
examples.en: My home is very close to the office; it's a ten-minute walk.

examples.zh: 学校离地铁站不远,坐两站就能到。
examples.pinyin: Xué xiào lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn, zuò liǎng zhàn jiù néng dào。
examples.en: The school isn't far from the subway station; two stops and you're there.

examples.zh: 你家离这儿多远?我开车去接你吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā lí zhè ér duō yuǎn? wǒ kāi chē qù jiē nǐ ba。
examples.en: How far is your home from here? Let me drive over to pick you up.

examples.zh: 医院离我们家太远了,坐车要一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Yī yuàn lí wǒ men jiā tài yuǎn le, zuò chē yào yí gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: The hospital is too far from our home; it takes an hour by car.

examples.zh: 那家饭馆离火车站很近,吃完饭正好去坐车。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā fàn guǎn lí huǒ chē zhàn hěn jìn, chī wán fàn zhèng hǎo qù zuò chē。
examples.en: That restaurant is right by the train station; we can catch the train right after eating.

examples.zh: 我的座位离门口太近,一开门就有冷风。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zuò wèi lí mén kǒu tài jìn, yī kāi mén jiù yǒu lěng fēng。
examples.en: My seat is too close to the door; cold air blows in whenever it opens.

examples.zh: 图书馆离宿舍不远,我常常晚上去那儿看书。
examples.pinyin: Tú shū guǎn lí sù shè bù yuǎn, wǒ cháng cháng wǎn shàng qù nà ér kàn shū。
examples.en: The library isn't far from the dorm; I often go there to read at night.

examples.zh: 他的老家离北京很远,坐飞机也要三个小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lǎo jiā lí běi jīng hěn yuǎn, zuò fēi jī yě yào sān gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: His hometown is far from Beijing; even by plane it takes three hours.

examples.zh: 咱们的酒店离海边很近,早上能听见海浪的声音。
examples.pinyin: Zán men de jiǔ diàn lí hǎi biān hěn jìn, zǎo shàng néng tīng jiàn hǎi làng de shēng yīn。
examples.en: Our hotel is close to the sea; in the morning you can hear the waves.

examples.zh: 这个小区离超市很近,买东西特别方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiǎo qū lí chāo shì hěn jìn, mǎi dōng xī tè bié fāng biàn。
examples.en: This neighborhood is close to the supermarket, so shopping is very convenient.

examples.zh: 你别担心,机场离市中心其实不太远。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dān xīn, jī chǎng lí shì zhōng xīn qí shí bù tài yuǎn。
examples.en: Don't worry, the airport actually isn't very far from downtown.

examples.zh: 银行离你公司远不远?我想中午去取点钱。
examples.pinyin: Yín háng lí nǐ gōng sī yuǎn bù yuǎn? wǒ xiǎng zhōng wǔ qù qǔ diǎn qián。
examples.en: Is the bank far from your company? I want to withdraw some money at noon.

examples.zh: 我们的教室离操场很近,下课就能去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de jiào shì lí cāo chǎng hěn jìn, xià kè jiù néng qù dǎ qiú。
examples.en: Our classroom is close to the sports field; we can play ball right after class.

examples.zh: 那座山离城市不远,周末开车去爬正合适。
examples.pinyin: Nà zuò shān lí chéng shì bù yuǎn, zhōu mò kāi chē qù pá zhèng hé shì。
examples.en: That mountain isn't far from the city; it's perfect for a weekend drive and hike.

examples.zh: 新公司离我家有点儿远,我打算搬到那附近去。
examples.pinyin: Xīn gōng sī lí wǒ jiā yǒu diǎn ér yuǎn, wǒ dǎ suàn bān dào nà fù jìn qù。
examples.en: The new company is a bit far from my home; I plan to move nearby.

examples.zh: 你坐的地方离窗户太远,可能看不清外面的风景。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò de dì fāng lí chuāng hù tài yuǎn, kě néng kàn bù qīng wài miàn de fēng jǐng。
examples.en: Where you're sitting is too far from the window; you might not see the view clearly.

examples.zh: 咖啡馆离书店很近,买完书可以去那儿坐坐。
examples.pinyin: Kā fēi guǎn lí shū diàn hěn jìn, mǎi wán shū kě yǐ qù nà ér zuò zuò。
examples.en: The café is near the bookstore; you can sit there after buying books.

examples.zh: 他家离学校最近,所以每天他都是最后一个出门。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā lí xué xiào zuì jìn, suǒ yǐ měi tiān tā dōu shì zuì hòu yí gè chū mén。
examples.en: His home is closest to school, so he's the last one to leave every day.

examples.zh: 请问,这儿离最近的地铁站有多远?

examples.zh: 我们的房子离父母家很近,周末常常回去吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de fáng zi lí fù mǔ jiā hěn jìn, zhōu mò cháng cháng huí qù chī fàn。
examples.en: Our house is close to my parents' place; we often go back for meals on weekends.

examples.zh: 停车场离电影院不远,看完电影走过去就行。
examples.pinyin: Tíng chē chǎng lí diàn yǐng yuàn bù yuǎn, kàn wán diàn yǐng zǒu guò qù jiù xíng。
examples.en: The parking lot isn't far from the cinema; just walk over after the movie.

examples.zh: 这家医院离高速公路很近,救护车来得特别快。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yī yuàn lí gāo sù gōng lù hěn jìn, jiù hù chē lái de tè bié kuài。
examples.en: This hospital is close to the highway, so ambulances arrive very quickly.

examples.zh: 你的桌子离空调太近了,难怪你总是觉得冷。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zhuō zi lí kōng tiáo tài jìn le, nán guài nǐ zǒng shì jué de lěng。
examples.en: Your desk is too close to the air conditioner; no wonder you always feel cold.

examples.zh: 虽然公园离我家不近,可是我还是喜欢每天去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán gōng yuán lí wǒ jiā bù jìn, kě shì wǒ hái shì xǐ huān měi tiān qù pǎo bù。
examples.en: Although the park isn't close to my home, I still like going there to run every day.

examples.zh: 离放假还有一个星期,同学们都已经等不及了。
examples.pinyin: Lí fàng jià hái yǒu yí gè xīng qī, tóng xué men dōu yǐ jīng děng bù jí le。
examples.en: There's still a week until the holiday, and the students can hardly wait.

title: "多" ile şaşırma/vurgu ünlemi
summary: "多" (duō) bir sıfatın önüne gelip ünlem cümlesi kurar: 多好啊！= Ne güzel! / Ne kadar güzel!
explanation: "多" bir sıfatın önüne geldiğinde "ne kadar...!" anlamında güçlü bir ünlem oluşturur ve cümle genellikle "啊" ile biter: 多好啊！(Ne güzel!), 多漂亮啊！(Ne kadar güzel!). Konuşmacının hayranlığını, şaşkınlığını ya da duygusunu vurgular. Bu yapı, "多"'nun soru anlamındaki kullanımından (多远? = ne kadar uzak?) farklıdır; buradaki ton bir ölçü sormaz, duyguyu abartır. Uzun cümlelerde çoğu zaman bir sebep ya da durum eklenerek "..., o zaman ne kadar ... olurdu!" gibi bir yapı da kurulur: 你要是来就好了,那该多热闹啊！

examples.zh: 你看,今天的天气多好啊,咱们出去走走吧!
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, jīn tiān de tiān qì duō hǎo a, zán men chū qù zǒu zǒu ba!
examples.en: Look how nice the weather is today; let's go out for a walk!

examples.zh: 这个孩子多可爱啊,大家都想抱抱他。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hái zi duō kě ài a, dà jiā dōu xiǎng bào bào tā。
examples.en: How adorable this child is; everyone wants to hold him.

examples.zh: 你要是能来就好了,那该多热闹啊!
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì néng lái jiù hǎo le, nà gāi duō rè nào a!
examples.en: If only you could come, how lively it would be!

examples.zh: 山顶上的风景多美啊,我拍了好多照片。
examples.pinyin: Shān dǐng shàng de fēng jǐng duō měi a, wǒ pāi le hǎo duō zhào piān。
examples.en: How beautiful the view from the summit is; I took lots of photos.

examples.zh: 他一个人在国外生活,你想想那有多难啊。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí gè rén zài guó wài shēng huó, nǐ xiǎng xiǎng nà yǒu duō nán a。
examples.en: He lives abroad all alone; just think how hard that must be.

examples.zh: 这条裙子多漂亮啊,你穿上一定很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qún zi duō piào liàng a, nǐ chuān shàng yí dìng hěn hǎo kàn。
examples.en: How pretty this dress is; you'd look lovely in it.

examples.zh: 你听,外面的雨下得多大啊,先别出去了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, wài miàn de yǔ xià de duō dà a, xiān bié chū qù le。
examples.en: Listen how hard it's raining outside; don't go out just yet.

examples.zh: 能和家人一起过年,这是多幸福的一件事啊。
examples.pinyin: Néng hé jiā rén yì qǐ guò nián, zhè shì duō xìng fú de yī jiàn shì a。
examples.en: Being able to spend New Year with family — what a happy thing that is!

examples.zh: 你看他跑得多快啊,别人根本追不上。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn tā pǎo de duō kuài a, bié rén gēn běn zhuī bù shàng。
examples.en: Look how fast he runs; no one can catch up at all.

examples.zh: 这么晚了他还不回家,你说他妈妈多着急啊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le tā hái bù huí jiā, nǐ shuō tā mā mā duō zháo jí a。
examples.en: It's so late and he's still not home; imagine how worried his mother is.

examples.zh: 春天来了,公园里的花开得多好看啊。
examples.pinyin: Chūn tiān lái le, gōng yuán lǐ de huā kāi de duō hǎo kàn a。
examples.en: Spring has come, and how beautifully the flowers bloom in the park.

examples.zh: 你要是早点告诉我,事情该多简单啊。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ, shì qíng gāi duō jiǎn dān a。
examples.en: If you'd told me earlier, how simple things would have been!

examples.zh: 他的汉语说得多流利啊,一点儿都听不出是外国人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de hàn yǔ shuō de duō liú lì a, yì diǎn ér dōu tīng bù chū shì wài guó rén。
examples.en: How fluently he speaks Chinese; you can't tell at all that he's a foreigner.

examples.zh: 你看这只小猫多聪明啊,自己会开门。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn zhè zhǐ xiǎo māo duō cōng míng a, zì jǐ huì kāi mén。
examples.en: Look how clever this kitten is; it can open the door by itself.

examples.zh: 咱们好久没见了,今天能碰上多巧啊!
examples.pinyin: Zán men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn le, jīn tiān néng pèng shàng duō qiǎo a!
examples.en: We haven't seen each other in ages; what a coincidence to run into you today!

examples.zh: 你看这间屋子收拾得多干净啊,让人心情都好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn zhè jiān wū zi shōu shí de duō gān jìng a, ràng rén xīn qíng dōu hǎo le。
examples.en: Look how clean this room has been tidied; it lifts your mood.

examples.zh: 孩子第一次叫妈妈,那位母亲心里该多高兴啊。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dì yī cì jiào mā mā, nà wèi mǔ qīn xīn lǐ gāi duō gāo xìng a。
examples.en: The first time the child said 'mom,' how happy that mother must have felt.

examples.zh: 他每天早上五点起床学习,你说这有多不容易啊。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn qǐ chuáng xué xí, nǐ shuō zhè yǒu duō bù róng yì a。
examples.en: He gets up at five every morning to study; think how hard that is.

examples.zh: 你看外面的雪下得多大啊,树上全白了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn wài miàn de xuě xià de duō dà a, shù shàng quán bái le。
examples.en: Look how heavily the snow is falling; the trees are all white.

examples.zh: 能在这么安静的地方看书,多舒服啊。
examples.pinyin: Néng zài zhè me ān jìng de dì fāng kàn shū, duō shū fú a。
examples.en: How comfortable it is to read in such a quiet place.

examples.zh: 他们俩认识二十年了,这份友谊多难得啊。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ rèn shí èr shí nián le, zhè fèn yǒu yì duō nán de a。
examples.en: The two of them have known each other for twenty years; how precious that friendship is.

examples.zh: 你看这道菜做得多好啊,颜色和味道都不错。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn zhè dào cài zuò de duō hǎo a, yán sè hé wèi dào dōu bù cuò。
examples.en: Look how well this dish is made; both the color and the taste are great.

examples.zh: 要是每天都能睡到自然醒,那多好啊。
examples.pinyin: Yào shì měi tiān dōu néng shuì dào zì rán xǐng, nà duō hǎo a。
examples.en: If only I could sleep until I naturally wake every day — how nice that would be.

examples.zh: 你看他对工作多认真啊,别人早下班了他还在。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn tā duì gōng zuò duō rèn zhēn a, bié rén zǎo xià bān le tā hái zài。
examples.en: Look how serious he is about work; everyone else left long ago but he's still here.

examples.zh: 孩子们在草地上跑来跑去,多开心啊。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men zài cǎo dì shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù, duō kāi xīn a。
examples.en: The children run around on the grass — how happy they are!

title: "还" ile ölçülü olumlu değerlendirme
pattern: 还 + Sıfat (还不错 / 还可以 / 还好)
summary: "还" (hái) olumlu bir sıfattan önce gelip değerlendirmeyi yumuşatır: 还不错 = fena değil, idare eder; 还可以 = eh işte, olur.
explanation: Olumlu bir sıfatın önüne gelen "还" değerlendirmeyi hafifletir ve "idare eder, fena değil, epey iyi" gibi ölçülü bir anlam katar. En sık kalıplar: 还不错 (fena değil), 还可以 (olur, eh işte), 还好 (iyi sayılır), 还行 (idare eder). Konuşmacı çoğu zaman beklenenden iyi ya da yeterince iyi bir durumu, abartmadan, olumlu ama ölçülü bir tonla anlatır. "还" burada "hâlâ/daha" anlamındaki kullanımından farklıdır; ton tamamen değerlendirmeye yöneliktir.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的菜还不错,价格也不算贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de cài hái bú cuò, jià gé yě bù suàn guì。
examples.en: The food at this restaurant is pretty good, and the prices aren't expensive either.

examples.zh: 你今天看起来还好,昨天不是说不舒服吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái hái hǎo, zuó tiān bú shì shuō bù shū fú ma?
examples.en: You look okay today; didn't you say you felt unwell yesterday?

examples.zh: 这次考试还可以,虽然没考满分,但也及格了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì hái kě yǐ, suī rán méi kǎo mǎn fēn, dàn yě jí gé le。
examples.en: This exam went okay; I didn't get a perfect score, but I passed.

examples.zh: 他的房间不大,不过收拾得还算干净。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fáng jiān bù dà, bù guò shōu shí de hái suàn gān jìng。
examples.en: His room isn't big, but it's kept fairly clean.

examples.zh: 这件衣服还行,就是颜色我不太喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú hái xíng, jiù shì yán sè wǒ bù tài xǐ huān。
examples.en: This shirt is alright; I just don't quite like the color.

examples.zh: 新来的同事人还挺好的,大家都愿意帮他。
examples.pinyin: Xīn lái de tóng shì rén hái tǐng hǎo de, dà jiā dōu yuàn yì bāng tā。
examples.en: The new colleague is quite nice; everyone is willing to help him.

examples.zh: 这部电影还不错,你有时间可以去看看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng hái bú cuò, nǐ yǒu shí jiān kě yǐ qù kàn kàn。
examples.en: This movie is pretty good; go see it if you have time.

examples.zh: 今天天气还可以,没下雨,咱们可以去公园。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān tiān qì hái kě yǐ, méi xià yǔ, zán men kě yǐ qù gōng yuán。
examples.en: The weather's okay today, no rain, so we can go to the park.

examples.zh: 这个手机还行,拍照清楚,电池也够用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shǒu jī hái xíng, pāi zhào qīng chǔ, diàn chí yě gòu yòng。
examples.en: This phone is decent; the camera is clear and the battery lasts.

examples.zh: 他做的饭还挺好吃的,没想到他会做菜。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de fàn hái tǐng hǎo chī de, méi xiǎng dào tā huì zuò cài。
examples.en: The food he cooked is quite tasty; I didn't expect he could cook.

examples.zh: 这条路还好走,就是有点儿远。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hái hǎo zǒu, jiù shì yǒu diǎn ér yuǎn。
examples.en: This road is easy enough to walk; it's just a bit far.

examples.zh: 我最近工作还顺利,谢谢你的关心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì jìn gōng zuò hái shùn lì, xiè xiè nǐ de guān xīn。
examples.en: Work has been going fairly smoothly lately; thanks for your concern.

examples.zh: 这本书还挺有意思的,我一个晚上就看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hái tǐng yǒu yì si de, wǒ yí gè wǎn shàng jiù kàn wán le。
examples.en: This book is quite interesting; I finished it in one evening.

examples.zh: 他汉语说得还可以,日常聊天没什么问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā hàn yǔ shuō de hái kě yǐ, rì cháng liáo tiān méi shén me wèn tí。
examples.en: His Chinese is okay; everyday conversation is no problem.

examples.zh: 这家酒店还不错,房间干净,服务也周到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔ diàn hái bú cuò, fáng jiān gān jìng, fú wù yě zhōu dào。
examples.en: This hotel is pretty good; the rooms are clean and the service is attentive.

examples.zh: 今天的会开得还顺利,大家很快就决定了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān de huì kāi de hái shùn lì, dà jiā hěn kuài jiù jué dìng le。
examples.en: Today's meeting went fairly smoothly; everyone decided quickly.

examples.zh: 这个价钱还算合理,我们就买这个吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jià qián hái suàn hé lǐ, wǒ men jiù mǎi zhè ge ba。
examples.en: This price is fairly reasonable; let's just buy this one.

examples.zh: 他的身体最近还好,你别太担心了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēn tǐ zuì jìn hái hǎo, nǐ bié tài dān xīn le。
examples.en: His health has been okay lately; don't worry too much.

examples.zh: 这次旅行还挺愉快的,就是天气有点儿冷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng hái tǐng yú kuài de, jiù shì tiān qì yǒu diǎn ér lěng。
examples.en: This trip was quite pleasant; the weather was just a bit cold.

examples.zh: 那家店的咖啡还不错,我常常去那儿坐坐。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de kā fēi hái bú cuò, wǒ cháng cháng qù nà ér zuò zuò。
examples.en: The coffee at that shop is pretty good; I often go sit there.

examples.zh: 孩子这学期的成绩还可以,老师也表扬了他。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhè xué qī de chéng jì hái kě yǐ, lǎo shī yě biǎo yáng le tā。
examples.en: The child's grades this semester are okay; the teacher praised him too.

examples.zh: 这套房子还挺合适的,离地铁近,采光也好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào fáng zi hái tǐng hé shì de, lí dì tiě jìn, cǎi guāng yě hǎo。
examples.en: This apartment is quite suitable; close to the subway and well-lit.

examples.zh: 他的普通话还标准,虽然他是南方人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pǔ tōng huà hái biāo zhǔn, suī rán tā shì nán fāng rén。
examples.en: His Mandarin is fairly standard, even though he's a southerner.

examples.zh: 这个周末过得还不错,睡了个懒觉,也见了老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò guò de hái bú cuò, shuì le gè lǎn jiào, yě jiàn le lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: This weekend went pretty well; I slept in and saw old friends.

examples.zh: 新工作虽然忙,不过还挺有意思,我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Xīn gōng zuò suī rán máng, bù guò hái tǐng yǒu yì si, wǒ hěn xǐ huān。
examples.en: The new job is busy, but it's quite interesting and I really like it.

title: Sıfat + "的" ile isim niteleme
summary: Bir sıfat "的" ile bir ismi niteler: 漂亮的裙子 = güzel elbise; 可爱的宝宝 = sevimli bebek.
explanation: Çince'de bir sıfat bir ismi nitelerken çoğu zaman araya "的" girer: Sıfat + 的 + İsim. 好喝的啤酒 (güzel/lezzetli bira), 可爱的宝宝 (sevimli bebek). Sıfat iki heceli ya da bir zarfla (很, 非常 gibi) güçlendirilmişse "的" neredeyse zorunludur: 非常漂亮的房子. Tek heceli çok yaygın sıfatlarda "的" bazen düşebilir (好人, 红花) ama öğrenirken "的"'yi kullanmak en güvenli yoldur. "的"'den önceki bütün öbek, sonraki ismi tanımlar.

examples.zh: 她今天穿了一件漂亮的红裙子去参加朋友的婚礼。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān chuān le yī jiàn piào liàng de hóng qún zi qù cān jiā péng yǒu de hūn lǐ。
examples.en: She wore a pretty red dress today to attend a friend's wedding.

examples.zh: 我想买一双舒服的鞋子,天天走路脚都疼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng shū fú de xié zi, tiān tiān zǒu lù jiǎo dōu téng。
examples.en: I want to buy a comfortable pair of shoes; my feet hurt from walking every day.

examples.zh: 这是一本很有用的书,对学汉语的人特别合适。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī běn hěn yǒu yòng de shū, duì xué hàn yǔ de rén tè bié hé shì。
examples.en: This is a very useful book, especially suitable for people learning Chinese.

examples.zh: 他是一个热情的人,谁有困难他都愿意帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí gè rè qíng de rén, shuí yǒu kùn nán tā dōu yuàn yì bāng máng。
examples.en: He's a warm-hearted person; he's willing to help anyone in trouble.

examples.zh: 妈妈做的菜里,我最爱那盘甜甜的红烧肉。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zuò de cài lǐ, wǒ zuì ài nà pán tián tián de hóng shāo ròu。
examples.en: Among the dishes mom makes, I love that plate of sweet braised pork the most.

examples.zh: 我们住在一间安静的屋子里,晚上睡得特别好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zhù zài yī jiān ān jìng de wū zi lǐ, wǎn shàng shuì de tè bié hǎo。
examples.en: We live in a quiet room and sleep very well at night.

examples.zh: 那只可爱的小狗每天都在门口等它的主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhǐ kě ài de xiǎo gǒu měi tiān dōu zài mén kǒu děng tā de zhǔ rén。
examples.en: That adorable little dog waits at the door for its owner every day.

examples.zh: 他送给我一份特别的礼物,是他自己画的画。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng gěi wǒ yī fèn tè bié de lǐ wù, shì tā zì jǐ huà de huà。
examples.en: He gave me a special gift — a painting he made himself.

examples.zh: 干净的街道让整个城市看起来都舒服多了。
examples.pinyin: Gān jìng de jiē dào ràng zhěng gè chéng shì kàn qǐ lái dōu shū fú duō le。
examples.en: Clean streets make the whole city look much more pleasant.

examples.zh: 我喜欢这种简单的生活,不用想太多复杂的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huān zhè zhǒng jiǎn dān de shēng huó, bù yòng xiǎng tài duō fù zá de shì。
examples.en: I like this kind of simple life, without thinking about too many complicated things.

examples.zh: 新鲜的水果对身体好,你应该每天都吃一点。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ duì shēn tǐ hǎo, nǐ yīng gāi měi tiān dōu chī yì diǎn。
examples.en: Fresh fruit is good for your health; you should eat some every day.

examples.zh: 他有一双明亮的眼睛,笑起来特别好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī shuāng míng liàng de yǎn jīng, xiào qǐ lái tè bié hǎo kàn。
examples.en: He has a pair of bright eyes and looks especially nice when he smiles.

examples.zh: 这是一件重要的事,你一定要认真对待。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī jiàn zhòng yào de shì, nǐ yí dìng yào rèn zhēn duì dài。
examples.en: This is an important matter; you must take it seriously.

examples.zh: 便宜的东西不一定不好,贵的也不一定合适。
examples.pinyin: Pián yi de dōng xī bù yí dìng bù hǎo, guì de yě bù yí dìng hé shì。
examples.en: Cheap things aren't necessarily bad, and expensive ones aren't necessarily right.

examples.zh: 我们需要一个安静的地方好好谈谈这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào yí gè ān jìng de dì fāng hǎo hǎo tán tán zhè jiàn shì。
examples.en: We need a quiet place to talk this over properly.

examples.zh: 她有一副温柔的声音,读故事的时候特别好听。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī fù wēn róu de shēng yīn, dú gù shì de shí hòu tè bié hǎo tīng。
examples.en: She has a gentle voice that sounds especially lovely when she reads stories.

examples.zh: 蓝色的天空下,孩子们在草地上快乐地跑着。
examples.pinyin: Lán sè de tiān kōng xià, hái zi men zài cǎo dì shàng kuài lè de pǎo zhe。
examples.en: Under the blue sky, the children run happily on the grass.

examples.zh: 这家店卖的都是手工做的好吃的点心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài de dōu shì shǒu gōng zuò de hǎo chī de diǎn xīn。
examples.en: This shop sells only handmade, delicious pastries.

examples.zh: 他写了一封长长的信,把心里的话都说了出来。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiě le yī fēng cháng cháng de xìn, bǎ xīn lǐ de huà dōu shuō le chū lái。
examples.en: He wrote a long letter, pouring out everything on his mind.

examples.zh: 认真的学生总是会提前把作业做完。
examples.pinyin: Rèn zhēn de xué shēng zǒng shì huì tí qián bǎ zuò yè zuò wán。
examples.en: Diligent students always finish their homework ahead of time.

examples.zh: 我买了一台新的电脑,速度比以前快多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yī tái xīn de diàn nǎo, sù dù bǐ yǐ qián kuài duō le。
examples.en: I bought a new computer; it's much faster than before.

examples.zh: 热闹的市场里,到处都是卖水果和蔬菜的人。
examples.pinyin: Rè nào de shì chǎng lǐ, dào chù dōu shì mài shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài de rén。
examples.en: In the bustling market, there are vendors selling fruit and vegetables everywhere.

examples.zh: 他讲了一个有意思的故事,把孩子们都逗笑了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎng le yí gè yǒu yì si de gù shì, bǎ hái zi men dōu dòu xiào le。
examples.en: He told an interesting story that made all the children laugh.

examples.zh: 冬天里,一杯热的咖啡能让人觉得很温暖。
examples.pinyin: Dōng tiān lǐ, yī bēi rè de kā fēi néng ràng rén jué de hěn wēn nuǎn。
examples.en: In winter, a cup of hot coffee can make you feel warm.

examples.zh: 这是我见过的最美的风景,让人一辈子都忘不了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ jiàn guò de zuì měi de fēng jǐng, ràng rén yī bèi zi dōu wàng bù liǎo。
examples.en: This is the most beautiful scenery I've ever seen; unforgettable for a lifetime.

title: Öbek + "的" ile isim niteleme
summary: Bir fiil öbeği ya da bütün bir tümce "的" ile bir ismi niteler: 去北京的火车 = Pekin'e giden tren.
explanation: Sadece sıfatlar değil, bütün bir öbek (fiil öbeği, özne-yüklem yapısı vb.) da "的" ile bir ismi niteleyebilir. Türkçedeki ortaç/sıfat-fiil ("...-en, ...-diği") mantığına çok benzer, ama Çince'de niteleyen öbek her zaman ismin ÖNÜNE gelir: 去北京的火车 (Pekin'e giden tren), 今天来的人 (bugün gelen kişi), 昨天你说的那件事 (dün senin söylediğin o şey). "的"'den önceki bütün bölüm, sonraki ismi açıklar. Türkçe çevirisinde niteleyen kısım sona kayar; bu sıra farkına dikkat etmek gerekir.

examples.zh: 去北京的火车马上就要开了,我们快点上车吧。
examples.pinyin: Qù běi jīng de huǒ chē mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi le, wǒ men kuài diǎn shàng chē ba。
examples.en: The train to Beijing is about to leave; let's hurry and board.

examples.zh: 刚才给你打电话的人是我以前的同学。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de rén shì wǒ yǐ qián de tóng xué。
examples.en: The person who just called you is an old classmate of mine.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着的那本书是老师昨天借给我的。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe de nà běn shū shì lǎo shī zuó tiān jiè gěi wǒ de。
examples.en: That book lying on the desk is the one the teacher lent me yesterday.

examples.zh: 今天来我家的客人都是爸爸的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān lái wǒ jiā de kè rén dōu shì bà bà de lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: The guests coming to my home today are all my dad's old friends.

examples.zh: 昨天我们一起吃饭的那家餐厅今天关门了。
examples.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǒ men yì qǐ chī fàn de nà jiā cān tīng jīn tiān guān mén le。
examples.en: The restaurant where we ate together yesterday is closed today.

examples.zh: 站在门口的那个女孩是我妹妹,她在等我。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài mén kǒu de nà ge nǚ hái shì wǒ mèi mèi, tā zài děng wǒ。
examples.en: The girl standing at the door is my younger sister; she's waiting for me.

examples.zh: 你昨天说的那件事我已经帮你办好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuó tiān shuō de nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐ jīng bāng nǐ bàn hǎo le。
examples.en: I've already taken care of that matter you mentioned yesterday.

examples.zh: 会说三种语言的人在这家公司特别受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔ yán de rén zài zhè jiā gōng sī tè bié shòu huān yíng。
examples.en: People who can speak three languages are especially welcome at this company.

examples.zh: 上个星期买的水果已经放坏了,真可惜。
examples.pinyin: Shàng gè xīng qī mǎi de shuǐ guǒ yǐ jīng fàng huài le, zhēn kě xī。
examples.en: The fruit I bought last week has already gone bad; what a shame.

examples.zh: 正在跟你说话的那位先生是我们的新经理。
examples.pinyin: Zhèng zài gēn nǐ shuō huà de nà wèi xiān shēng shì wǒ men de xīn jīng lǐ。
examples.en: The gentleman talking with you right now is our new manager.

examples.zh: 他给我介绍的工作离家很近,我很满意。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ jiè shào de gōng zuò lí jiā hěn jìn, wǒ hěn mǎn yì。
examples.en: The job he introduced to me is close to home, and I'm very satisfied.

examples.zh: 我最喜欢的是奶奶讲的那些老故事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ huān de shì nǎi nǎi jiǎng de nà xiē lǎo gù shì。
examples.en: What I like most are those old stories grandma tells.

examples.zh: 刚从国外回来的表哥给我们带了很多礼物。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cóng guó wài huí lái de biǎo gē gěi wǒ men dài le hěn duō lǐ wù。
examples.en: My cousin, who just came back from abroad, brought us lots of gifts.

examples.zh: 和我们一起长大的朋友现在都在不同的城市工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé wǒ men yì qǐ zhǎng dà de péng yǒu xiàn zài dōu zài bù tóng de chéng shì gōng zuò。
examples.en: The friends who grew up with us now all work in different cities.

examples.zh: 你放在冰箱里的蛋糕被弟弟偷偷吃掉了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng zài bīng xiāng lǐ de dàn gāo bèi dì di tōu tōu chī diào le。
examples.en: The cake you put in the fridge was secretly eaten by little brother.

examples.zh: 今天早上迟到的同学下课后被老师留了下来。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān zǎo shàng chí dào de tóng xué xià kè hòu bèi lǎo shī liú le xià lái。
examples.en: The students who were late this morning were kept back by the teacher after class.

examples.zh: 这是我第一次坐的飞机,心里又紧张又高兴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì zuò de fēi jī, xīn lǐ yòu jǐn zhāng yòu gāo xìng。
examples.en: This is the first plane I've ever taken; I feel both nervous and excited.

examples.zh: 那个总是笑着跟大家打招呼的人是我们的邻居。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge zǒng shì xiào zhe gēn dà jiā dǎ zhāo hū de rén shì wǒ men de lín jū。
examples.en: That person who always greets everyone with a smile is our neighbor.

examples.zh: 每天早上来公园锻炼的老人身体都很健康。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shàng lái gōng yuán duàn liàn de lǎo rén shēn tǐ dōu hěn jiàn kāng。
examples.en: The elderly people who come to exercise in the park every morning are all very healthy.

examples.zh: 我一直想去的那个地方今年终于要去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì zhí xiǎng qù de nà ge dì fāng jīn nián zhōng yú yào qù le。
examples.en: The place I've always wanted to visit — I'm finally going this year.

examples.zh: 妈妈亲手织的毛衣穿在身上特别暖和。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā qīn shǒu zhī de máo yī chuān zài shēn shàng tè bié nuǎn huo。
examples.en: The sweater mom knitted by hand is especially warm to wear.

examples.zh: 帮我搬家的那几个朋友到现在我都还很感谢。
examples.pinyin: Bāng wǒ bān jiā de nà jǐ gè péng yǒu dào xiàn zài wǒ dōu hái hěn gǎn xiè。
examples.en: I'm still grateful to those friends who helped me move.

examples.zh: 你推荐给我的那部电影真的非常好看。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tuī jiàn gěi wǒ de nà bù diàn yǐng zhēn de fēi cháng hǎo kàn。
examples.en: That movie you recommended to me is really excellent.

examples.zh: 在图书馆看书的学生们都很安静,没有人说话。
examples.pinyin: Zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū de xué shēng men dōu hěn ān jìng, méi yǒu rén shuō huà。
examples.en: The students reading in the library are all quiet; no one is talking.

examples.zh: 我们计划下个月去旅行的城市是一座海边的小城。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jì huà xià gè yuè qù lǚ xíng de chéng shì shì yī zuò hǎi biān de xiǎo chéng。
examples.en: The city we plan to travel to next month is a small seaside town.

title: "最" ile en üstünlük derecesi
summary: "最" (zuì) bir sıfatın önüne gelip "en..." anlamı verir: 最好 = en iyi; 最贵 = en pahalı.
explanation: "最" bir sıfatın (ya da bazı fiillerin) önüne gelerek en üstünlük derecesini kurar: 最大 (en büyük), 最漂亮 (en güzel), 最喜欢 (en çok sevmek). Türkçedeki "en" ile birebir örtüşür. Cümle sonuna vurgu için "了" eklenebilir: 太好了/最好了. Bir grup içinde kıyaslama yaparken sık kullanılır: 他是我们班最高的 (O, sınıfımızın en uzunu). "最" ayrıca duyguyu güçlendiren bir abartı olarak da kullanılır: 这是我最喜欢的地方.

examples.zh: 在我们班,他是学习最认真的学生,老师最喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ men bān, tā shì xué xí zuì rèn zhēn de xué shēng, lǎo shī zuì xǐ huān tā。
examples.en: In our class he's the most diligent student, and the teacher likes him best.

examples.zh: 这家店的面包最好吃,所以每天早上都排很长的队。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de miàn bāo zuì hǎo chī, suǒ yǐ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu pái hěn zhǎng de duì。
examples.en: This shop's bread is the best, so there's a long line every morning.

examples.zh: 你觉得这几个颜色里,哪个最适合我?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jué de zhè jǐ gè yán sè lǐ, nǎ ge zuì shì hé wǒ?
examples.en: Among these colors, which do you think suits me best?

examples.zh: 我最怕的就是考试,一到考试我就紧张得睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì pà de jiù shì kǎo shì, yī dào kǎo shì wǒ jiù jǐn zhāng de shuì bù zhe。
examples.en: The thing I fear most is exams; I get so nervous I can't sleep.

examples.zh: 春天是一年里最舒服的季节,不冷也不热。
examples.pinyin: Chūn tiān shì yī nián lǐ zuì shū fú de jì jié, bù lěng yě bù rè。
examples.en: Spring is the most comfortable season of the year, neither cold nor hot.

examples.zh: 在所有的运动里,他最喜欢游泳,几乎每天都去。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒ yǒu de yùn dòng lǐ, tā zuì xǐ huān yóu yǒng, jī hū měi tiān dōu qù。
examples.en: Of all sports, he likes swimming the most and goes almost every day.

examples.zh: 这条路最近,可是车太多,反而走那条大路更快。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù zuì jìn, kě shì chē tài duō, fǎn ér zǒu nà tiáo dà lù gèng kuài。
examples.en: This road is the shortest, but there's too much traffic, so the big road is actually faster.

examples.zh: 妈妈做的红烧肉是我吃过的最好吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zuò de hóng shāo ròu shì wǒ chī guò de zuì hǎo chī de cài。
examples.en: The braised pork mom makes is the tastiest dish I've ever eaten.

examples.zh: 对我来说,家人的健康是最重要的事。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, jiā rén de jiàn kāng shì zuì zhòng yào de shì。
examples.en: To me, my family's health is the most important thing.

examples.zh: 这几件衣服里,你穿这件最好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ jiàn yī fú lǐ, nǐ chuān zhè jiàn zuì hǎo kàn。
examples.en: Of these clothes, you look best in this one.

examples.zh: 他是我们公司来得最早、走得最晚的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ men gōng sī lái de zuì zǎo、 zǒu de zuì wǎn de rén。
examples.en: He's the one in our company who comes earliest and leaves latest.

examples.zh: 我最不喜欢下雨天,因为出门特别不方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì bù xǐ huān xià yǔ tiān, yīn wèi chū mén tè bié bù fāng biàn。
examples.en: I dislike rainy days the most because going out is so inconvenient.

examples.zh: 这道题是这次考试里最难的一道,很多人都没做对。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí shì zhè cì kǎo shì lǐ zuì nán de yī dào, hěn duō rén dōu méi zuò duì。
examples.en: This question was the hardest on the exam; many people got it wrong.

examples.zh: 在这么多礼物中,我最喜欢你送的这本书。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè me duō lǐ wù zhōng, wǒ zuì xǐ huān nǐ sòng de zhè běn shū。
examples.en: Among all these gifts, I like this book you gave me the most.

examples.zh: 那家饭馆最有名的菜是鱼,来的人都要点一份。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā fàn guǎn zuì yǒu míng de cài shì yú, lái de rén dōu yào diǎn yī fèn。
examples.en: The most famous dish at that restaurant is the fish; everyone orders one.

examples.zh: 你现在最需要的是好好休息,别再工作了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài zuì xū yào de shì hǎo hǎo xiū xī, bié zài gōng zuò le。
examples.en: What you need most right now is a good rest; stop working.

examples.zh: 这是我这辈子看过的最美的日落。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zhè bèi zi kàn guò de zuì měi de rì luò。
examples.en: This is the most beautiful sunset I've seen in my whole life.

examples.zh: 小明是三个孩子里最聪明也最调皮的一个。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo míng shì sān gè hái zi lǐ zuì cōng míng yě zuì tiáo pí de yí gè。
examples.en: Xiao Ming is the smartest and also the naughtiest of the three children.

examples.zh: 每天早上的第一杯咖啡是我最享受的时刻。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shàng de dì yī bēi kā fēi shì wǒ zuì xiǎng shòu de shí kè。
examples.en: The first cup of coffee each morning is the moment I enjoy most.

examples.zh: 在这几种方法里,我觉得这个最简单也最有用。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jǐ zhǒng fāng fǎ lǐ, wǒ jué de zhè ge zuì jiǎn dān yě zuì yǒu yòng。
examples.en: Of these methods, I think this one is the simplest and most useful.

examples.zh: 他跑得最快,所以老师让他参加学校的比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de zuì kuài, suǒ yǐ lǎo shī ràng tā cān jiā xué xiào de bǐ sài。
examples.en: He runs the fastest, so the teacher had him join the school competition.

examples.zh: 这座城市冬天最冷的时候,气温能到零下二十度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéng shì dōng tiān zuì lěng de shí hòu, qì wēn néng dào líng xià èr shí dù。
examples.en: When this city is coldest in winter, the temperature can drop to minus twenty.

examples.zh: 我最想去的地方是海边,能安安静静地待几天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xiǎng qù de dì fāng shì hǎi biān, néng ān ān jìng jìng de dài jǐ tiān。
examples.en: The place I most want to go is the seaside, to stay quietly for a few days.

examples.zh: 在所有的老师里,数学老师对我们最严格。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒ yǒu de lǎo shī lǐ, shù xué lǎo shī duì wǒ men zuì yán gé。
examples.en: Of all the teachers, the math teacher is the strictest with us.

examples.zh: 能和最好的朋友一起旅行,是最开心的事了。
examples.pinyin: Néng hé zuì hǎo de péng yǒu yì qǐ lǚ xíng, shì zuì kāi xīn de shì le。
examples.en: Traveling with your best friend is the happiest thing of all.

title: "或者" ile düz cümlede "veya"
summary: "或者" (huòzhě) düz cümlelerde iki seçenek arasında "veya" der: 喝茶或者咖啡 = çay ya da kahve.
explanation: "或者" düz (soru olmayan) cümlelerde iki ya da daha çok seçeneği birbirine bağlar: 我想去青岛或者南京 (Qingdao ya da Nanjing'e gitmek istiyorum). ÇOK ÖNEMLİ ayrım: Soru cümlelerinde "veya" için "或者" değil "还是" (háishì) kullanılır: 你喝茶还是咖啡? (Çay mı kahve mi içersin?). Yani seçenek sunan bir SORUDA 还是, seçenekten bahseden bir İFADEDE 或者 gelir. "或者...或者..." biçiminde iki seçeneği de vurgulayarak kullanılabilir.

examples.zh: 周末我们可以去爬山,或者在家看看电影,你决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men kě yǐ qù pá shān, huò zhě zài jiā kàn kàn diàn yǐng, nǐ jué dìng ba。
examples.en: This weekend we can go hiking or watch movies at home; you decide.

examples.zh: 你饿了的话,冰箱里有面包或者鸡蛋,自己拿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ è le de huà, bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu miàn bāo huò zhě jī dàn, zì jǐ ná。
examples.en: If you're hungry, there's bread or eggs in the fridge; help yourself.

examples.zh: 这件事你可以打电话或者发邮件告诉他,都行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà huò zhě fā yóu jiàn gào sù tā, dōu xíng。
examples.en: You can tell him this by phone or email, either works.

examples.zh: 我打算学一门外语,英语或者法语,还没想好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ suàn xué yī mén wài yǔ, yīng yǔ huò zhě fǎ yǔ, hái méi xiǎng hǎo。
examples.en: I plan to learn a foreign language, English or French; I haven't decided.

examples.zh: 晚饭想吃米饭或者面条?我这就去做。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn fàn xiǎng chī mǐ fàn huò zhě miàn tiáo? wǒ zhè jiù qù zuò。
examples.en: Do you want rice or noodles for dinner? I'll go make it now.

examples.zh: 有问题的时候,你可以问老师或者查一下词典。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèn tí de shí hòu, nǐ kě yǐ wèn lǎo shī huò zhě chá yī xià cí diǎn。
examples.en: When you have a question, you can ask the teacher or look it up in a dictionary.

examples.zh: 我们坐地铁或者打车去都可以,你看时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò dì tiě huò zhě dǎ chē qù dōu kě yǐ, nǐ kàn shí jiān。
examples.en: We can take the subway or a taxi; it depends on the time.

examples.zh: 放假我想去北方或者南方旅行,换个环境休息一下。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià wǒ xiǎng qù běi fāng huò zhě nán fāng lǚ xíng, huàn gè huán jìng xiū xī yī xià。
examples.en: For the holiday I want to travel north or south, to change scenery and rest.

examples.zh: 你今天或者明天有空吗?我想请你吃个饭。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān huò zhě míng tiān yǒu kòng ma? wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ chī gè fàn。
examples.en: Are you free today or tomorrow? I'd like to treat you to a meal.

examples.zh: 这本书你可以自己买或者去图书馆借,都不贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū nǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ mǎi huò zhě qù tú shū guǎn jiè, dōu bù guì。
examples.en: You can buy this book yourself or borrow it from the library; neither is costly.

examples.zh: 生日礼物我想送她一条围巾或者一本书。
examples.pinyin: Shēng rì lǐ wù wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yī tiáo wéi jīn huò zhě yī běn shū。
examples.en: For her birthday I'm thinking of a scarf or a book.

examples.zh: 累的时候,喝杯茶或者出去走走都能让人放松。
examples.pinyin: Lèi de shí hòu, hē bēi chá huò zhě chū qù zǒu zǒu dōu néng ràng rén fàng sōng。
examples.en: When tired, a cup of tea or a short walk can both help you relax.

examples.zh: 这个周末或者下个周末,咱们一定要见一面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò huò zhě xià gè zhōu mò, zán men yí dìng yào jiàn yí miàn。
examples.en: This weekend or next, we really must meet up.

examples.zh: 你可以用红色或者蓝色的笔,别用铅笔写。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ yòng hóng sè huò zhě lán sè de bǐ, bié yòng qiān bǐ xiě。
examples.en: You can use a red or blue pen, just don't write in pencil.

examples.zh: 他每天早上跑步或者游泳,身体一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shàng pǎo bù huò zhě yóu yǒng, shēn tǐ yì zhí hěn hǎo。
examples.en: He runs or swims every morning, so he's always been healthy.

examples.zh: 我们可以先吃饭或者先看电影,顺序无所谓。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ xiān chī fàn huò zhě xiān kàn diàn yǐng, shùn xù wú suǒ wèi。
examples.en: We can eat first or watch the movie first; the order doesn't matter.

examples.zh: 有事儿你就找我或者找小王,我们都能帮你。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shì ér nǐ jiù zhǎo wǒ huò zhě zhǎo xiǎo wáng, wǒ men dōu néng bāng nǐ。
examples.en: If anything comes up, find me or Xiao Wang; we can both help.

examples.zh: 这道菜放点儿糖或者放点儿醋,味道会更好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài fàng diǎn ér táng huò zhě fàng diǎn ér cù, wèi dào huì gèng hǎo。
examples.en: Adding a little sugar or vinegar to this dish makes it taste better.

examples.zh: 你想坐窗边或者坐过道?我帮你选座位。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò chuāng biān huò zhě zuò guò dào? wǒ bāng nǐ xuǎn zuò wèi。
examples.en: Do you want a window or aisle seat? I'll pick one for you.

examples.zh: 周末我要么在家休息,或者去公园散散步。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ yào me zài jiā xiū xī, huò zhě qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù。
examples.en: On weekends I either rest at home or go for a walk in the park.

examples.zh: 学汉语可以每天听录音或者看中文电视剧。
examples.pinyin: Xué hàn yǔ kě yǐ měi tiān tīng lù yīn huò zhě kàn zhòng wén diàn shì jù。
examples.en: To learn Chinese you can listen to recordings daily or watch Chinese TV dramas.

examples.zh: 这些照片你可以打印出来或者存在电脑里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān nǐ kě yǐ dǎ yìn chū lái huò zhě cún zài diàn nǎo lǐ。
examples.en: You can print these photos or save them on the computer.

examples.zh: 下班以后,我常常看看书或者跟朋友聊聊天。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān yǐ hòu, wǒ cháng cháng kàn kàn shū huò zhě gēn péng yǒu liáo liáo tiān。
examples.en: After work I often read a bit or chat with friends.

examples.zh: 你可以现在付钱或者到时候再付,都没问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ xiàn zài fù qián huò zhě dào shí hòu zài fù, dōu méi wèn tí。
examples.en: You can pay now or pay later; either is fine.

examples.zh: 感冒的时候,多喝水或者早点睡觉都有好处。
examples.pinyin: Gǎn mào de shí hòu, duō hē shuǐ huò zhě zǎo diǎn shuì jiào dōu yǒu hǎo chù。
examples.en: When you have a cold, drinking more water or sleeping early both help.

title: "跟" ile "ile birlikte / -e"
summary: "跟" (gēn) bir kişiyle birlikte ya da o kişiye yönelik bir eylemi anlatır: 跟我一起去 = benimle birlikte git.
explanation: "跟" edatı, bir eylemi kiminle beraber ya da kime yönelik yaptığını belirtir ve fiilden ÖNCE gelir: 跟 + kişi + (一起) + fiil. 你跟我一起去吗? (Benimle birlikte gider misin?), 我跟他说 (Ona söylüyorum / onunla konuşuyorum). "一起" (birlikte) çoğu zaman eklenir. "跟" konuşma dilinde çok yaygındır; daha resmî ortamlarda "和" (hé) ya da "与" (yǔ) benzer işlevle kullanılır. Dikkat: "跟...说" = biriyle konuşmak / birine söylemek; "跟...学" = birinden öğrenmek.

examples.zh: 明天你要跟我们一起去看电影吗?我帮你留个座位。
examples.pinyin: Míng tiān nǐ yào gēn wǒ men yì qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng ma? wǒ bāng nǐ liú gè zuò wèi。
examples.en: Are you coming to the movie with us tomorrow? I'll save you a seat.

examples.zh: 这件事我已经跟老板说过了,他同意了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yǐ jīng gēn lǎo bǎn shuō guò le, tā tóng yì le。
examples.en: I've already spoken with the boss about this, and he agreed.

examples.zh: 小时候,我经常跟爷爷一起在河边钓鱼。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shí hòu, wǒ jīng cháng gēn yé yé yì qǐ zài hé biān diào yú。
examples.en: As a child I often went fishing by the river with my grandpa.

examples.zh: 你先别急,慢慢跟我说,到底发生了什么事?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jí, màn màn gēn wǒ shuō, dào dǐ fā shēng le shén me shì?
examples.en: Don't panic; tell me slowly — what on earth happened?

examples.zh: 周末我打算跟几个老朋友一起去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn gēn jǐ gè lǎo péng yǒu yì qǐ qù pá shān。
examples.en: This weekend I plan to go hiking with a few old friends.

examples.zh: 他从小就跟一位有名的老师学画画。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù gēn yī wèi yǒu míng de lǎo shī xué huà huà。
examples.en: Since childhood he has learned painting from a famous teacher.

examples.zh: 有什么不明白的,你可以随时跟我联系。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me bù míng bái de, nǐ kě yǐ suí shí gēn wǒ lián xì。
examples.en: If there's anything you don't understand, you can contact me anytime.

examples.zh: 我想跟你商量一件重要的事,你有时间吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liáng yī jiàn zhòng yào de shì, nǐ yǒu shí jiān ma?
examples.en: I'd like to discuss an important matter with you; do you have time?

examples.zh: 孩子应该多跟别的小朋友一起玩儿,这样更开朗。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi yīng gāi duō gēn bié de xiǎo péng yǒu yì qǐ wán ér, zhè yàng gèng kāi lǎng。
examples.en: Children should play more with other kids; it makes them more cheerful.

examples.zh: 昨天我跟同事一起加班到很晚才回家。
examples.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǒ gēn tóng shì yì qǐ jiā bān dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā。
examples.en: Yesterday I worked overtime with colleagues and got home very late.

examples.zh: 你要是不舒服,应该早点跟医生说清楚。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì bù shū fú, yīng gāi zǎo diǎn gēn yī shēng shuō qīng chǔ。
examples.en: If you feel unwell, you should tell the doctor clearly early on.

examples.zh: 每天晚饭后,我喜欢跟家人一起散散步。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān wǎn fàn hòu, wǒ xǐ huān gēn jiā rén yì qǐ sàn sàn bù。
examples.en: After dinner every day, I like to take a walk with my family.

examples.zh: 这件衣服的颜色跟你的鞋子很配。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú de yán sè gēn nǐ de xié zi hěn pèi。
examples.en: The color of this outfit goes well with your shoes.

examples.zh: 他不太爱说话,很少主动跟别人聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù tài ài shuō huà, hěn shǎo zhǔ dòng gēn bié rén liáo tiān。
examples.en: He isn't very talkative and rarely chats with others on his own.

examples.zh: 我打算跟房东谈谈,看能不能便宜一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ suàn gēn fáng dōng tán tán, kàn néng bù néng pián yi yì diǎn ér。
examples.en: I plan to talk with the landlord to see if it can be a bit cheaper.

examples.zh: 学汉语最好的办法就是多跟中国人练习说话。
examples.pinyin: Xué hàn yǔ zuì hǎo de bàn fǎ jiù shì duō gēn zhōng guó rén liàn xí shuō huà。
examples.en: The best way to learn Chinese is to practice speaking with Chinese people a lot.

examples.zh: 请你跟大家介绍一下你自己,好吗?
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gēn dà jiā jiè shào yī xià nǐ zì jǐ, hǎo ma?
examples.en: Could you please introduce yourself to everyone?

examples.zh: 我跟他认识十年了,他是我最信任的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā rèn shí shí nián le, tā shì wǒ zuì xìn rèn de péng yǒu。
examples.en: I've known him for ten years; he's the friend I trust most.

examples.zh: 有困难别一个人扛着,要跟朋友说一说。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kùn nán bié yí gè rén káng zhe, yào gēn péng yǒu shuō yī shuō。
examples.en: Don't bear difficulties alone; talk to your friends about them.

examples.zh: 你跟他一样,都特别喜欢看足球比赛。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gēn tā yī yàng, dōu tè bié xǐ huān kàn zú qiú bǐ sài。
examples.en: Just like him, you really love watching soccer matches.

examples.zh: 下课以后,我要跟老师一起讨论这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ yào gēn lǎo shī yì qǐ tǎo lùn zhè ge wèn tí。
examples.en: After class I'm going to discuss this problem with the teacher.

examples.zh: 过年的时候,我们全家人跟亲戚一起吃了顿大饭。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián de shí hòu, wǒ men quán jiā rén gēn qīn qī yì qǐ chī le dùn dà fàn。
examples.en: During New Year, our whole family had a big meal with relatives.

examples.zh: 你能不能跟我换一下座位?我想坐在窗边。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng gēn wǒ huàn yī xià zuò wèi? wǒ xiǎng zuò zài chuāng biān。
examples.en: Could you swap seats with me? I'd like to sit by the window.

examples.zh: 从今天起,我要跟你一起早起锻炼身体。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ yào gēn nǐ yì qǐ zǎo qǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ。
examples.en: Starting today, I'll get up early with you to exercise.

examples.zh: 这么大的事,你怎么不早点跟家里人商量?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de shì, nǐ zěn me bù zǎo diǎn gēn jiā lǐ rén shāng liáng?
examples.en: For such a big matter, why didn't you discuss it with your family sooner?

title: "那个" dolgu/duraksama sözcüğü
summary: "那个" (nèige) konuşurken duraksarken "şey..., yani..." gibi bir dolgu sözcüğü olarak kullanılır.
explanation: Aslında "那个" "o/şu (nesne)" demektir, ama konuşma dilinde çok sık bir DOLGU sözcüğü (duraksama ifadesi) olarak kullanılır — Türkçedeki "şey..., yani..., hani..." gibi. Konuşmacı bir sonraki kelimeyi düşünürken ya da söylemeye çekindiği bir şeyi yumuşatırken araya "那个..." sıkıştırır: 那个……你能帮我一个忙吗? (Şey... bana bir iyilik yapabilir misin?). Konuşurken zaman kazandırır ve cümleyi yumuşatır. Elbette normal "o" anlamıyla da (那个人, 那个东西) kullanılmaya devam eder; hangi anlamda olduğunu bağlam belirler.

examples.zh: 那个……我想问一下,这附近有没有厕所?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… wǒ xiǎng wèn yī xià, zhè fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu cè suǒ?
examples.en: Um... I wanted to ask, is there a restroom nearby?

examples.zh: 那个……其实我有件事一直想跟你说。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… qí shí wǒ yǒu jiàn shì yì zhí xiǎng gēn nǐ shuō。
examples.en: Well... actually there's something I've been wanting to tell you.

examples.zh: 老师,那个……这道题我还是没太明白。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī, nà ge…… zhè dào tí wǒ hái shì méi tài míng bái。
examples.en: Teacher, um... I still don't quite understand this question.

examples.zh: 那个……不好意思,能不能麻烦你让一下?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… bù hǎo yì sī, néng bù néng má fán nǐ ràng yī xià?
examples.en: Um... excuse me, could I trouble you to step aside?

examples.zh: 他站在门口,那个了半天也没说出话来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài mén kǒu, nà ge le bàn tiān yě méi shuō chū huà lái。
examples.en: He stood at the door, hesitating for a long while without saying a word.

examples.zh: 那个……我可能今天来不了了,真的很抱歉。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… wǒ kě néng jīn tiān lái bù liǎo le, zhēn de hěn bào qiàn。
examples.en: Um... I might not be able to come today; I'm really sorry.

examples.zh: 那个……你上次借我的书,我明天一定还你。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… nǐ shàng cì jiè wǒ de shū, wǒ míng tiān yí dìng hái nǐ。
examples.en: Uh... that book you lent me last time, I'll definitely return it tomorrow.

examples.zh: 那个……这件事说来话长,你先坐下听我慢慢讲。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… zhè jiàn shì shuō lái huà cháng, nǐ xiān zuò xià tīng wǒ màn màn jiǎng。
examples.en: Well... it's a long story; sit down first and let me explain slowly.

examples.zh: 那个……请问,去火车站应该怎么走?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… qǐng wèn, qù huǒ chē zhàn yīng gāi zěn me zǒu?
examples.en: Um... excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

examples.zh: 那个……我想请你帮个忙,不知道方不方便。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng gè máng, bù zhī dào fāng bù fāng biàn。
examples.en: Um... I'd like to ask you a favor, if it's convenient.

examples.zh: 他一紧张就爱说那个,一句话里能有好几个。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī jǐn zhāng jiù ài shuō nà ge, yī jù huà lǐ néng yǒu hǎo jǐ gè。
examples.en: When he's nervous he tends to say 'um'; there can be several in one sentence.

examples.zh: 那个……其实那天的事,是我误会你了。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… qí shí nà tiān de shì, shì wǒ wù huì nǐ le。
examples.en: Um... actually, about that day, I misunderstood you.

examples.zh: 那个……我们是不是在哪儿见过?你看着很面熟。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… wǒ men shì bú shì zài nǎ ér jiàn guò? nǐ kàn zhe hěn miàn shú。
examples.en: Um... have we met somewhere? You look very familiar.

examples.zh: 那个……钱的事你别担心,我来想办法。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… qián de shì nǐ bié dān xīn, wǒ lái xiǎng bàn fǎ。
examples.en: Um... don't worry about the money; I'll figure something out.

examples.zh: 那个……今天的会,能不能改到明天下午?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… jīn tiān de huì, néng bù néng gǎi dào míng tiān xià wǔ?
examples.en: Uh... could today's meeting be moved to tomorrow afternoon?

examples.zh: 那个……我有点儿不好意思,想跟你借点钱。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… wǒ yǒu diǎn ér bù hǎo yì sī, xiǎng gēn nǐ jiè diǎn qián。
examples.en: Um... this is a bit awkward, but I'd like to borrow some money from you.

examples.zh: 那个……你说的那个地方,具体在什么位置?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… nǐ shuō de nà ge dì fāng, jù tǐ zài shén me wèi zhì?
examples.en: Um... that place you mentioned, where exactly is it?

examples.zh: 那个……老板,我想请两天假,回家看看父母。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… lǎo bǎn, wǒ xiǎng qǐng liǎng tiān jiǎ, huí jiā kàn kàn fù mǔ。
examples.en: Um... boss, I'd like two days off to go home and see my parents.

examples.zh: 那个……这个问题有点复杂,让我想想再回答你。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… zhè ge wèn tí yǒu diǎn fù zá, ràng wǒ xiǎng xiǎng zài huí dá nǐ。
examples.en: Um... this question is a bit complex; let me think before I answer.

examples.zh: 那个……说实话,我到现在还没准备好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… shuō shí huà, wǒ dào xiàn zài hái méi zhǔn bèi hǎo。
examples.en: Well... to be honest, I'm still not ready even now.

examples.zh: 那个……你能不能小点儿声,孩子在睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… nǐ néng bù néng xiǎo diǎn ér shēng, hái zi zài shuì jiào。
examples.en: Um... could you keep it down a little? The child is sleeping.

examples.zh: 那个……我们认识这么久了,我一直想谢谢你。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… wǒ men rèn shí zhè me jiǔ le, wǒ yì zhí xiǎng xiè xiè nǐ。
examples.en: Well... we've known each other so long, and I've always wanted to thank you.

examples.zh: 那个……这件衣服有点儿贵,能便宜一点吗?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… zhè jiàn yī fú yǒu diǎn ér guì, néng pián yi yì diǎn ma?
examples.en: Um... this outfit is a bit pricey; could it be a little cheaper?

examples.zh: 那个……对不起,我刚才好像说错话了。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… duì bù qǐ, wǒ gāng cái hǎo xiàng shuō cuò huà le。
examples.en: Um... sorry, I think I said the wrong thing just now.

examples.zh: 那个……你别生气,听我把话说完好吗?
examples.pinyin: Nà ge…… nǐ bié shēng qì, tīng wǒ bǎ huà shuō wán hǎo ma?
examples.en: Um... don't be angry; let me finish what I'm saying, okay?

title: "可是 / 但是" ile "ama, fakat"
summary: "可是" (kěshì) ve "但是" (dànshì) ikisi de "ama, fakat" demektir ve zıt iki cümleyi bağlar.
explanation: "可是" ve "但是" hemen hemen aynı anlama gelir: "ama, fakat, ne var ki". İkinci cümlenin başına gelip birinci cümleyle zıtlık kurarlar: 我喜欢他,可是/但是他不喜欢我 (Ondan hoşlanıyorum ama o benden hoşlanmıyor). Küçük fark: "可是" biraz daha konuşma diline, "但是" biraz daha resmî/güçlü tona yakındır, ama çoğu durumda ikisi de kullanılabilir. Çince'de sıkça "虽然...但是/可是..." (her ne kadar ... yine de ...) biçiminde ikili bağlaçla da gelir; Türkçenin aksine iki bağlacın birlikte kullanılması normaldir.

examples.zh: 这件衣服很漂亮,可是有点儿贵,我得再想想。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú hěn piào liàng, kě shì yǒu diǎn ér guì, wǒ děi zài xiǎng xiǎng。
examples.en: This outfit is pretty, but a bit expensive; I need to think it over.

examples.zh: 我很想去旅行,但是最近工作太忙,走不开。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù lǚ xíng, dàn shì zuì jìn gōng zuò tài máng, zǒu bù kāi。
examples.en: I'd love to travel, but I've been too busy with work to get away.

examples.zh: 他学汉语才一年,可是已经说得非常流利了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué hàn yǔ cái yī nián, kě shì yǐ jīng shuō de fēi cháng liú lì le。
examples.en: He's only studied Chinese for a year, but he already speaks very fluently.

examples.zh: 外面看着不冷,可是风很大,你多穿点儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn kàn zhe bù lěng, kě shì fēng hěn dà, nǐ duō chuān diǎn ér ba。
examples.en: It doesn't look cold outside, but it's windy; put on more clothes.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃,但是等的时间太长了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de cài hěn hǎo chī, dàn shì děng de shí jiān tài zhǎng le。
examples.en: The food at this restaurant is delicious, but the wait is too long.

examples.zh: 我给他打了好几次电话,可是他一直没接。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā dǎ le hǎo jǐ cì diàn huà, kě shì tā yì zhí méi jiē。
examples.en: I called him several times, but he never picked up.

examples.zh: 虽然这本书很厚,但是内容很有意思,我很快就看完了。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán zhè běn shū hěn hòu, dàn shì nèi róng hěn yǒu yì si, wǒ hěn kuài jiù kàn wán le。
examples.en: Although this book is thick, the content is interesting, so I finished it quickly.

examples.zh: 他答应今天来帮忙,可是到现在还没出现。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng jīn tiān lái bāng máng, kě shì dào xiàn zài hái méi chū xiàn。
examples.en: He promised to come help today, but he still hasn't shown up.

examples.zh: 这个办法听起来不错,但是实际做起来很难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bàn fǎ tīng qǐ lái bù cuò, dàn shì shí jì zuò qǐ lái hěn nán。
examples.en: This method sounds good, but it's very hard to actually carry out.

examples.zh: 我想早点睡,可是隔壁太吵,根本睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǎo diǎn shuì, kě shì gé bì tài chǎo, gēn běn shuì bù zhe。
examples.en: I wanted to sleep early, but the neighbors were too loud, so I couldn't sleep at all.

examples.zh: 她年纪不大,但是做事非常认真,大家都很信任她。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián jì bù dà, dàn shì zuò shì fēi cháng rèn zhēn, dà jiā dōu hěn xìn rèn tā。
examples.en: She's young, but very serious about her work, and everyone trusts her.

examples.zh: 天气预报说今天有雨,可是一天都是晴天。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō jīn tiān yǒu yǔ, kě shì yī tiān dōu shì qíng tiān。
examples.en: The forecast said rain today, but it's been sunny all day.

examples.zh: 我很喜欢这个城市,但是这里的冬天太冷了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè ge chéng shì, dàn shì zhè lǐ de dōng tiān tài lěng le。
examples.en: I really like this city, but the winters here are too cold.

examples.zh: 他表面上很冷淡,可是心里其实很关心别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā biǎo miàn shàng hěn lěng dàn, kě shì xīn lǐ qí shí hěn guān xīn bié rén。
examples.en: On the surface he seems cold, but he actually cares a lot about others.

examples.zh: 这道题看起来简单,但是很多人都做错了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí kàn qǐ lái jiǎn dān, dàn shì hěn duō rén dōu zuò cuò le。
examples.en: This question looks simple, but many people got it wrong.

examples.zh: 我们准备了很久,可是比赛那天还是输了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zhǔn bèi le hěn jiǔ, kě shì bǐ sài nà tiān hái shì shū le。
examples.en: We prepared for a long time, but still lost on the day of the match.

examples.zh: 虽然我们是第一次见面,可是感觉像认识很久了。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán wǒ men shì dì yī cì jiàn miàn, kě shì gǎn jué xiàng rèn shí hěn jiǔ le。
examples.en: Although it's our first meeting, it feels like we've known each other a long time.

examples.zh: 他工作很努力,但是身体一直不太好。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò hěn nǔ lì, dàn shì shēn tǐ yì zhí bù tài hǎo。
examples.en: He works very hard, but his health has never been very good.

examples.zh: 这部电影名字很有名,可是我看了觉得一般。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng míng zì hěn yǒu míng, kě shì wǒ kàn le jué de yì bān。
examples.en: This movie's title is famous, but I found it just so-so after watching.

examples.zh: 我本来想自己修,但是发现问题太复杂了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái xiǎng zì jǐ xiū, dàn shì fā xiàn wèn tí tài fù zá le。
examples.en: I originally wanted to fix it myself, but found the problem too complex.

examples.zh: 孩子想要那个玩具,可是妈妈没同意给他买。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi xiǎng yào nà ge wán jù, kě shì mā mā méi tóng yì gěi tā mǎi。
examples.en: The child wanted that toy, but mom didn't agree to buy it.

examples.zh: 这里的东西不便宜,但是质量真的很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de dōng xī bù biàn yí, dàn shì zhì liàng zhēn de hěn hǎo。
examples.en: Things here aren't cheap, but the quality is truly excellent.

examples.zh: 我们说好一起去的,可是最后只有我一个人到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men shuō hǎo yì qǐ qù de, kě shì zuì hòu zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí gè rén dào le。
examples.en: We agreed to go together, but in the end only I showed up.

examples.zh: 他嘴上说不在乎,但是心里其实很难过。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuǐ shàng shuō bù zài hū, dàn shì xīn lǐ qí shí hěn nán guò。
examples.en: He says he doesn't care, but he's actually very sad inside.

examples.zh: 虽然路很远,可是为了见你,再远我也愿意来。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán lù hěn yuǎn, kě shì wèi le jiàn nǐ, zài yuǎn wǒ yě yuàn yì lái。
examples.en: Although the road is long, to see you I'd be willing to come no matter how far.

title: "以后" ile "-den sonra" (belirli zaman)
summary: "以后" (yǐhòu) bir zaman ya da eylemin ARKASINA gelip "...-den sonra" der: 下班以后 = işten sonra; 吃饭以后 = yemekten sonra.
explanation: Belirli bir olayın ya da zamanın ardından bir şeyi anlatmak için "以后" o zaman/eylemin SONUNA eklenir: 下课以后 (dersten sonra), 三点以后 (saat üçten sonra), 我回家以后 (eve döndükten sonra). Türkçenin aksine "以后" niteldiği ifadenin ARKASINDADIR, önünde değil. Bir fiil öbeğinden sonra gelerek "...dıktan sonra" anlamı verir. Karşıtı "以前" (önce). "以后" tek başına cümle başında da "bundan sonra, ilerde" anlamında kullanılır (bkz. ayrı konu).

examples.zh: 下班以后,我常常去健身房锻炼一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān yǐ hòu, wǒ cháng cháng qù jiàn shēn fáng duàn liàn yí gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: After work I often go to the gym to exercise for an hour.

examples.zh: 吃完晚饭以后,我们一家人一起看了会儿电视。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán wǎn fàn yǐ hòu, wǒ men yī jiā rén yì qǐ kàn le huì er diàn shì。
examples.en: After dinner, our family watched TV together for a while.

examples.zh: 大学毕业以后,他决定回老家开一家小书店。
examples.pinyin: Dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu, tā jué dìng huí lǎo jiā kāi yī jiā xiǎo shū diàn。
examples.en: After graduating from university, he decided to go home and open a small bookstore.

examples.zh: 到了北京以后,记得马上给妈妈打个电话。
examples.pinyin: Dào le běi jīng yǐ hòu, jì de mǎ shàng gěi mā mā dǎ gè diàn huà。
examples.en: After you arrive in Beijing, remember to call your mom right away.

examples.zh: 学了三年汉语以后,她终于能看懂中文报纸了。
examples.pinyin: Xué le sān nián hàn yǔ yǐ hòu, tā zhōng yú néng kàn dǒng zhōng wén bào zhǐ le。
examples.en: After studying Chinese for three years, she can finally read Chinese newspapers.

examples.zh: 九点以后图书馆就关门了,你得早点去。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn yǐ hòu tú shū guǎn jiù guān mén le, nǐ děi zǎo diǎn qù。
examples.en: The library closes after nine, so you'd better go early.

examples.zh: 下过雨以后,空气变得特别新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Xià guò yǔ yǐ hòu, kōng qì biàn de tè bié xīn xiān。
examples.en: After it rains, the air becomes especially fresh.

examples.zh: 结婚以后,他们搬到了一个安静的小城市。
examples.pinyin: Jié hūn yǐ hòu, tā men bān dào le yí gè ān jìng de xiǎo chéng shì。
examples.en: After getting married, they moved to a quiet small city.

examples.zh: 看完这部电影以后,我好几天都忘不了那个故事。
examples.pinyin: Kàn wán zhè bù diàn yǐng yǐ hòu, wǒ hǎo jǐ tiān dōu wàng bù liǎo nà ge gù shì。
examples.en: After watching this movie, I couldn't forget the story for days.

examples.zh: 放假以后,你有什么打算?想不想一起去旅行?
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià yǐ hòu, nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn? xiǎng bù xiǎng yì qǐ qù lǚ xíng?
examples.en: After the holiday starts, what are your plans? Want to travel together?

examples.zh: 他每天写完作业以后,才可以出去玩儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān xiě wán zuò yè yǐ hòu, cái kě yǐ chū qù wán ér。
examples.en: Every day he can only go out to play after finishing his homework.

examples.zh: 退休以后,爷爷开始学画画,现在画得越来越好。
examples.pinyin: Tuì xiū yǐ hòu, yé yé kāi shǐ xué huà huà, xiàn zài huà de yuè lái yuè hǎo。
examples.en: After retiring, grandpa took up painting and now paints better and better.

examples.zh: 上了年纪以后,他才明白健康比什么都重要。
examples.pinyin: Shàng le nián jì yǐ hòu, tā cái míng bái jiàn kāng bǐ shén me dōu zhòng yào。
examples.en: Only after getting older did he realize health matters more than anything.

examples.zh: 吃药以后你先躺一会儿,别马上出门。
examples.pinyin: Chī yào yǐ hòu nǐ xiān tǎng yī huì er, bié mǎ shàng chū mén。
examples.en: After taking the medicine, lie down for a bit; don't go out right away.

examples.zh: 搬到新家以后,孩子上学方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Bān dào xīn jiā yǐ hòu, hái zi shàng xué fāng biàn duō le。
examples.en: After moving to the new home, it's much more convenient for the kids to get to school.

examples.zh: 认识他以后,我才知道原来他这么幽默。
examples.pinyin: Rèn shí tā yǐ hòu, wǒ cái zhī dào yuán lái tā zhè me yōu mò。
examples.en: Only after meeting him did I learn how funny he actually is.

examples.zh: 下了飞机以后,我打算先找个地方吃点东西。
examples.pinyin: Xià le fēi jī yǐ hòu, wǒ dǎ suàn xiān zhǎo gè dì fāng chī diǎn dōng xī。
examples.en: After getting off the plane, I plan to find somewhere to eat first.

examples.zh: 十二点以后别再喝咖啡了,不然晚上睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Shí èr diǎn yǐ hòu bié zài hē kā fēi le, bù rán wǎn shàng shuì bù zhe。
examples.en: Don't drink coffee after twelve, or you won't sleep at night.

examples.zh: 考完试以后,我们班的同学一起去唱歌了。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo wán shì yǐ hòu, wǒ men bān de tóng xué yì qǐ qù chàng gē le。
examples.en: After the exams, our classmates went to sing together.

examples.zh: 工作几年以后,他慢慢懂得了钱不是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Gōng zuò jǐ nián yǐ hòu, tā màn màn dǒng de le qián bú shì zuì zhòng yào de。
examples.en: After working for a few years, he gradually understood money isn't the most important thing.

examples.zh: 孩子长大以后,离开了家去外地上大学。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhǎng dà yǐ hòu, lí kāi le jiā qù wài dì shàng dà xué。
examples.en: After the child grew up, he left home to attend university in another city.

examples.zh: 洗完澡以后,喝一杯热牛奶会睡得更香。
examples.pinyin: Xǐ wán zǎo yǐ hòu, hē yī bēi rè niú nǎi huì shuì de gèng xiāng。
examples.en: After a shower, a cup of hot milk helps you sleep more soundly.

examples.zh: 听了老师的话以后,他决定重新努力一次。
examples.pinyin: Tīng le lǎo shī de huà yǐ hòu, tā jué dìng chóng xīn nǔ lì yī cì。
examples.en: After hearing the teacher's words, he decided to try hard once more.

examples.zh: 春节以后,很多人都开始计划新一年的目标。
examples.pinyin: Chūn jié yǐ hòu, hěn duō rén dōu kāi shǐ jì huà xīn yī nián de mù biāo。
examples.en: After the Spring Festival, many people start planning their goals for the new year.

examples.zh: 等你回来以后,咱们再一起商量这件事吧。
examples.pinyin: Děng nǐ huí lái yǐ hòu, zán men zài yì qǐ shāng liáng zhè jiàn shì ba。
examples.en: Let's discuss this matter together after you come back.

title: "以前" ile "-den önce" (belirli zaman)
summary: "以前" (yǐqián) bir zaman ya da eylemin ARKASINA gelip "...-den önce" der: 睡觉以前 = uyumadan önce; 吃饭以前 = yemekten önce.
explanation: Belirli bir olay ya da zamandan önceki durumu anlatmak için "以前" o ifadenin SONUNA eklenir: 吃饭以前 (yemekten önce), 十点以前 (saat ondan önce), 来中国以前 (Çin'e gelmeden önce). "以后" gibi, "以前" de niteldiği öbeğin arkasında yer alır. Bir fiil öbeğinden sonra gelerek "...madan önce" anlamı verir. Cümle başında tek başına da "eskiden, önceden" anlamında kullanılabilir (bkz. ayrı konu).

examples.zh: 睡觉以前,我习惯看半个小时书。
examples.pinyin: Shuì jiào yǐ qián, wǒ xí guàn kàn bàn gè xiǎo shí shū。
examples.en: Before sleeping, I'm used to reading for half an hour.

examples.zh: 吃饭以前一定要洗手,这是妈妈从小教我的。
examples.pinyin: Chī fàn yǐ qián yí dìng yào xǐ shǒu, zhè shì mā mā cóng xiǎo jiào wǒ de。
examples.en: You must wash your hands before eating; mom taught me that since I was little.

examples.zh: 来中国以前,我一句中文都不会说。
examples.pinyin: Lái zhōng guó yǐ qián, wǒ yī jù zhōng wén dōu bú huì shuō。
examples.en: Before coming to China, I couldn't speak a word of Chinese.

examples.zh: 考试以前,他每天晚上都复习到很晚。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo shì yǐ qián, tā měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu fù xí dào hěn wǎn。
examples.en: Before the exam, he reviewed until late every night.

examples.zh: 出门以前,记得检查一下门窗关好了没有。
examples.pinyin: Chū mén yǐ qián, jì de jiǎn chá yī xià mén chuāng guān hǎo le méi yǒu。
examples.en: Before going out, remember to check whether the doors and windows are shut.

examples.zh: 八点以前你必须到,不然就赶不上车了。
examples.pinyin: Bā diǎn yǐ qián nǐ bì xū dào, bù rán jiù gǎn bù shàng chē le。
examples.en: You must arrive before eight, or you'll miss the bus.

examples.zh: 结婚以前,他们已经认识十年了。
examples.pinyin: Jié hūn yǐ qián, tā men yǐ jīng rèn shí shí nián le。
examples.en: Before getting married, they had already known each other for ten years.

examples.zh: 做决定以前,你最好多听听别人的意见。
examples.pinyin: Zuò jué dìng yǐ qián, nǐ zuì hǎo duō tīng tīng bié rén de yì jiàn。
examples.en: Before making a decision, you'd better listen to others' opinions.

examples.zh: 天黑以前,我们得赶回山下的旅馆。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐ qián, wǒ men děi gǎn huí shān xià de lǚ guǎn。
examples.en: Before dark, we need to get back to the hotel at the foot of the mountain.

examples.zh: 上课以前,老师让我们先预习新的内容。
examples.pinyin: Shàng kè yǐ qián, lǎo shī ràng wǒ men xiān yù xí xīn de nèi róng。
examples.en: Before class, the teacher had us preview the new material.

examples.zh: 放假以前,大家都在忙着准备考试。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià yǐ qián, dà jiā dōu zài máng zhe zhǔn bèi kǎo shì。
examples.en: Before the holiday, everyone was busy preparing for exams.

examples.zh: 搬家以前,我们把不用的东西都送人了。
examples.pinyin: Bān jiā yǐ qián, wǒ men bǎ bù yòng de dōng xī dōu sòng rén le。
examples.en: Before moving, we gave away all the things we didn't need.

examples.zh: 三十岁以前,他几乎走遍了大半个中国。
examples.pinyin: Sān shí suì yǐ qián, tā jī hū zǒu biàn le dà bàn gè zhōng guó。
examples.en: Before turning thirty, he had traveled across most of China.

examples.zh: 回答问题以前,请先认真想清楚。
examples.pinyin: Huí dá wèn tí yǐ qián, qǐng xiān rèn zhēn xiǎng qīng chǔ。
examples.en: Before answering the question, please think it through carefully.

examples.zh: 下雨以前,天上的云变得又黑又厚。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐ qián, tiān shàng de yún biàn de yòu hēi yòu hòu。
examples.en: Before it rained, the clouds in the sky turned dark and thick.

examples.zh: 认识你以前,我从来没吃过这么辣的菜。
examples.pinyin: Rèn shí nǐ yǐ qián, wǒ cóng lái méi chī guò zhè me là de cài。
examples.en: Before I met you, I'd never eaten such spicy food.

examples.zh: 过马路以前,一定要先看看左右两边。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎ lù yǐ qián, yí dìng yào xiān kàn kàn zuǒ yòu liǎng biān。
examples.en: Before crossing the road, you must look both ways first.

examples.zh: 开会以前,请大家把手机调成静音。
examples.pinyin: Kāi huì yǐ qián, qǐng dà jiā bǎ shǒu jī diào chéng jìng yīn。
examples.en: Before the meeting, please set your phones to silent.

examples.zh: 退休以前,他在这家公司工作了整整三十年。
examples.pinyin: Tuì xiū yǐ qián, tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le zhěng zhěng sān shí nián。
examples.en: Before retiring, he worked at this company for a full thirty years.

examples.zh: 睡觉以前喝太多水,晚上容易起夜。
examples.pinyin: Shuì jiào yǐ qián hē tài duō shuǐ, wǎn shàng róng yì qǐ yè。
examples.en: Drinking too much water before bed makes you get up at night.

examples.zh: 比赛以前,教练又把重要的地方讲了一遍。
examples.pinyin: Bǐ sài yǐ qián, jiào liàn yòu bǎ zhòng yào de dì fāng jiǎng le yī biàn。
examples.en: Before the match, the coach went over the important points once more.

examples.zh: 买东西以前,先想想是不是真的需要。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi dōng xī yǐ qián, xiān xiǎng xiǎng shì bú shì zhēn de xū yào。
examples.en: Before buying something, first think about whether you really need it.

examples.zh: 离开家以前,妈妈往我包里放了很多吃的。
examples.pinyin: Lí kāi jiā yǐ qián, mā mā wǎng wǒ bāo lǐ fàng le hěn duō chī de。
examples.en: Before I left home, mom put lots of snacks in my bag.

examples.zh: 天亮以前,渔民们就已经出海了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān liàng yǐ qián, yú mín men jiù yǐ jīng chū hǎi le。
examples.en: Before dawn, the fishermen had already set out to sea.

examples.zh: 说这句话以前,他犹豫了很久。
examples.pinyin: Shuō zhè jù huà yǐ qián, tā yóu yù le hěn jiǔ。
examples.en: Before saying this, he hesitated for a long time.

title: "以前" ile "eskiden, önceden" (genel)
summary: Cümle başında tek başına "以前" (yǐqián) "eskiden, önceden" anlamı verir: 以前我住在北京 = Eskiden Pekin'de otururdum.
explanation: "以前" belirli bir olaya bağlanmadan, tek başına cümlenin başında (ya da öznenin hemen ardında) kullanıldığında "eskiden, önceden, geçmişte" anlamına gelir ve genel bir geçmiş durumu bugünle karşılaştırır: 以前这里是一片农田,现在都是高楼了 (Eskiden burası tarlaydı, şimdi hep gökdelen oldu). Çoğu zaman "现在" (şimdi) ile birlikte, geçmiş ile bugün arasındaki değişimi vurgulamak için gelir. Belirli bir zaman/fiile bağlı "...-den önce" anlamından (bkz. ayrı konu) bağlamla ayrılır.

examples.zh: 以前我住在北京,后来因为工作搬到了上海。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián wǒ zhù zài běi jīng, hòu lái yīn wèi gōng zuò bān dào le shàng hǎi。
examples.en: I used to live in Beijing; later I moved to Shanghai for work.

examples.zh: 以前这条街很安静,现在到处都是商店和饭馆。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián zhè tiáo jiē hěn ān jìng, xiàn zài dào chù dōu shì shāng diàn hé fàn guǎn。
examples.en: This street used to be quiet; now it's full of shops and restaurants.

examples.zh: 以前他不爱说话,现在变得开朗多了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián tā bù ài shuō huà, xiàn zài biàn de kāi lǎng duō le。
examples.en: He used to be quiet; now he's become much more outgoing.

examples.zh: 我以前不喜欢吃辣的,可是来了四川以后就习惯了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián bù xǐ huān chī là de, kě shì lái le sì chuān yǐ hòu jiù xí guàn le。
examples.en: I used to dislike spicy food, but after coming to Sichuan I got used to it.

examples.zh: 以前没有手机的时候,大家都是写信联系的。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián méi yǒu shǒu jī de shí hòu, dà jiā dōu shì xiě xìn lián xì de。
examples.en: Before there were phones, everyone kept in touch by writing letters.

examples.zh: 这个地方我以前来过一次,变化真是太大了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dì fāng wǒ yǐ qián lái guò yī cì, biàn huà zhēn shì tài dà le。
examples.en: I came here once before; the changes are really huge.

examples.zh: 以前她身体不太好,现在天天锻炼,精神好多了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián tā shēn tǐ bù tài hǎo, xiàn zài tiān tiān duàn liàn, jīng shén hǎo duō le。
examples.en: She used to be in poor health; now she exercises daily and feels much better.

examples.zh: 我们以前是同学,毕业以后就很少见面了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ qián shì tóng xué, bì yè yǐ hòu jiù hěn shǎo jiàn miàn le。
examples.en: We used to be classmates; after graduation we rarely met.

examples.zh: 以前坐火车去要一天,现在坐高铁三个小时就到了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián zuò huǒ chē qù yào yī tiān, xiàn zài zuò gāo tiě sān gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le。
examples.en: It used to take a whole day by train; now the high-speed rail gets there in three hours.

examples.zh: 爸爸说,他们以前的生活比现在苦得多。
examples.pinyin: Bà bà shuō, tā men yǐ qián de shēng huó bǐ xiàn zài kǔ de duō。
examples.en: Dad says their life used to be much harder than now.

examples.zh: 以前我总觉得时间过得很慢,长大以后才发现越来越快。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián wǒ zǒng jué de shí jiān guò de hěn màn, zhǎng dà yǐ hòu cái fā xiàn yuè lái yuè kuài。
examples.en: I used to feel time passed slowly; after growing up I realized it goes faster and faster.

examples.zh: 这家店以前生意很好,不知道为什么现在关门了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yǐ qián shēng yì hěn hǎo, bù zhī dào wèi shén me xiàn zài guān mén le。
examples.en: This shop used to do good business; I don't know why it's closed now.

examples.zh: 以前村里没有学校,孩子们要走很远的路去上学。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián cūn lǐ méi yǒu xué xiào, hái zi men yào zǒu hěn yuǎn de lù qù shàng xué。
examples.en: The village used to have no school, so children walked a long way to study.

examples.zh: 我以前从来不看书,是你让我爱上了阅读。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián cóng lái bù kàn shū, shì nǐ ràng wǒ ài shàng le yuè dú。
examples.en: I never used to read; you're the one who made me fall in love with reading.

examples.zh: 以前的照片都是黑白的,现在早就是彩色的了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián de zhào piān dōu shì hēi bái de, xiàn zài zǎo jiù shì cǎi sè de le。
examples.en: Photos used to be black and white; now they've long been in color.

examples.zh: 他以前很瘦,这两年一下子胖了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ qián hěn shòu, zhè liǎng nián yī xià zi pàng le bù shǎo。
examples.en: He used to be thin; over the past two years he's gained quite a bit.

examples.zh: 以前我们家很小,一家五口挤在一间屋子里。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián wǒ men jiā hěn xiǎo, yī jiā wǔ kǒu jǐ zài yī jiān wū zi lǐ。
examples.en: Our home used to be small; five of us squeezed into one room.

examples.zh: 以前这里的天很蓝,可惜后来越来越少见了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián zhè lǐ de tiān hěn lán, kě xī hòu lái yuè lái yuè shǎo jiàn le。
examples.en: The sky here used to be very blue; sadly that became rarer over time.

examples.zh: 你别看他现在这么厉害,以前也是从零学起的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā xiàn zài zhè me lì hài, yǐ qián yě shì cóng líng xué qǐ de。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by how skilled he is now; he too started from scratch.

examples.zh: 以前每到过年,全家人都会回老家团聚。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián měi dào guò nián, quán jiā rén dū huì huí lǎo jiā tuán jù。
