examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái méi chí dào guò, jīn tiān bù zhī dào chū le shén me shì。
examples.en: He's never been late before; something must have happened today.

examples.zh: 我在国外住过一段时间,那段日子让我成长了很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài guó wài zhù guò yī duàn shí jiān, nà duàn rì zi ràng wǒ chéng zhǎng le hěn duō。
examples.en: I lived abroad for a while; that period helped me grow a lot.

examples.zh: 你见过下雪吗?对南方人来说那可是稀罕事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiàn guò xià xuě ma? duì nán fāng rén lái shuō nà kě shì xī hǎn shì。
examples.en: Have you seen snow? For southerners it's quite a rarity.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅我来过一次,他们的鱼做得特别好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng wǒ lái guò yī cì, tā men de yú zuò de tè bié hǎo。
examples.en: I've been to this restaurant once; they make fish especially well.

examples.zh: 我教过很多学生,但像他这么努力的很少见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiào guò hěn duō xué shēng, dàn xiàng tā zhè me nǔ lì de hěn shǎo jiàn。
examples.en: I've taught many students, but one as hardworking as him is rare.

examples.zh: 你爬过泰山吗?看日出的时候人特别多。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pá guò tài shān ma? kàn rì chū de shí hòu rén tè bié duō。
examples.en: Have you climbed Mount Tai? There are lots of people watching the sunrise.

examples.zh: 我从没想过自己有一天会喜欢上做饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng méi xiǎng guò zì jǐ yǒu yī tiān huì xǐ huān shàng zuò fàn。
examples.en: I never thought I'd one day come to enjoy cooking.

examples.zh: 他经历过很多困难,所以做事特别沉着。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīng lì guò hěn duō kùn nán, suǒ yǐ zuò shì tè bié chén zhuó。
examples.en: He's been through many hardships, so he handles things very calmly.

examples.zh: 这种茶我没喝过,听说对身体很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chá wǒ méi hē guò, tīng shuō duì shēn tǐ hěn hǎo。
examples.en: I've never had this kind of tea; I hear it's very good for you.

examples.zh: 我们在那家老店买过东西,老板人特别好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài nà jiā lǎo diàn mǎi guò dōng xī, lǎo bǎn rén tè bié hǎo。
examples.en: We've shopped at that old store; the owner is very kind.

examples.zh: 你用过这个牌子的手机吗?好不好用?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yòng guò zhè ge pái zi de shǒu jī ma? hǎo bù hǎo yòng?
examples.en: Have you used this brand of phone? Is it any good?

examples.zh: 我年轻时也疯狂过,做过不少现在想想很傻的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nián qīng shí yě fēng kuáng guò, zuò guò bù shǎo xiàn zài xiǎng xiǎng hěn shǎ de shì。
examples.en: When young I had my wild days too, doing many things that seem silly now.

title: "呢" soru parçacığı
summary: Cümle sonundaki "呢" (ne) "ya ..? / peki ..? / nerede/ne yapıyor?" gibi soruları yumuşatır: 你呢? = Ya sen?
explanation: "呢" cümle sonuna gelen bir soru parçacığıdır ve birkaç işlevi vardır: (1) Aynı soruyu karşıya geri sormak — 我很好,你呢? (Ben iyiyim, ya sen?); (2) Bir kişinin/şeyin nerede olduğunu sormak — 我的手机呢? (Telefonum nerede?); (3) Süregelen bir durumu vurgulamak — 他还在睡觉呢 (Hâlâ uyuyor). "吗" ile karıştırılmamalı: "吗" evet/hayır sorusu kurar; "呢" ise ya karşılaştırmalı/eksiltili soru sorar ya da bir durumu vurgular. Kısa "...呢?" soruları konuşma dilinde çok yaygındır.

examples.zh: 我打算周末去爬山,你呢?有什么安排吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ suàn zhōu mò qù pá shān, nǐ ne? yǒu shén me ān pái ma?
examples.en: I plan to go hiking this weekend; how about you? Any plans?

examples.zh: 咦,我刚放在桌上的钥匙呢?怎么不见了?
examples.pinyin: Yí, wǒ gāng fàng zài zhuō shàng de yào shi ne? zěn me bú jiàn le?
examples.en: Huh, where are the keys I just put on the table? How are they gone?

examples.zh: 你别着急,他还在路上呢,一会儿就到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zháo jí, tā hái zài lù shàng ne, yī huì er jiù dào。
examples.en: Don't worry; he's still on the way and will be here soon.

examples.zh: 大家都到了,就差你一个了,你现在在哪儿呢?
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu dào le, jiù chà nǐ yí gè le, nǐ xiàn zài zài nǎ ér ne?
examples.en: Everyone's here except you; where are you right now?

examples.zh: 这道题这么难,你是怎么做出来的呢?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí zhè me nán, nǐ shì zěn me zuò chū lái de ne?
examples.en: This question is so hard; how did you manage to solve it?

examples.zh: 外面下着大雨呢,你还是等雨小点儿再走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ ne, nǐ hái shì děng yǔ xiǎo diǎn ér zài zǒu ba。
examples.en: It's pouring outside; wait until the rain lets up before you go.

examples.zh: 我已经吃过了,你呢?饿不饿?要不要一起吃点?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng chī guò le, nǐ ne? è bù è? yào bù yào yì qǐ chī diǎn?
examples.en: I've already eaten; how about you? Hungry? Want to grab something?

examples.zh: 孩子们都去哪儿了呢?家里怎么这么安静?
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men dōu qù nǎ ér le ne? jiā lǐ zěn me zhè me ān jìng?
examples.en: Where have the kids all gone? Why is the house so quiet?

examples.zh: 你怎么一个人在这儿?你的朋友们呢?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me yí gè rén zài zhè ér? nǐ de péng yǒu men ne?
examples.en: Why are you here alone? Where are your friends?

examples.zh: 我觉得这件红的好看,可是那件蓝的呢,也不错。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè jiàn hóng de hǎo kàn, kě shì nà jiàn lán de ne, yě bù cuò。
examples.en: I think the red one looks nice, but that blue one is good too.

examples.zh: 别关电视,我还看着呢,精彩的地方还没到。
examples.pinyin: Bié guān diàn shì, wǒ hái kàn zhe ne, jīng cǎi de dì fāng hái méi dào。
examples.en: Don't turn off the TV; I'm still watching, the exciting part hasn't come yet.

examples.zh: 你说得倒轻松,可事情哪有那么简单呢?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de dào qīng sōng, kě shì qíng nǎ yǒu nà me jiǎn dān ne?
examples.en: You make it sound easy, but how could things be that simple?

examples.zh: 我的那本书呢?我记得昨天还放在书架上的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nà běn shū ne? wǒ jì de zuó tiān hái fàng zài shū jià shàng de。
examples.en: Where's that book of mine? I remember it was on the shelf yesterday.

examples.zh: 天还早呢,咱们再多坐一会儿,聊聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hái zǎo ne, zán men zài duō zuò yī huì er, liáo liáo tiān。
examples.en: It's still early; let's sit a while longer and chat.

examples.zh: 你为什么突然改变主意了呢?能告诉我原因吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèi shén me tū rán gǎi biàn zhǔ yì le ne? néng gào sù wǒ yuán yīn ma?
examples.en: Why did you suddenly change your mind? Can you tell me why?

examples.zh: 这么重要的事,你怎么现在才想起来呢?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de shì, nǐ zěn me xiàn zài cái xiǎng qǐ lái ne?
examples.en: Such an important thing — how are you only remembering it now?

examples.zh: 我这边一切都好,家里人都好吗?爷爷的身体呢?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè biān yī qiè dōu hǎo, jiā lǐ rén dōu hǎo ma? yé yé de shēn tǐ ne?
examples.en: Everything's fine on my end; is the family well? How is grandpa's health?

examples.zh: 他工作那么忙,哪有时间陪孩子玩呢?
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò nà me máng, nǎ yǒu shí jiān péi hái zi wán ne?
examples.en: He's so busy with work; where would he find time to play with the kids?

examples.zh: 你先别走,饭马上就好了,还热着呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié zǒu, fàn mǎ shàng jiù hǎo le, hái rè zhe ne。
examples.en: Don't leave yet; the food's almost ready and still hot.

examples.zh: 这个周末的天气怎么样呢?适不适合出去玩?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò de tiān qì zěn me yàng ne? shì bú shì hé chū qù wán?
examples.en: What will the weather be like this weekend? Is it good for going out?

examples.zh: 我的钱包呢?刚才还在包里,现在怎么找不到了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qián bāo ne? gāng cái hái zài bāo lǐ, xiàn zài zěn me zhǎo bú dào le?
examples.en: Where's my wallet? It was in my bag just now; why can't I find it?

examples.zh: 你都准备好了,他呢?他准备得怎么样了?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le, tā ne? tā zhǔn bèi de zěn me yàng le?
examples.en: You're all ready; what about him? How's his preparation going?

examples.zh: 外面那么冷,你怎么穿这么少呢?快加件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn nà me lěng, nǐ zěn me chuān zhè me shǎo ne? kuài jiā jiàn yī fú。
examples.en: It's so cold outside; why are you dressed so lightly? Put on more clothes.

examples.zh: 这件事到底该怎么办呢?我实在想不出好办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dào dǐ gāi zěn me bàn ne? wǒ shí zài xiǎng bù chū hǎo bàn fǎ。
examples.en: What on earth should we do about this? I really can't think of a good idea.

examples.zh: 大家都在等你发言呢,你有什么想法就说吧。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zài děng nǐ fā yán ne, nǐ yǒu shén me xiǎng fǎ jiù shuō ba。
examples.en: Everyone's waiting for you to speak; share whatever ideas you have.

title: "啊" ünlem/pekiştirme parçacığı
summary: Cümle sonundaki "啊" (a) cümleye duygu katar: şaşkınlık, vurgu, hatırlatma ya da yumuşatma bildirir: 太好了啊！= Ne güzel ya!
explanation: "啊" cümlenin sonuna gelen bir duygu parçacığıdır ve söyleneni yumuşatır ya da duygusal olarak renklendirir: hayranlık (真美啊！), hatırlatma/uyarı (小心啊！= dikkat et ha!), sabırsızlık ya da içtenlik (快点啊！= çabuk ol hadi!), onay isteme (是这样啊 = demek öyleymiş). Emir cümlesine eklendiğinde emri yumuşatır, ünlem cümlesine eklendiğinde duyguyu artırır. Önündeki sesle uyum için telaffuzda "呀/哪/哇" gibi biçimlere de girebilir, ama yazıda çoğunlukla "啊" kalır. Ton ekleyen, samimileştiren bir parçacıktır.

examples.zh: 这里的风景真美啊,简直像一幅画一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng zhēn měi a, jiǎn zhí xiàng yī fú huà yī yàng。
examples.en: The scenery here is so beautiful; it's just like a painting.

examples.zh: 过马路的时候小心点啊,车太多了。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎ lù de shí hòu xiǎo xīn diǎn a, chē tài duō le。
examples.en: Be careful crossing the road; there's so much traffic.

examples.zh: 原来你就是小王啊,我早就听说过你了。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái nǐ jiù shì xiǎo wáng a, wǒ zǎo jiù tīng shuō guò nǐ le。
examples.en: So you're Xiao Wang! I've heard about you for a long time.

examples.zh: 你快点儿啊,电影马上就要开始了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kuài diǎn ér a, diàn yǐng mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le。
examples.en: Hurry up; the movie is about to start.

examples.zh: 天气这么好啊,咱们出去走走吧,别老待在家里。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo a, zán men chū qù zǒu zǒu ba, bié lǎo dài zài jiā lǐ。
examples.en: The weather is so nice; let's go out for a walk instead of staying home.

examples.zh: 这道菜真好吃啊,你是跟谁学的?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zhēn hǎo chī a, nǐ shì gēn shuí xué de?
examples.en: This dish is so delicious; who did you learn it from?

examples.zh: 你可要照顾好自己啊,别让家里人担心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yào zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ a, bié ràng jiā lǐ rén dān xīn。
examples.en: Do take good care of yourself; don't make the family worry.

examples.zh: 哎呀,原来是这么回事啊,我一直都误会你了。
examples.pinyin: Āi yā, yuán lái shì zhè me huí shì a, wǒ yì zhí dōu wù huì nǐ le。
examples.en: Oh, so that's how it is; I've been misunderstanding you all along.

examples.zh: 时间过得真快啊,一转眼孩子都上学了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài a, yī zhuǎn yǎn hái zi dōu shàng xué le。
examples.en: Time really flies; in a blink the child is already in school.

examples.zh: 你怎么才来啊,我们都等你半天了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me cái lái a, wǒ men dōu děng nǐ bàn tiān le。
examples.en: Why are you only coming now? We've waited for you for ages.

examples.zh: 这么晚了你还不睡啊,明天还要早起呢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le nǐ hái bù shuì a, míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ ne。
examples.en: It's so late and you're still not asleep; you have to get up early tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你说得对啊,是我刚才没考虑清楚。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì a, shì wǒ gāng cái méi kǎo lǜ qīng chǔ。
examples.en: You're right; I just didn't think it through clearly.

examples.zh: 多穿点衣服啊,外面的风可大了。
examples.pinyin: Duō chuān diǎn yī fú a, wài miàn de fēng kě dà le。
examples.en: Put on more clothes; the wind outside is really strong.

examples.zh: 这个孩子真懂事啊,小小年纪就知道帮妈妈干活。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hái zi zhēn dǒng shì a, xiǎo xiǎo nián jì jiù zhī dào bāng mā mā gàn huó。
examples.en: This child is so sensible, helping mom with chores at such a young age.

examples.zh: 你可别忘了带钥匙啊,不然进不了门。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě bié wàng le dài yào shi a, bù rán jìn bù liǎo mén。
examples.en: Don't forget to bring your keys, or you won't get in.

examples.zh: 哇,你的房间收拾得这么干净啊,真让我羡慕。
examples.pinyin: Wa, nǐ de fáng jiān shōu shí de zhè me gān jìng a, zhēn ràng wǒ xiàn mù。
examples.en: Wow, your room is so clean; I really envy you.

examples.zh: 你慢点儿吃啊,别噎着了,又没人跟你抢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ màn diǎn ér chī a, bié yē zhe le, yòu méi rén gēn nǐ qiǎng。
examples.en: Eat slowly; don't choke — no one's fighting you for it.

examples.zh: 这么大的事你怎么不早说啊?现在才想起来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de shì nǐ zěn me bù zǎo shuō a? xiàn zài cái xiǎng qǐ lái。
examples.en: Why didn't you mention such a big thing earlier? Only now you remember.

examples.zh: 你一定要记得给我回电话啊,我等你消息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yí dìng yào jì de gěi wǒ huí diàn huà a, wǒ děng nǐ xiāo xī。
examples.en: Be sure to call me back; I'll be waiting to hear from you.

examples.zh: 外面天都黑了啊,你一个人回去我不放心。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn tiān dōu hēi le a, nǐ yí gè rén huí qù wǒ bù fàng xīn。
examples.en: It's already dark outside; I'm worried about you going back alone.

examples.zh: 这本书太有意思了啊,我一口气就读完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài yǒu yì si le a, wǒ yì kǒu qì jiù dú wán le。
examples.en: This book is so interesting; I read it all in one go.

examples.zh: 你可要说话算话啊,答应了就不能反悔。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yào shuō huà suàn huà a, dā yìng le jiù bù néng fǎn huǐ。
examples.en: You have to keep your word; once you've promised, no going back.

examples.zh: 哎,做人还是要诚实啊,骗人是长久不了的。
examples.pinyin: Āi, zuò rén hái shì yào chéng shí a, piàn rén shì cháng jiǔ bù liǎo de。
examples.en: Ah, one really should be honest; deceiving people never lasts.

examples.zh: 路上开车一定要注意安全啊,我在家等你回来。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng kāi chē yí dìng yào zhù yì ān quán a, wǒ zài jiā děng nǐ huí lái。
examples.en: Do drive safely on the road; I'll be waiting for you at home.

examples.zh: 你看这花开得多好啊,香味都飘到屋里来了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn zhè huā kāi de duō hǎo a, xiāng wèi dōu piāo dào wū lǐ lái le。
examples.en: Look how beautifully these flowers bloom; the fragrance drifts into the house.

title: "吧" ile yumuşatma ve tahmin
summary: Cümle sonundaki "吧" (ba) öneri, rica ya da tahmini yumuşatır: 咱们走吧 = Hadi gidelim; 你是老师吧? = Öğretmensin, değil mi?
explanation: "吧" cümle sonunda iki yumuşak ton katar: (1) ÖNERİ/RİCA — bir emir ya da teklifi nazikleştirir: 咱们走吧 (Hadi gidelim), 你休息一下吧 (Biraz dinlensene). Emirdeki sertliği azaltır. (2) TAHMİN — konuşmacının emin olmadığı bir varsayımı bildirir ve onay bekler: 他应该到了吧? (Gelmiştir herhâlde?), 你是新来的吧? (Yeni gelensin galiba?). Türkçedeki "...-sene, hadi" ve "...-dır herhâlde, değil mi?" tonlarına denk gelir. Emir/soru cümlesini yumuşatan çok yaygın bir parçacıktır.

examples.zh: 时间不早了,咱们快点出发吧,别迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù zǎo le, zán men kuài diǎn chū fā ba, bié chí dào le。
examples.en: It's getting late; let's set off soon so we're not late.

examples.zh: 你脸色不太好,先坐下来休息一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ liǎn sè bù tài hǎo, xiān zuò xià lái xiū xī yī huì er ba。
examples.en: You don't look well; sit down and rest for a bit first.

examples.zh: 这么晚了他还没回来,大概是加班了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le tā hái méi huí lái, dà gài shì jiā bān le ba。
examples.en: It's so late and he's not back yet; he's probably working overtime.

examples.zh: 你就是新搬来的邻居吧?欢迎欢迎!
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiù shì xīn bān lái de lín jū ba? huān yíng huān yíng!
examples.en: You must be the neighbor who just moved in? Welcome!

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我们出去走走吧,别老待在家里。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo, wǒ men chū qù zǒu zǒu ba, bié lǎo dài zài jiā lǐ。
examples.en: The weather's so nice; let's go out for a walk instead of staying in.

examples.zh: 这道题这么简单,你应该会做吧?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí zhè me jiǎn dān, nǐ yīng gāi huì zuò ba?
examples.en: This question is so easy; you should be able to do it, right?

examples.zh: 你别难过了,事情总会好起来的,别想太多吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié nán guò le, shì qíng zǒng huì hǎo qǐ lái de, bié xiǎng tài duō ba。
examples.en: Don't be sad; things will get better, so don't overthink it.

examples.zh: 他学了这么多年汉语,说得应该很流利了吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué le zhè me duō nián hàn yǔ, shuō de yīng gāi hěn liú lì le ba。
examples.en: He's studied Chinese for years; he must speak it fluently by now.

examples.zh: 咱们点两个菜就够了吧?吃不完多浪费。
examples.pinyin: Zán men diǎn liǎng gè cài jiù gòu le ba? chī bù wán duō làng fèi。
examples.en: Two dishes should be enough for us, right? It's wasteful if we can't finish.

examples.zh: 你先把这份文件看一下吧,有问题随时问我。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn kàn yī xià ba, yǒu wèn tí suí shí wèn wǒ。
examples.en: Take a look at this document first; ask me anytime if you have questions.

examples.zh: 外面在下雨,你带把伞吧,别淋湿了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn zài xià yǔ, nǐ dài bǎ sǎn ba, bié lín shī le。
examples.en: It's raining outside; take an umbrella so you don't get soaked.

examples.zh: 这个价钱差不多了,就买了吧,别再犹豫了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jià qián chà bu duō le, jiù mǎi le ba, bié zài yóu yù le。
examples.en: This price is about right; let's just buy it and stop hesitating.

examples.zh: 你今天累了一天,早点睡吧,明天还要上班。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān lèi le yī tiān, zǎo diǎn shuì ba, míng tiān hái yào shàng bān。
examples.en: You've been tired all day; sleep early, you have work tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这么多年没见,你都快认不出我了吧?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián méi jiàn, nǐ dōu kuài rèn bù chū wǒ le ba?
examples.en: After so many years apart, you can hardly recognize me, can you?

examples.zh: 咱们边走边聊吧,站在这儿说话太冷了。
examples.pinyin: Zán men biān zǒu biān liáo ba, zhàn zài zhè ér shuō huà tài lěng le。
examples.en: Let's talk while we walk; it's too cold to stand here talking.

examples.zh: 他刚才没接电话,大概是在开会吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng cái méi jiē diàn huà, dà gài shì zài kāi huì ba。
examples.en: He didn't answer the phone just now; he's probably in a meeting.

examples.zh: 这件事你就别放在心上了吧,大家都理解你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ jiù bié fàng zài xīn shàng le ba, dà jiā dōu lǐ jiě nǐ。
examples.en: Don't take this to heart; everyone understands you.

examples.zh: 你尝尝这个汤吧,看看咸淡合不合适。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cháng cháng zhè ge tāng ba, kàn kàn xián dàn hé bù hé shì。
examples.en: Try this soup and see if the seasoning is right.

examples.zh: 都到饭点了,你也饿了吧?一起吃点儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Dōu dào fàn diǎn le, nǐ yě è le ba? yì qǐ chī diǎn ér ba。
examples.en: It's mealtime; you must be hungry too? Let's eat together.

examples.zh: 这条路我们走了这么久,应该快到了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ men zǒu le zhè me jiǔ, yīng gāi kuài dào le ba。
examples.en: We've walked this road for so long; we should be almost there.

examples.zh: 你别客气了,把这些水果都拿去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kè qì le, bǎ zhè xiē shuǐ guǒ dōu ná qù chī ba。
examples.en: Don't be polite; take all this fruit and eat it.

examples.zh: 他今天没来上课,是不是生病了吧?
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān méi lái shàng kè, shì bú shì shēng bìng le ba?
examples.en: He didn't come to class today; could he be sick?

examples.zh: 咱们先在这儿等他一会儿吧,他说马上就到。
examples.pinyin: Zán men xiān zài zhè ér děng tā yī huì er ba, tā shuō mǎ shàng jiù dào。
examples.en: Let's wait here for him a while; he said he'd be here soon.

examples.zh: 这么重的箱子,还是让我来帮你搬吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng de xiāng zi, hái shì ràng wǒ lái bāng nǐ bān ba。
examples.en: Such a heavy box — let me help you carry it.

examples.zh: 你一个人在外地,平时要照顾好自己吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yí gè rén zài wài dì, píng shí yào zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ ba。
examples.en: You're on your own away from home; take good care of yourself.

title: Yapısal parçacıklar: 的 / 得 / 地
summary: Üçü de "de" okunur ama işlevleri farklıdır: 的 ismi niteler (漂亮的花), 得 tümleç bağlar (跑得快), 地 zarf yapar (认真地学).
explanation: Çince'de üç ayrı "de" parçacığı aynı telaffuz edilir ama işlevleri farklıdır: (1) 的 — bir ismi niteleyen öbeği isme bağlar: 漂亮的花 (güzel çiçek), 我的书 (benim kitabım). (2) 地 — bir sözcüğü ZARFA çevirip fiili niteler: 认真地学习 (dikkatlice çalışmak), 高兴地笑 (sevinçle gülmek). (3) 得 — fiil/sıfattan sonra gelip bir TÜMLEÇ (nasıl/ne derece) bağlar: 跑得快 (hızlı koşuyor), 高兴得跳起来 (sevinçten zıpladı). Kısaca: 的 + isim, 地 + fiil (önünde niteleyici), fiil + 得 + tümleç. Telaffuzda hepsi "de"dir (地 burada dì değil de'dir); ayrım yazıda ve işlevdedir.

examples.zh: 她穿着一条漂亮的裙子,高兴地走进了教室。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe yī tiáo piào liàng de qún zi, gāo xìng de zǒu jìn le jiào shì。
examples.en: Wearing a pretty dress, she walked happily into the classroom.

examples.zh: 他跑得很快,一会儿就跑得不见人影了。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, yī huì er jiù pǎo de bú jiàn rén yǐng le。
examples.en: He runs fast; in a moment he was out of sight.

examples.zh: 孩子认真地做着作业,写得又快又整齐。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi rèn zhēn de zuò zhe zuò yè, xiě de yòu kuài yòu zhěng qí。
examples.en: The child does the homework diligently, writing quickly and neatly.

examples.zh: 这是妈妈亲手做的菜,大家都吃得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì mā mā qīn shǒu zuò de cài, dà jiā dōu chī de hěn kāi xīn。
examples.en: This is food mom made by hand; everyone ate happily.

examples.zh: 老师慢慢地讲,把这个难题解释得很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī màn màn de jiǎng, bǎ zhè ge nán tí jiě shì de hěn qīng chǔ。
examples.en: The teacher explained slowly, making this hard problem very clear.

examples.zh: 外面的雨下得很大,我们只好待在温暖的屋子里。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn de yǔ xià de hěn dà, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo dài zài wēn nuǎn de wū zi lǐ。
examples.en: The rain outside is heavy, so we can only stay in the warm room.

examples.zh: 他小心地把杯子放好,生怕打碎了珍贵的礼物。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de bǎ bēi zi fàng hǎo, shēng pà dǎ suì le zhēn guì de lǐ wù。
examples.en: He carefully set down the cup, afraid of breaking the precious gift.

examples.zh: 这个消息来得太突然,大家都惊讶得说不出话。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī lái de tài tū rán, dà jiā dōu jīng yà de shuō bù chū huà。
examples.en: The news came so suddenly that everyone was too shocked to speak.

examples.zh: 她高兴地告诉我,她的努力终于得到了回报。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāo xìng de gào sù wǒ, tā de nǔ lì zhōng yú dé dào le huí bào。
examples.en: She happily told me that her efforts had finally paid off.

examples.zh: 他认真地听着老师的话,一句都没有漏掉。
examples.pinyin: Tā rèn zhēn de tīng zhe lǎo shī de huà, yī jù dōu méi yǒu lòu diào。
examples.en: He listened attentively to the teacher, missing not a single word.

examples.zh: 这条路又长又难走,我们走得非常辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yòu zhǎng yòu nán zǒu, wǒ men zǒu de fēi cháng xīn kǔ。
examples.en: This road is long and hard; we walked with great difficulty.

examples.zh: 弟弟开心地笑了,笑得眼睛都眯成了一条线。
examples.pinyin: Dì di kāi xīn de xiào le, xiào de yǎn jīng dōu mī chéng le yī tiáo xiàn。
examples.en: Little brother laughed happily, his eyes narrowing into lines.

examples.zh: 妈妈做的饭菜香喷喷的,我们都吃得饱饱的。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zuò de fàn cài xiāng pēn pēn de, wǒ men dōu chī de bǎo bǎo de。
examples.en: The meal mom made smelled wonderful, and we all ate our fill.

examples.zh: 他悄悄地走进房间,怕吵醒熟睡的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiāo qiāo de zǒu jìn fáng jiān, pà chǎo xǐng shú shuì de hái zi。
examples.en: He tiptoed into the room, afraid of waking the sleeping child.

examples.zh: 这么重要的比赛,他准备得非常充分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de bǐ sài, tā zhǔn bèi de fēi cháng chōng fèn。
examples.en: For such an important match, he prepared very thoroughly.

examples.zh: 同学们高高兴兴地放假了,校园一下子安静了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xué men gāo gāo xìng xìng de fàng jià le, xiào yuán yī xià zi ān jìng le xià lái。
examples.en: The students went off happily on holiday, and the campus suddenly went quiet.

examples.zh: 那位老人慢慢地走着,脸上带着温和的微笑。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo rén màn màn de zǒu zhe, liǎn shàng dài zhe wēn hé de wēi xiào。
examples.en: The old man walked slowly, a gentle smile on his face.

examples.zh: 他的字写得很漂亮,是全班写得最好的一个。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zì xiě de hěn piào liàng, shì quán bān xiě de zuì hǎo de yí gè。
examples.en: His handwriting is beautiful, the best in the whole class.

examples.zh: 孩子们认真地听着爷爷讲那些古老的故事。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men rèn zhēn de tīng zhe yé yé jiǎng nà xiē gǔ lǎo de gù shì。
examples.en: The children listened intently to grandpa telling those old stories.

examples.zh: 这场大雨下得又急又猛,街上的人都跑得飞快。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà yǔ xià de yòu jí yòu měng, jiē shàng de rén dōu pǎo de fēi kuài。

examples.zh: 她轻轻地关上门,不想打扰正在工作的丈夫。
examples.pinyin: Tā qīng qīng de guān shàng mén, bù xiǎng dǎ rǎo zhèng zài gōng zuò de zhàng fū。
examples.en: She gently closed the door, not wanting to disturb her working husband.

examples.zh: 我们玩得特别开心,连回家的时间都忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men wán de tè bié kāi xīn, lián huí jiā de shí jiān dōu wàng le。
examples.en: We had so much fun that we even forgot the time to go home.

examples.zh: 他仔细地检查了一遍,把每个错误都改得很认真。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǐ xì de jiǎn chá le yī biàn, bǎ měi gè cuò wù dōu gǎi de hěn rèn zhēn。
examples.en: He checked carefully and corrected every mistake conscientiously.

examples.zh: 那只小鸟自由地飞着,飞得越来越高。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhǐ xiǎo niǎo zì yóu de fēi zhe, fēi de yuè lái yuè gāo。
examples.en: The little bird flew freely, higher and higher.

examples.zh: 这道菜辣得我直流眼泪,可是还是忍不住地想吃。

examples.en: This dish was so spicy it made me tear up, yet I couldn't help wanting more.

title: "过" ve "了" birlikte
summary: "过" ve "了" birlikte gelince bir eylemin ARTIK tamamlandığını / yapılıp bitirildiğini vurgular: 我吃过了 = Yemeğimi yedim (yeme işi tamamlandı).
explanation: "过" tek başına "deneyim" bildirir, ama "过了" birlikte kullanıldığında konuşma anına yakın, ARTIK tamamlanmış bir eylemi vurgular — çoğu zaman "...-ı çoktan yaptım/bitirdim" anlamında: 我吃过饭了 (Yemeği yedim / karnım tok), 药我已经吃过了 (İlacı aldım bile). Bu kullanımda "过" eylemin gerçekleştiğini, "了" ise bunun şu anki durumu etkileyen yeni bir gerçek olduğunu belirtir. "已经" ile sık gelir. Deneyim "过"sından farkı: burada belli, yakın zamanlı ve tamamlanmış bir eyleme vurgu vardır.

examples.zh: 你们先吃,我已经吃过饭了,不饿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ men xiān chī, wǒ yǐ jīng chī guò fàn le, bù è。
examples.en: You go ahead and eat; I've already eaten and I'm not hungry.

examples.zh: 这部电影我看过了,结局有点儿出人意料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng wǒ kàn guò le, jié jú yǒu diǎn ér chū rén yì liào。
examples.en: I've already seen this movie; the ending is a bit unexpected.

examples.zh: 药我按时吃过了,你不用担心。
examples.pinyin: Yào wǒ àn shí chī guò le, nǐ bù yòng dān xīn。
examples.en: I've taken the medicine on time; don't worry.

examples.zh: 那本书我早就还过了,不在我这儿。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū wǒ zǎo jiù hái guò le, bù zài wǒ zhè ér。
examples.en: I returned that book long ago; it's not with me.

examples.zh: 这个地方我来过了,咱们换个新的地方玩吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dì fāng wǒ lái guò le, zán men huàn gè xīn de dì fāng wán ba。
examples.en: I've been to this place before; let's go somewhere new.

examples.zh: 会议的通知我已经发过了,大家应该都收到了。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì de tōng zhī wǒ yǐ jīng fā guò le, dà jiā yīng gāi dōu shōu dào le。

examples.zh: 你放心,我跟他说过了,他答应会来帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, wǒ gēn tā shuō guò le, tā dā yìng huì lái bāng máng。

examples.zh: 这道题老师讲过了,你怎么还是不会做?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí lǎo shī jiǎng guò le, nǐ zěn me hái shì bú huì zuò?
examples.en: The teacher has already explained this problem; how can you still not do it?

examples.zh: 水果我洗过了,放在桌上,你们随便吃。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ guǒ wǒ xǐ guò le, fàng zài zhuō shàng, nǐ men suí biàn chī。
examples.en: I've washed the fruit; it's on the table, help yourselves.

examples.zh: 那家餐厅我们去过了,味道一般,不用再去了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cān tīng wǒ men qù guò le, wèi dào yì bān, bù yòng zài qù le。
examples.en: We've been to that restaurant; it was mediocre, no need to go again.

examples.zh: 信我寄过了,大概过几天他就能收到。
examples.pinyin: Xìn wǒ jì guò le, dà gài guò jǐ tiān tā jiù néng shōu dào。
examples.en: I've mailed the letter; he should receive it in a few days.

examples.zh: 这些照片我都看过了,拍得真不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān wǒ dōu kàn guò le, pāi de zhēn bù cuò。
examples.en: I've looked through all these photos; they're really well taken.

examples.zh: 你要问的那件事,我早就跟经理商量过了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào wèn de nà jiàn shì, wǒ zǎo jiù gēn jīng lǐ shāng liáng guò le。
examples.en: That matter you want to ask about — I discussed it with the manager long ago.

examples.zh: 门窗我都检查过了,你放心去上班吧。

examples.zh: 这个道理我小时候就懂过了,不用你再教我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dào lǐ wǒ xiǎo shí hòu jiù dǒng guò le, bù yòng nǐ zài jiào wǒ。

examples.zh: 车票我订过了,是明天上午九点的。
examples.pinyin: Chē piào wǒ dìng guò le, shì míng tiān shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn de。

examples.zh: 这种苦我年轻的时候就吃过了,现在不怕了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kǔ wǒ nián qīng de shí hòu jiù chī guò le, xiàn zài bù pà le。
examples.en: I went through this hardship when young; I'm not afraid of it now.

examples.zh: 作业我写过了,现在可以出去玩一会儿了吧?
examples.pinyin: Zuò yè wǒ xiě guò le, xiàn zài kě yǐ chū qù wán yī huì er le ba?
examples.en: I've finished my homework; can I go out and play for a while now?

examples.zh: 这个问题咱们上次开会已经讨论过了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí zán men shàng cì kāi huì yǐ jīng tǎo lùn guò le。
examples.en: We already discussed this question at the last meeting.

examples.zh: 礼物我准备过了,就等着给她一个惊喜了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ wù wǒ zhǔn bèi guò le, jiù děng zhe gěi tā yí gè jīng xǐ le。
examples.en: I've prepared the gift; now I'm just waiting to surprise her.

examples.zh: 那条路我走过了,又远又不好走,咱们绕一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo lù wǒ zǒu guò le, yòu yuǎn yòu bù hǎo zǒu, zán men rào yī xià ba。
examples.en: I've walked that road; it's far and hard, let's take a detour.

examples.zh: 你说的那个方法我试过了,可惜没什么用。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de nà ge fāng fǎ wǒ shì guò le, kě xī méi shén me yòng。

examples.zh: 饭我做过了,菜也热过了,就等你回来吃了。
examples.pinyin: Fàn wǒ zuò guò le, cài yě rè guò le, jiù děng nǐ huí lái chī le。
examples.en: I've cooked the rice and reheated the dishes; just waiting for you to eat.

examples.zh: 这句话你已经说过好几遍了,我记住了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jù huà nǐ yǐ jīng shuō guò hǎo jǐ biàn le, wǒ jì zhù le。
examples.en: You've said this several times already; I've got it.

examples.zh: 那个地方的风景我欣赏过了,确实名不虚传。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge dì fāng de fēng jǐng wǒ xīn shǎng guò le, què shí míng bù xū chuán。
examples.en: I've admired the scenery there; it truly lives up to its reputation.

title: "比" ile karşılaştırma
summary: "比" (bǐ) iki şeyi karşılaştırır: A 比 B + sıfat = A, B'den daha ...: 他比我高 = O benden daha uzun.
explanation: İki şeyi karşılaştırmak için temel kalıp: A + 比 + B + sıfat. 今天比昨天冷 (Bugün dünden soğuk), 他比我大三岁 (O benden üç yaş büyük). Sıfat YALIN kalır — Türkçedeki gibi ayrı bir "daha" sözcüğü GEREKMEZ; "比" zaten "-den daha" anlamını taşır. ÖNEMLİ HATA: "比" cümlesinde sıfattan önce "很/非常" KULLANILMAZ (他比我很高 yanlıştır). Farkın miktarı sıfattan sonra eklenir: 高一点儿 (biraz daha uzun), 大三岁 (üç yaş büyük), 便宜得多 (çok daha ucuz). Olumsuzu genelde "没有" ile kurulur: 我没有他高 (Ben onun kadar uzun değilim).

examples.zh: 今天比昨天冷多了,你得多穿一件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng duō le, nǐ děi duō chuān yī jiàn yī fú。

examples.zh: 他比我大三岁,可是看上去比我还年轻。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì, kě shì kàn shàng qù bǐ wǒ hái nián qīng。
examples.en: He's three years older than me, yet he looks even younger.

examples.zh: 坐高铁比坐飞机方便,不用提前很久到车站。
examples.pinyin: Zuò gāo tiě bǐ zuò fēi jī fāng biàn, bù yòng tí qián hěn jiǔ dào chē zhàn。

examples.zh: 这家店的东西比那家便宜,质量却一点儿不差。

examples.en: This shop's goods are cheaper than that one's, yet the quality is just as good.

examples.zh: 弟弟比哥哥高一点儿,常常有人认错。
examples.pinyin: Dì di bǐ gē gē gāo yì diǎn ér, cháng cháng yǒu rén rèn cuò。
examples.en: The younger brother is a bit taller than the older one, so people often mix them up.

examples.zh: 今年的夏天比去年热得多,大家都不敢出门。

examples.zh: 他的汉语比我好,所以我常常向他请教。

examples.zh: 骑自行车比走路快,可是没有坐车舒服。
examples.pinyin: Qí zì xíng chē bǐ zǒu lù kuài, kě shì méi yǒu zuò chē shū fú。
examples.en: Cycling is faster than walking, but not as comfortable as riding.

examples.zh: 这次考试比上次难,很多同学都没考好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì bǐ shàng cì nán, hěn duō tóng xué dōu méi kǎo hǎo。
examples.en: This exam was harder than the last; many students didn't do well.

examples.zh: 乡下的空气比城里新鲜,住着特别舒服。
examples.pinyin: Xiāng xià de kōng qì bǐ chéng lǐ xīn xiān, zhù zhe tè bié shū fú。
examples.en: The countryside air is fresher than the city's; it's very comfortable to live there.

examples.zh: 妈妈做的饭比饭馆的还好吃,我最爱回家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zuò de fàn bǐ fàn guǎn de hái hǎo chī, wǒ zuì ài huí jiā chī fàn。
examples.en: Mom's cooking is even better than the restaurant's; I love eating at home most.

examples.zh: 他跑得比谁都快,是我们班的运动明星。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de bǐ shéi dōu kuài, shì wǒ men bān de yùn dòng míng xīng。
examples.en: He runs faster than anyone; he's the sports star of our class.

examples.zh: 这条裙子比那条好看,可是价钱也贵不少。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qún zi bǐ nà tiáo hǎo kàn, kě shì jià qián yě guì bù shǎo。

examples.zh: 我们的新家比以前的大多了,还带一个小院子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de xīn jiā bǐ yǐ qián de dà duō le, hái dài yí gè xiǎo yuàn zi。
examples.en: Our new home is much bigger than the old one, with a small yard too.

examples.zh: 身体比什么都重要,再多的钱也买不来健康。
examples.pinyin: Shēn tǐ bǐ shén me dōu zhòng yào, zài duō de qián yě mǎi bù lái jiàn kāng。

examples.zh: 哥哥比弟弟懂事,总是让着他,照顾他。

examples.en: The older brother is more sensible than the younger, always yielding to and caring for him.

examples.zh: 今天的月亮比平时圆,也比平时亮。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān de yuè liàng bǐ píng shí yuán, yě bǐ píng shí liàng。
examples.en: Tonight's moon is rounder and brighter than usual.

examples.zh: 这种方法比原来的省时间,大家都愿意用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāng fǎ bǐ yuán lái de shěng shí jiān, dà jiā dōu yuàn yì yòng。
examples.en: This method saves more time than the old one, so everyone prefers it.

examples.zh: 他的经验比我丰富,遇到问题总能想出办法。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jīng yàn bǐ wǒ fēng fù, yù dào wèn tí zǒng néng xiǎng chū bàn fǎ。
examples.en: His experience is richer than mine; he always finds a solution to problems.

examples.zh: 这次的旅行比想象中还有意思,我们都玩得很尽兴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lǚ xíng bǐ xiǎng xiàng zhōng hái yǒu yì si, wǒ men dōu wán de hěn jìn xìng。
examples.en: This trip was even more fun than we imagined; we all enjoyed ourselves.

examples.zh: 冬天的白天比夏天短,天黑得也早得多。
examples.pinyin: Dōng tiān de bái tiān bǐ xià tiān duǎn, tiān hēi de yě zǎo de duō。
examples.en: Winter days are shorter than summer ones, and it gets dark much earlier.

examples.zh: 他写的字比我工整,看起来舒服多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiě de zì bǐ wǒ gōng zhěng, kàn qǐ lái shū fú duō le。
examples.en: His handwriting is neater than mine; it's much more pleasant to look at.

examples.zh: 这个孩子比同龄人成熟,说话做事很有分寸。

examples.zh: 网上买东西有时比商店便宜,可是看不到实物。
examples.pinyin: Wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī yǒu shí bǐ shāng diàn pián yi, kě shì kàn bú dào shí wù。
examples.en: Buying online is sometimes cheaper than in stores, but you can't see the actual item.

examples.zh: 今年的收成比去年好,农民们脸上都是笑容。
examples.pinyin: Jīn nián de shōu chéng bǐ qù nián hǎo, nóng mín men liǎn shàng dōu shì xiào róng。
examples.en: This year's harvest is better than last year's; the farmers are all smiles.

title: "从...到..." ile "...-den ...-e"
summary: "从...到..." (cóng...dào...) bir başlangıç ve bitiş noktasını belirtir; hem yer hem zaman için kullanılır: 从家到学校 = evden okula; 从早到晚 = sabahtan akşama.
explanation: "从...到..." bir aralığın başını ve sonunu gösterir. Hem MEKÂN için — 从北京到上海 (Pekin'den Şanghay'a), 从家到公司 (evden şirkete) — hem de ZAMAN için — 从早上到晚上 (sabahtan akşama), 从星期一到星期五 (pazartesiden cumaya) kullanılır. "从" başlangıcı, "到" bitişi verir ve bu öbek genellikle fiilden önce, cümlenin başında ya da öznenin ardında yer alır. Mesafe/süre ölçmede ve bir işin kapsamını anlatmada çok yaygındır. Mecazi kullanımı da vardır: 从小到大 (küçüklükten büyüklüğe, hep).

examples.zh: 从我家到公司,坐地铁大概要四十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōng sī, zuò dì tiě dà gài yào sì shí fēn zhōng。
examples.en: From my home to the office, the subway takes about forty minutes.

examples.zh: 他每天从早忙到晚,几乎没有休息的时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān cóng zǎo máng dào wǎn, jī hū méi yǒu xiū xī de shí jiān。
examples.en: He's busy from morning to night every day, with almost no time to rest.

examples.zh: 从北京到上海,坐高铁只要五个小时。
examples.pinyin: Cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi, zuò gāo tiě zhǐ yào wǔ gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: From Beijing to Shanghai, the high-speed rail takes only five hours.

examples.zh: 这家店从周一到周日都开门,非常方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn cóng zhōu yī dào zhōu rì dōu kāi mén, fēi cháng fāng biàn。
examples.en: This shop is open from Monday to Sunday; very convenient.

examples.zh: 从小到大,妈妈一直是我最信任的人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎo dào dà, mā mā yì zhí shì wǒ zuì xìn rèn de rén。
examples.en: From childhood to adulthood, mom has always been the person I trust most.

examples.zh: 从这里到火车站不远,走路十几分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè lǐ dào huǒ chē zhàn bù yuǎn, zǒu lù shí jǐ fēn zhōng jiù dào le。
examples.en: It's not far from here to the train station; a ten-minute walk.

examples.zh: 我们从下午一直聊到深夜,谁都不觉得累。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men cóng xià wǔ yì zhí liáo dào shēn yè, shéi dōu bù jué de lèi。
examples.en: We chatted from the afternoon into the deep night, and no one felt tired.

examples.zh: 从山脚到山顶,一路上的风景美得让人忘记疲劳。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shān jiǎo dào shān dǐng, yī lù shàng de fēng jǐng měi de ràng rén wàng jì pí láo。
examples.en: From the foot to the summit, the scenery makes you forget your fatigue.

examples.zh: 这门课从最基础的内容讲到比较难的部分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè cóng zuì jī chǔ de nèi róng jiǎng dào bǐ jiào nán de bù fèn。
examples.en: This course goes from the most basic content to the harder parts.

examples.zh: 从春天到秋天,这个公园的花几乎没断过。
examples.pinyin: Cóng chūn tiān dào qiū tiān, zhè ge gōng yuán de huā jī hū méi duàn guò。
examples.en: From spring to autumn, the flowers in this park hardly ever stop blooming.

examples.zh: 他从年轻到年老,一直住在这个小村子里。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng nián qīng dào nián lǎo, yì zhí zhù zài zhè ge xiǎo cūn zi lǐ。
examples.en: From youth to old age, he has always lived in this small village.

examples.zh: 从早上八点到下午五点,他一直坐在电脑前工作。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zǎo shàng bā diǎn dào xià wǔ wǔ diǎn, tā yì zhí zuò zài diàn nǎo qián gōng zuò。
examples.en: From eight in the morning to five in the afternoon, he sat working at the computer.

examples.zh: 这条河从北向南,从我们村一直流到大海。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé cóng běi xiàng nán, cóng wǒ men cūn yì zhí liú dào dà hǎi。
examples.en: This river runs from north to south, flowing from our village all the way to the sea.

examples.zh: 从认识到结婚,他们只用了短短半年时间。
examples.pinyin: Cóng rèn shí dào jié hūn, tā men zhǐ yòng le duǎn duǎn bàn nián shí jiān。
examples.en: From meeting to marrying, they took only a short half a year.

examples.zh: 孩子从一岁到三岁,变化真是太大了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi cóng yī suì dào sān suì, biàn huà zhēn shì tài dà le。
examples.en: From age one to three, the change in a child is truly enormous.

examples.zh: 从这个星期一到下个星期五,他都要出差。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè ge xīng qī yī dào xià gè xīng qī wǔ, tā dōu yào chū chāi。
examples.en: From this Monday to next Friday, he'll be away on business.

examples.zh: 我从头到尾把这本书读了一遍,收获很大。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi bǎ zhè běn shū dú le yī biàn, shōu huò hěn dà。
examples.en: I read this book from start to finish and gained a lot.

examples.zh: 从家门口到学校门口,这条路我走了整整六年。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jiā mén kǒu dào xué xiào mén kǒu, zhè tiáo lù wǒ zǒu le zhěng zhěng liù nián。
examples.en: From my front door to the school gate, I walked this road for a full six years.

examples.zh: 这场大雨从昨天晚上一直下到今天中午。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà yǔ cóng zuó tiān wǎn shàng yì zhí xià dào jīn tiān zhōng wǔ。
examples.en: This heavy rain fell from last night all the way to noon today.

examples.zh: 从这个季度到下个季度,公司的目标提高了不少。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè ge jì dù dào xià gè jì dù, gōng sī de mù biāo tí gāo le bù shǎo。
examples.en: From this quarter to the next, the company's targets rose considerably.

examples.zh: 从第一页到最后一页,他做的笔记密密麻麻。
examples.pinyin: Cóng dì yī yè dào zuì hòu yī yè, tā zuò de bǐ jì mì mì má má。
examples.en: From the first page to the last, his notes are packed densely.

examples.zh: 从城东到城西,这座城市这几年变化很大。
examples.pinyin: Cóng chéng dōng dào chéng xī, zhè zuò chéng shì zhè jǐ nián biàn huà hěn dà。
examples.en: From the east side to the west, this city has changed a lot in recent years.

examples.zh: 他从早到晚都在照顾生病的母亲,一点儿不喊累。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn dōu zài zhào gù shēng bìng de mǔ qīn, yì diǎn ér bù hǎn lèi。
examples.en: He cares for his sick mother from morning to night without complaining.

examples.zh: 这次培训从理论讲到实践,内容非常丰富。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì péi xùn cóng lǐ lùn jiǎng dào shí jiàn, nèi róng fēi cháng fēng fù。
examples.en: This training goes from theory to practice; the content is very rich.

examples.zh: 从开始学习到能流利交流,她花了不到两年。
examples.pinyin: Cóng kāi shǐ xué xí dào néng liú lì jiāo liú, tā huā le bú dào liǎng nián。
examples.en: From beginning to study to communicating fluently, she took less than two years.

title: "没有" ile olumsuz karşılaştırma
pattern: İsim 1 + 没(有) + İsim 2 + (这么/那么) + Sıfat
summary: "没有" karşılaştırmada "...kadar değil" der: A 没有 B 高 = A, B kadar uzun değil.
explanation: "比" ile yapılan karşılaştırmanın OLUMSUZ karşılığı "没有" iledir: A + 没有 + B + (这么/那么) + sıfat = "A, B kadar ... değil". 我没有他高 (Ben onun kadar uzun değilim), 今天没有昨天冷 (Bugün dün kadar soğuk değil). Sıfattan önce çoğu zaman "这么/那么" gelir: 弟弟没有哥哥那么高 (Kardeş, ağabey kadar uzun değil). Bu yapı "不比"den farklıdır: "A 没有 B 高" = A, B'den kısa (B daha uzun); daha yumuşak ve doğaldır. Türkçedeki "... kadar ... değil" kalıbına birebir uyar.

examples.zh: 我没有他跑得快,每次比赛都是他赢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu tā pǎo de kuài, měi cì bǐ sài dōu shì tā yíng。
examples.en: I don't run as fast as him; he wins every race.

examples.zh: 今天没有昨天那么冷,不用穿那么厚。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng, bù yòng chuān nà me hòu。
examples.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday; no need to dress so warmly.

examples.zh: 这家店的东西没有那家新鲜,我们还是去那家吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī méi yǒu nà jiā xīn xiān, wǒ men hái shì qù nà jiā ba。
examples.en: This shop's goods aren't as fresh as that one's; let's go to that one.

examples.zh: 弟弟没有哥哥那么高,可是比哥哥壮实。
examples.pinyin: Dì di méi yǒu gē gē nà me gāo, kě shì bǐ gē gē zhuàng shí。
examples.en: The younger brother isn't as tall as the older, but he's sturdier.

examples.zh: 我的汉语没有你说得那么流利,还得多练习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de hàn yǔ méi yǒu nǐ shuō de nà me liú lì, hái de duō liàn xí。
examples.en: My Chinese isn't as fluent as yours; I need more practice.

examples.zh: 这次考试没有上次难,大家都考得不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì méi yǒu shàng cì nán, dà jiā dōu kǎo de bù cuò。
examples.en: This exam wasn't as hard as last time; everyone did well.

examples.zh: 城里的空气没有乡下新鲜,住久了不太舒服。
examples.pinyin: Chéng lǐ de kōng qì méi yǒu xiāng xià xīn xiān, zhù jiǔ le bù tài shū fú。
examples.en: City air isn't as fresh as the countryside's; it's uncomfortable long-term.

examples.zh: 他做的菜没有妈妈做的好吃,不过也不错了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de cài méi yǒu mā mā zuò de hǎo chī, bù guò yě bù cuò le。
examples.en: His cooking isn't as good as mom's, but it's not bad.

examples.zh: 坐公交车没有坐地铁快,常常会堵在路上。
examples.pinyin: Zuò gōng jiāo chē méi yǒu zuò dì tiě kuài, cháng cháng huì dǔ zài lù shàng。
examples.en: The bus isn't as fast as the subway; it often gets stuck in traffic.

examples.zh: 这部电影没有上一部精彩,我看到一半就走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng méi yǒu shàng yī bù jīng cǎi, wǒ kàn dào yí bàn jiù zǒu le。
examples.en: This movie isn't as exciting as the last; I left halfway through.

examples.zh: 我的房间没有你的大,不过收拾得很整齐。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fáng jiān méi yǒu nǐ de dà, bù guò shōu shí de hěn zhěng qí。
examples.en: My room isn't as big as yours, but it's tidily kept.

examples.zh: 今年的雨水没有去年多,农民们有点儿担心。
examples.pinyin: Jīn nián de yǔ shuǐ méi yǒu qù nián duō, nóng mín men yǒu diǎn ér dān xīn。
examples.en: This year's rainfall isn't as much as last year's; the farmers are a bit worried.

examples.zh: 他的经验没有老王丰富,遇事还是会紧张。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jīng yàn méi yǒu lǎo wáng fēng fù, yù shì hái shì huì jǐn zhāng。
examples.en: His experience isn't as rich as Old Wang's; he still gets nervous in trouble.

examples.zh: 这条路没有那条宽,车多的时候很容易堵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù méi yǒu nà tiáo kuān, chē duō de shí hòu hěn róng yì dǔ。
examples.en: This road isn't as wide as that one; it easily jams when busy.

examples.zh: 新买的手机没有原来的好用,我有点后悔了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn mǎi de shǒu jī méi yǒu yuán lái de hǎo yòng, wǒ yǒu diǎn hòu huǐ le。
examples.en: The newly bought phone isn't as easy to use as the old one; I regret it a bit.

examples.zh: 妹妹没有姐姐那么爱说话,平时安安静静的。
examples.pinyin: Mèi mèi méi yǒu jiě jiě nà me ài shuō huà, píng shí ān ān jìng jìng de。
examples.en: The younger sister isn't as talkative as the older; she's usually quiet.

examples.zh: 这里的冬天没有北方那么冷,很少下雪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de dōng tiān méi yǒu běi fāng nà me lěng, hěn shǎo xià xuě。
examples.en: Winters here aren't as cold as in the north; it rarely snows.

examples.zh: 我没有他那么有耐心,教孩子学习总是着急。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu tā nà me yǒu nài xīn, jiào hái zi xué xí zǒng shì zháo jí。
examples.en: I'm not as patient as him; I always get anxious teaching the child.

examples.zh: 这个牌子的衣服没有那个牌子的贵,质量却差不多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge pái zi de yī fú méi yǒu nà ge pái zi de guì, zhì liàng què chà bu duō。
examples.en: This brand's clothes aren't as pricey as that brand's, yet the quality's similar.

examples.zh: 今天的月亮没有昨天那么圆,不过还是很亮。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān de yuè liàng méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me yuán, bù guò hái shì hěn liàng。
examples.en: Tonight's moon isn't as round as yesterday's, but it's still bright.

examples.zh: 他的个子没有以前高了吗?怎么感觉矮了一点。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gè zi méi yǒu yǐ qián gāo le ma? zěn me gǎn jué ǎi le yì diǎn。
examples.en: Isn't he as tall as before? He seems a bit shorter.

examples.zh: 这次的旅行没有想象中那么累,反而很放松。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lǚ xíng méi yǒu xiǎng xiàng zhōng nà me lèi, fǎn ér hěn fàng sōng。
examples.en: This trip wasn't as tiring as expected; it was actually relaxing.

examples.zh: 弟弟的字没有姐姐写得工整,还得好好练。
examples.pinyin: Dì di de zì méi yǒu jiě jiě xiě de gōng zhěng, hái de hǎo hǎo liàn。
examples.en: The younger brother's handwriting isn't as neat as the older sister's; he needs practice.

examples.zh: 我们村现在没有以前那么热闹了,年轻人都走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men cūn xiàn zài méi yǒu yǐ qián nà me rè nào le, nián qīng rén dōu zǒu le。
examples.en: Our village isn't as lively as before; the young people have all left.

examples.zh: 这道题其实没有看起来那么难,静下心就会做了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí qí shí méi yǒu kàn qǐ lái nà me nán, jìng xià xīn jiù huì zuò le。
examples.en: This problem isn't actually as hard as it looks; calm down and you'll solve it.

title: "来" ve "去" ile yön
summary: "来" (lái) konuşana DOĞRU, "去" (qù) konuşandan UZAĞA yönelmeyi gösterir: 来我家 = (bana) evime gel; 去学校 = okula git.
explanation: "来" ve "去" hareketin yönünü konuşmacıya göre belirler: "来" konuşmacıya/hedefe DOĞRU gelmeyi, "去" konuşmacıdan UZAĞA gitmeyi anlatır. 你来我家吧 (Bana evime gel), 我去你那儿 (Ben sana gelirim/giderim — konuşmacı gidiyor). Bir yer eklendiğinde: 来/去 + yer. Türkçedeki "gel/git" mantığıyla aynıdır ama referans noktası her zaman konuşmacının bulunduğu/hayal ettiği yerdir. Ayrıca başka fiillerin ardına gelip yön tümleci olurlar: 走过来 (yürüyerek buraya gel), 拿去 (alıp götür). Temelde "buraya" vs "oraya" ayrımıdır.

examples.zh: 周末你来我家吃饭吧,我给你做拿手菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò nǐ lái wǒ jiā chī fàn ba, wǒ gěi nǐ zuò ná shǒu cài。
examples.en: Come to my place for dinner this weekend; I'll make my specialty.

examples.zh: 我明天要去上海出差,大概待三天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míng tiān yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi, dà gài dài sān tiān。
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm going to Shanghai on business, staying about three days.

examples.zh: 外面下雨了,你快进来,别在门口站着。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn xià yǔ le, nǐ kuài jìn lái, bié zài mén kǒu zhàn zhe。
examples.en: It's raining outside; come in quickly, don't stand at the door.

examples.zh: 他去超市买东西了,一会儿就回来。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xī le, yī huì er jiù huí lái。
examples.en: He went to the supermarket to shop; he'll be back soon.

examples.zh: 有空的话,欢迎你们随时来我们学校参观。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kòng de huà, huān yíng nǐ men suí shí lái wǒ men xué xiào cān guān。
examples.en: If you have time, you're welcome to visit our school anytime.

examples.zh: 我下午要去医院看望一位生病的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yī yuàn kàn wàng yī wèi shēng bìng de lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: This afternoon I'm going to the hospital to visit a sick old friend.

examples.zh: 你别过来,地上刚拖过,还湿着呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié guò lái, de shàng gāng tuō guò, hái shī zhe ne。
examples.en: Don't come over; the floor was just mopped and is still wet.

examples.zh: 我们打算暑假去南方旅行,顺便看看海。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dǎ suàn shǔ jià qù nán fāng lǚ xíng, shùn biàn kàn kàn hǎi。
examples.en: We plan to travel south during summer break and see the sea.

examples.zh: 快过来看,窗外的晚霞太美了!
examples.pinyin: Kuài guò lái kàn, chuāng wài de wǎn xiá tài měi le!
examples.en: Come over quickly and look; the sunset outside the window is gorgeous!

examples.zh: 他每天都要去公园锻炼,风雨无阻。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu yào qù gōng yuán duàn liàn, fēng yǔ wú zǔ。
examples.en: He goes to the park to exercise every day, rain or shine.

examples.zh: 你把那本书拿过来,我想看看是什么内容。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ nà běn shū ná guò lái, wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn shì shén me nèi róng。
examples.en: Bring that book over; I want to see what it's about.

examples.zh: 下课以后,我要去图书馆还几本书。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ yào qù tú shū guǎn hái jǐ běn shū。
examples.en: After class I'm going to the library to return some books.

examples.zh: 客人马上就来了,你快去准备一下茶水。
examples.pinyin: Kè rén mǎ shàng jiù lái le, nǐ kuài qù zhǔn bèi yī xià chá shuǐ。
examples.en: The guests are arriving soon; go and prepare some tea.

examples.zh: 他从很远的地方赶来,就为了参加这次聚会。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng hěn yuǎn de dì fāng gǎn lái, jiù wèi le cān jiā zhè cì jù huì。
examples.en: He rushed here from far away just to attend this gathering.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我们去海边走走怎么样?
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo, wǒ men qù hǎi biān zǒu zǒu zěn me yàng?
examples.en: The weather's so nice; how about we go for a walk by the sea?

examples.zh: 你回来的时候,顺便去买点儿面包和牛奶。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huí lái de shí hòu, shùn biàn qù mǎi diǎn ér miàn bāo hé niú nǎi。
examples.en: On your way back, pick up some bread and milk.

examples.zh: 孩子放学了还没回来,妈妈有点儿着急。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi fàng xué le hái méi huí lái, mā mā yǒu diǎn ér zháo jí。
examples.en: The child hasn't come back from school yet; mom is a bit worried.

examples.zh: 请大家往前走,不要停在门口挡着路。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā wǎng qián zǒu, bú yào tíng zài mén kǒu dǎng zhe lù。
examples.en: Please move forward, everyone; don't stop at the door blocking the way.

examples.zh: 我这就去接你,你在车站等我,别乱走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jiù qù jiē nǐ, nǐ zài chē zhàn děng wǒ, bié luàn zǒu。
examples.en: I'll go pick you up now; wait at the station and don't wander off.

examples.zh: 他跑过来告诉我这个好消息,高兴得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo guò lái gào sù wǒ zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī, gāo xìng de bù de le。
examples.en: He ran over to tell me the good news, thrilled beyond words.

examples.zh: 周末我不想出去,就想在家好好休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù, jiù xiǎng zài jiā hǎo hǎo xiū xī。
examples.en: This weekend I don't want to go out; I just want to rest at home.

examples.zh: 你要是来北京,一定要提前告诉我一声。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì lái běi jīng, yí dìng yào tí qián gào sù wǒ yī shēng。
examples.en: If you come to Beijing, be sure to let me know in advance.

examples.zh: 这些东西太重了,我一个人搬不过去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē dōng xī tài zhòng le, wǒ yí gè rén bān bù guò qù。
examples.en: These things are too heavy; I can't carry them over by myself.

examples.zh: 老师叫你去办公室一趟,好像有事找你。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī jiào nǐ qù bàn gōng shì yī tàng, hǎo xiàng yǒu shì zhǎo nǐ。
examples.en: The teacher wants you to come to the office; it seems there's something.

examples.zh: 既然来了,就多待几天,好好逛逛这座城市。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán lái le, jiù duō dài jǐ tiān, hǎo hǎo guàng guàng zhè zuò chéng shì。
examples.en: Since you've come, stay a few more days and explore the city properly.

title: "请" ile kibar rica
summary: "请" (qǐng) bir isteği kibarlaştırır: 请进 = buyurun girin; 请坐 = lütfen oturun.
explanation: "请" bir fiilin önüne gelerek isteği/emri kibarlaştırır — Türkçedeki "lütfen / buyurun / rica ederim" gibi. 请进 (buyurun girin), 请坐 (oturun lütfen), 请等一下 (bir dakika bekleyin lütfen). Bir kişi de eklenebilir: 请你帮我一下 (rica etsem bana yardım eder misin). "请" ayrıca "davet etmek / ısmarlamak" fiili olarak da kullanılır: 我请你吃饭 (Sana yemek ısmarlıyorum), 请客 (misafir ağırlamak/ısmarlamak). Nazik ortamlarda, hizmet dilinde ve ricalarda çok yaygındır; ricayı yumuşatan en temel kibarlık sözcüğüdür.

examples.zh: 请进,外面冷,快到屋里来坐。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jìn, wài miàn lěng, kuài dào wū lǐ lái zuò。
examples.en: Please come in; it's cold outside, come sit inside.

examples.zh: 请大家安静一下,会议马上就要开始了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā ān jìng yī xià, huì yì mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le。
examples.en: Please quiet down, everyone; the meeting is about to begin.

examples.zh: 请问,去火车站应该坐几路车?
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wèn, qù huǒ chē zhàn yīng gāi zuò jǐ lù chē?
examples.en: Excuse me, which bus should I take to the train station?

examples.zh: 这顿饭我请客,你们千万别跟我抢着付钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dùn fàn wǒ qǐng kè, nǐ men qiān wàn bié gēn wǒ qiǎng zhe fù qián。
examples.en: This meal is on me; don't you dare fight me over the bill.

examples.zh: 请你把窗户关一下,风太大了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ chuāng hù guān yī xià, fēng tài dà le。
examples.en: Please close the window; the wind is too strong.

examples.zh: 请稍等一下,我去看看经理在不在。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shāo děng yí xià, wǒ qù kàn kàn jīng lǐ zài bù zài。
examples.en: Please wait a moment; I'll check if the manager is in.

examples.zh: 为了感谢他的帮助,我特意请他吃了顿饭。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le gǎn xiè tā de bāng zhù, wǒ tè yì qǐng tā chī le dùn fàn。
examples.en: To thank him for his help, I specially treated him to a meal.

examples.zh: 请各位系好安全带,飞机马上就要起飞了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gè wèi jì hǎo ān quán dài, fēi jī mǎ shàng jiù yào qǐ fēi le。
examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelts; the plane is about to take off.

examples.zh: 有不明白的地方,请随时举手提问。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu bù míng bái de dì fāng, qǐng suí shí jǔ shǒu tí wèn。
examples.en: If anything is unclear, please raise your hand and ask anytime.

examples.zh: 请你转告他,今天的约会改到明天了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhuǎn gào tā, jīn tiān de yuē huì gǎi dào míng tiān le。
examples.en: Please tell him the appointment today is moved to tomorrow.

examples.zh: 请慢用,菜要是不够,随时叫我。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng màn yòng, cài yào shì bù gòu, suí shí jiào wǒ。
examples.en: Please enjoy your meal; if it's not enough, call me anytime.

examples.zh: 下周我过生日,想请几个好朋友来家里聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōu wǒ guò shēng rì, xiǎng qǐng jǐ gè hǎo péng yǒu lái jiā lǐ jù jù。
examples.en: I have my birthday next week and want to invite some good friends over.

examples.zh: 请把手机调成静音,不要影响别人休息。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shǒu jī diào chéng jìng yīn, bú yào yǐng xiǎng bié rén xiū xī。
examples.en: Please set your phone to silent so you don't disturb others' rest.

examples.zh: 请您在这里签个字,然后就可以取货了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nín zài zhè lǐ qiān gè zì, rán hòu jiù kě yǐ qǔ huò le。
examples.en: Please sign here, and then you can collect the goods.

examples.zh: 他为了请老师帮忙,专门跑了一趟老师家。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le qǐng lǎo shī bāng máng, zhuān mén pǎo le yī tàng lǎo shī jiā。
examples.en: To ask the teacher for help, he made a special trip to the teacher's home.

examples.zh: 请大家排队上车,不要拥挤,注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā pái duì shàng chē, bú yào yōng jǐ, zhù yì ān quán。
examples.en: Please queue to board; don't push, and mind your safety.

examples.zh: 请你原谅我这次的粗心,我以后一定注意。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ yuán liàng wǒ zhè cì de cū xīn, wǒ yǐ hòu yí dìng zhù yì。
examples.en: Please forgive my carelessness this time; I'll be careful in future.

examples.zh: 今天你请我喝咖啡,下次就轮到我请你了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān nǐ qǐng wǒ hē kā fēi, xià cì jiù lún dào wǒ qǐng nǐ le。
examples.en: You're treating me to coffee today; next time it's my turn.

examples.zh: 请把这份文件复印三份,谢谢你了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fù yìn sān fèn, xiè xiè nǐ le。
examples.en: Please make three copies of this document; thank you.

examples.zh: 客人来了,请先给他们倒杯水,让他们坐下歇歇。
examples.pinyin: Kè rén lái le, qǐng xiān gěi tā men dào bēi shuǐ, ràng tā men zuò xià xiē xiē。
examples.en: The guests are here; please pour them water and let them sit and rest.

examples.zh: 请您说慢一点儿,我的汉语还不太好。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nín shuō màn yì diǎn ér, wǒ de hàn yǔ hái bù tài hǎo。
examples.en: Please speak a bit slower; my Chinese isn't very good yet.

examples.zh: 这件事还得请您多多帮忙,我们感激不尽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hái de qǐng nín duō duō bāng máng, wǒ men gǎn jī bù jìn。
examples.en: We must ask for your help with this; we're deeply grateful.

examples.zh: 请大家把垃圾带走,一起保护这里的环境。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā bǎ lā jī dài zǒu, yì qǐ bǎo hù zhè lǐ de huán jìng。
examples.en: Please take your trash with you and help protect the environment here.

examples.zh: 为了庆祝他升职,同事们请他好好吃了一顿。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le qìng zhù tā shēng zhí, tóng shì men qǐng tā hǎo hǎo chī le yī dùn。
examples.en: To celebrate his promotion, his colleagues treated him to a good meal.

examples.zh: 请你放心,这件事包在我身上,一定办好。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ fàng xīn, zhè jiàn shì bāo zài wǒ shēn shàng, yí dìng bàn hǎo。
examples.en: Rest assured; leave this to me, I'll definitely get it done.

title: "要" yardımcı fiilinin çok anlamlılığı
titleEn: Auxiliary verb "yao" and its multiple meanings
summary: "要" (yào) bağlama göre "istemek", "...-ecek/niyetinde olmak", "gerekmek/-meli" ya da yakın gelecek ("neredeyse") anlamı taşır.
explanation: "要" çok anlamlı bir yardımcı fiildir; anlamı bağlamdan çıkar: (1) İSTEMEK/almak istemek (isimle): 我要一杯茶 (Bir çay istiyorum). (2) NİYET/gelecek (fiille): 我要去北京 (Pekin'e gideceğim/gitmek istiyorum). (3) GEREKLİLİK: 你要注意身体 (Sağlığına dikkat etmelisin). (4) YAKIN GELECEK, çoğu zaman "要...了" ile: 火车要开了 (Tren birazdan kalkacak), 快要下雨了 (Neredeyse yağmur yağacak). Olumsuzları anlamına göre değişir: istememe "不想", gerekmeme "不用/不必" ile kurulur; "不要" ise "...ma!" (yasak) demektir. Bu esneklik "要"yı çok sık ama dikkat gerektiren bir sözcük yapar.

examples.zh: 服务员,我要一杯热茶和一份点心,谢谢。
examples.pinyin: Fú wù yuán, wǒ yào yī bēi rè chá hé yī fèn diǎn xīn, xiè xiè。
examples.en: Waiter, I'd like a cup of hot tea and a pastry, thank you.

examples.zh: 放假以后,我要去南方好好玩几天。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià yǐ hòu, wǒ yào qù nán fāng hǎo hǎo wán jǐ tiān。
examples.en: After the holiday, I'm going to travel south and have fun for a few days.

examples.zh: 天气变凉了,你要注意身体,别感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì biàn liáng le, nǐ yào zhù yì shēn tǐ, bié gǎn mào le。
examples.en: The weather's turned cool; take care of your health and don't catch a cold.

examples.zh: 快点儿,火车要开了,再不上就赶不上了!
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎn ér, huǒ chē yào kāi le, zài bù shàng jiù gǎn bù shàng le!
examples.en: Hurry, the train's about to leave; if you don't board now you'll miss it!

examples.zh: 孩子说他长大以后要当一名科学家。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuō tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yào dāng yī míng kē xué jiā。
examples.en: The child says he wants to be a scientist when he grows up.

examples.zh: 这件事很重要,你要认真对待,不能马虎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào, nǐ yào rèn zhēn duì dài, bù néng mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: This matter is important; you must take it seriously, no carelessness.

examples.zh: 看样子快要下雨了,我们还是早点回家吧。
examples.pinyin: Kàn yàng zi kuài yào xià yǔ le, wǒ men hái shì zǎo diǎn huí jiā ba。
examples.en: It looks like it's about to rain; let's head home early.

examples.zh: 我要买一台新电脑,旧的实在太慢了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yī tái xīn diàn nǎo, jiù de shí zài tài màn le。
examples.en: I want to buy a new computer; the old one is really too slow.

examples.zh: 明天要考试了,他今天晚上打算好好复习。
examples.pinyin: Míng tiān yào kǎo shì le, tā jīn tiān wǎn shàng dǎ suàn hǎo hǎo fù xí。
examples.en: There's an exam tomorrow, so tonight he plans to review thoroughly.

examples.zh: 你要是累了就休息,身体最重要,别硬撑。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì lèi le jiù xiū xī, shēn tǐ zuì zhòng yào, bié yìng chēng。
examples.en: If you're tired, rest; health matters most, don't push yourself.

examples.zh: 春节要到了,家家户户都开始打扫房子。
examples.pinyin: Chūn jié yào dào le, jiā jiā hù hù dōu kāi shǐ dǎ sǎo fáng zi。
examples.en: The Spring Festival is coming; every household is starting to clean house.

examples.zh: 我要减肥,所以最近不敢吃太多甜的东西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào jiǎn féi, suǒ yǐ zuì jìn bù gǎn chī tài duō tián de dōng xī。
examples.en: I want to lose weight, so lately I don't dare eat too many sweets.

examples.zh: 你要记住,做人一定要诚实、守信用。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào jì zhù, zuò rén yí dìng yào chéng shí、 shǒu xìn yòng。
examples.en: Remember, one must be honest and keep one's word.

examples.zh: 电影马上就要开始了,大家把手机关了吧。
examples.pinyin: Diàn yǐng mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le, dà jiā bǎ shǒu jī guān le ba。
examples.en: The movie is about to start; everyone please turn off your phones.

examples.zh: 他说他要请我们全班同学吃饭,庆祝毕业。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā yào qǐng wǒ men quán bān tóng xué chī fàn, qìng zhù bì yè。
examples.en: He says he'll treat our whole class to a meal to celebrate graduation.

examples.zh: 你要多喝水,少喝饮料,这样对身体好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō hē shuǐ, shǎo hē yǐn liào, zhè yàng duì shēn tǐ hǎo。
examples.en: You should drink more water and fewer soft drinks; it's better for you.

examples.zh: 天快要黑了,我们得抓紧时间赶到山下。
examples.pinyin: Tiān kuài yào hēi le, wǒ men děi zhuā jǐn shí jiān gǎn dào shān xià。
examples.en: It's about to get dark; we must hurry to reach the foot of the mountain.

examples.zh: 我要跟你商量一件事,你什么时候有空?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào gēn nǐ shāng liáng yī jiàn shì, nǐ shén me shí hòu yǒu kòng?
examples.en: I want to discuss something with you; when are you free?

examples.zh: 孩子要上学了,做父母的心里既高兴又担心。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi yào shàng xué le, zuò fù mǔ de xīn lǐ jì gāo xìng yòu dān xīn。
examples.en: The child is about to start school; the parents feel both happy and anxious.

examples.zh: 你要真心对待朋友,别人才会真心对你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhēn xīn duì dài péng yǒu, bié rén cái huì zhēn xīn duì nǐ。
examples.en: You must treat friends sincerely, and only then will they treat you the same.

examples.zh: 这道菜要多放点盐,不然一点味道都没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yào duō fàng diǎn yán, bù rán yì diǎn wèi dào dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: This dish needs more salt, or it'll have no flavor at all.

examples.zh: 我们快要到站了,你把行李收拾一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men kuài yào dào zhàn le, nǐ bǎ xíng lǐ shōu shí yī xià ba。
examples.en: We're about to reach the station; gather up your luggage.

examples.zh: 他下决心要把汉语学好,每天都坚持练习。
examples.pinyin: Tā xià jué xīn yào bǎ hàn yǔ xué hǎo, měi tiān dōu jiān chí liàn xí。
examples.en: He's determined to master Chinese and practices every day.

examples.zh: 你要是想去,现在就得出发,再晚就来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì xiǎng qù, xiàn zài jiù dé chū fā, zài wǎn jiù lái bù jí le。
examples.en: If you want to go, you must leave now; any later and it'll be too late.

examples.zh: 秋天要来了,树上的叶子渐渐变黄了。
examples.pinyin: Qiū tiān yào lái le, shù shàng de yè zi jiàn jiàn biàn huáng le。
examples.en: Autumn is coming; the leaves on the trees are gradually turning yellow.

title: "应该" ile "-meli, gerekir"
summary: "应该" (yīnggāi) bir gereklilik ya da beklenti bildirir: "...-meli, ...-mesi gerekir": 你应该多休息 = Daha çok dinlenmelisin.
explanation: "应该" (kısaca "该") bir fiilin önüne gelerek "...-meli, ...-mesi gerekir, doğru olan budur" anlamı verir; ahlaki/mantıksal bir gereklilik ya da tavsiye bildirir: 你应该早点睡 (Erken yatmalısın), 我们应该帮助他 (Ona yardım etmeliyiz). Ayrıca güçlü bir TAHMİN/beklenti de bildirir: 他应该快到了 (Gelmek üzeredir herhâlde). Olumsuzu "不应该" = "...-memeli": 你不应该对他撒谎 (Ona yalan söylememeliydin). Konuşma dilinde çoğu zaman "该"a kısalır: 该走了 (Gitme vakti / gitmeliyiz). Tavsiye, uyarı ve beklenti anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 你最近脸色不好,应该早点休息,别熬夜了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn liǎn sè bù hǎo, yīng gāi zǎo diǎn xiū xī, bié áo yè le。
examples.en: You've looked unwell lately; you should rest early and stop staying up.

examples.zh: 做错了事就应该道歉,这没什么丢人的。
examples.pinyin: Zuò cuò liǎo shì jiù yīng gāi dào qiàn, zhè méi shén me diū rén de。
examples.en: If you've done wrong, you should apologize; there's nothing shameful in it.

examples.zh: 时间不早了,孩子们应该回家写作业了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù zǎo le, hái zi men yīng gāi huí jiā xiě zuò yè le。
examples.en: It's getting late; the children should go home and do their homework.

examples.zh: 他学得这么努力,这次考试应该没问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué de zhè me nǔ lì, zhè cì kǎo shì yīng gāi méi wèn tí。
examples.en: He's studied so hard; this exam should be no problem for him.

examples.zh: 我们应该珍惜和家人在一起的每一天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi zhēn xī hé jiā rén zài yì qǐ de měi yī tiān。
examples.en: We should cherish every day we spend with family.

examples.zh: 你不应该在背后说别人的坏话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yīng gāi zài bèi hòu shuō bié rén de huài huà。
examples.en: You shouldn't speak ill of others behind their backs.

examples.zh: 这么晚了他还没到,路上应该是堵车了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le tā hái méi dào, lù shàng yīng gāi shì dǔ chē le。
examples.en: It's so late and he's not here; there must be a traffic jam.

examples.zh: 年轻人应该多出去看看,增长见识。
examples.pinyin: Nián qīng rén yīng gāi duō chū qù kàn kàn, zēng zhǎng jiàn shí。
examples.en: Young people should go out more and broaden their horizons.

examples.zh: 你答应了别人的事,就应该说到做到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dā yìng le bié rén de shì, jiù yīng gāi shuō dào zuò dào。
examples.en: Once you've promised someone something, you should follow through.

examples.zh: 天气预报说明天有雨,我们应该带把伞。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān yǒu yǔ, wǒ men yīng gāi dài bǎ sǎn。
examples.en: The forecast says rain tomorrow; we should bring an umbrella.

examples.zh: 遇到困难的时候,朋友之间应该互相帮助。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào kùn nán de shí hòu, péng yǒu zhī jiān yīng gāi hù xiāng bāng zhù。
examples.en: When facing difficulties, friends should help one another.

examples.zh: 这件事是我做得不对,我应该向你说声对不起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì wǒ zuò de bú duì, wǒ yīng gāi xiàng nǐ shuō shēng duì bù qǐ。
examples.en: I was in the wrong on this; I should say sorry to you.

examples.zh: 他这个年纪,应该学会自己安排时间了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè ge nián jì, yīng gāi xué huì zì jǐ ān pái shí jiān le。
examples.en: At his age, he should learn to manage his own time.

examples.zh: 菜已经上齐了,他也该到了吧,再等他一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Cài yǐ jīng shàng qí le, tā yě gāi dào le ba, zài děng tā yī huì er。
examples.en: The dishes are all served; he should arrive soon, let's wait a bit.

examples.zh: 我们不应该因为一次失败就失去信心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bù yīng gāi yīn wèi yī cì shī bài jiù shī qù xìn xīn。
examples.en: We shouldn't lose confidence over a single failure.

examples.zh: 你身体不舒服,就应该去看医生,别拖着。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēn tǐ bù shū fú, jiù yīng gāi qù kàn yī shēng, bié tuō zhe。
examples.en: If you're unwell, you should see a doctor; don't put it off.

examples.zh: 好不容易放假了,你应该好好放松放松。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì fàng jià le, nǐ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo fàng sōng fàng sōng。
examples.en: You finally have a holiday; you should relax properly.

examples.zh: 这么重要的日子,他应该不会忘记吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de rì zi, tā yīng gāi bú huì wàng jì ba。
examples.en: Such an important day — surely he won't forget it.

examples.zh: 做人应该懂得感恩,别把别人的付出当成理所当然。
examples.pinyin: Zuò rén yīng gāi dǒng de gǎn ēn, bié bǎ bié rén de fù chū dàng chéng lǐ suǒ dāng rán。
examples.en: One should know gratitude and not take others' efforts for granted.

examples.zh: 都这个点儿了,该睡觉了,明天还要早起呢。
examples.pinyin: Dōu zhè ge diǎn ér le, gāi shuì jiào le, míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ ne。
examples.en: It's this late already; time to sleep, we have to get up early tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你既然喜欢那份工作,就应该勇敢去争取。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán xǐ huān nà fèn gōng zuò, jiù yīng gāi yǒng gǎn qù zhēng qǔ。
examples.en: Since you like that job, you should bravely go after it.

examples.zh: 客人快到了,我们应该提前把桌子准备好。
examples.pinyin: Kè rén kuài dào le, wǒ men yīng gāi tí qián bǎ zhuō zi zhǔn bèi hǎo。
examples.en: The guests are arriving soon; we should set the table in advance.

examples.zh: 他为这个家付出了这么多,我们应该理解他。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhè ge jiā fù chū le zhè me duō, wǒ men yīng gāi lǐ jiě tā。
examples.en: He's given so much to this family; we should understand him.

examples.zh: 这种小事你自己应该能处理好,不用什么都问我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎo shì nǐ zì jǐ yīng gāi néng chǔ lǐ hǎo, bù yòng shén me dōu wèn wǒ。
examples.en: You should be able to handle such small things yourself, without always asking me.

examples.zh: 努力了不一定成功,但不努力就应该想到会失败。
examples.pinyin: Nǔ lì le bù yí dìng chéng gōng, dàn bù nǔ lì jiù yīng gāi xiǎng dào huì shī bài。
examples.en: Effort doesn't guarantee success, but without it you should expect to fail.

title: "会" ile olasılık ve beceri
summary: "会" (huì) hem öğrenilmiş bir beceriyi ("...-ebilmek") hem de gelecekteki olasılığı ("...-ecek") bildirir: 我会开车 = Araba kullanabilirim; 明天会下雨 = Yarın yağmur yağacak.
explanation: "会" iki temel anlam taşır: (1) ÖĞRENİLMİŞ BECERİ — bir şeyi yapmayı bilmek/öğrenmiş olmak: 我会说汉语 (Çince konuşabiliyorum), 他会游泳 (Yüzmeyi biliyor). (2) OLASILIK/GELECEK — bir şeyin olacağına dair tahmin: 明天会下雨 (Yarın yağmur yağacak), 他会来吗? (Gelecek mi acaba?). İkinci anlamda çoğu zaman güçlü bir beklenti/olasılık vardır. Olumsuzu "不会": 我不会游泳 (Yüzme bilmem) ya da 明天不会下雨 (Yarın yağmaz). "能" (fiziksel imkân) ve "可以" (izin) ile karıştırılmamalı; "会" özellikle ÖĞRENME sonucu kazanılan beceriyi ve gelecek olasılığını vurgular.

examples.zh: 他会说好几种语言,出国旅行一点儿都不发愁。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì shuō hǎo jǐ zhǒng yǔ yán, chū guó lǚ xíng yì diǎn ér dōu bù fā chóu。
examples.en: He can speak several languages, so traveling abroad worries him not at all.

examples.zh: 天气预报说今天晚上会下大雪,你少出门。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō jīn tiān wǎn shàng huì xià dà xuě, nǐ shǎo chū mén。
examples.en: The forecast says heavy snow tonight; go out as little as possible.

examples.zh: 我以前不会做饭,现在会做好几道拿手菜了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián bú huì zuò fàn, xiàn zài huì zuò hǎo jǐ dào ná shǒu cài le。
examples.en: I used to not cook; now I can make several signature dishes.

examples.zh: 你放心,他答应的事一定会做到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, tā dā yìng de shì yí dìng huì zuò dào。
examples.en: Rest assured; whatever he promises he will surely do.

examples.zh: 这孩子这么聪明,将来一定会有出息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi zhè me cōng míng, jiāng lái yí dìng huì yǒu chū xī。
examples.en: This child is so clever; he'll surely amount to something.

examples.zh: 我不太会游泳,所以从来不敢去深水区。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì yóu yǒng, suǒ yǐ cóng lái bù gǎn qù shēn shuǐ qū。
examples.en: I can't really swim, so I never dare go into the deep end.

examples.zh: 你要是不好好复习,考试就会考砸的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì bù hǎo hǎo fù xí, kǎo shì jiù huì kǎo zá de。
examples.en: If you don't review well, you'll fail the exam.

examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴,也会拉小提琴,特别有音乐天分。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tán gāng qín, yě huì lā xiǎo tí qín, tè bié yǒu yīn yuè tiān fèn。
examples.en: She can play piano and violin; she's very musically gifted.

examples.zh: 别担心,一切都会好起来的,时间会解决一切。
examples.pinyin: Bié dān xīn, yī qiè dū huì hǎo qǐ lái de, shí jiān huì jiě jué yī qiè。
examples.en: Don't worry; everything will get better — time heals all.

examples.zh: 多穿点衣服,不然你会感冒的。
examples.pinyin: Duō chuān diǎn yī fú, bù rán nǐ huì gǎn mào de。
examples.en: Wear more clothes, or you'll catch a cold.

examples.zh: 他这个人很守时,从来不会让别人等他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè ge rén hěn shǒu shí, cóng lái bú huì ràng bié rén děng tā。
examples.en: He's very punctual and never makes others wait for him.

examples.zh: 你现在努力,以后一定会感谢今天的自己。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài nǔ lì, yǐ hòu yí dìng huì gǎn xiè jīn tiān de zì jǐ。
examples.en: Work hard now, and you'll surely thank your present self later.

examples.zh: 这么冷的天,他会不会忘了带外套?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me lěng de tiān, tā huì bú huì wàng le dài wài tào?
examples.en: In such cold weather, might he have forgotten his coat?

examples.zh: 我会开车,可是好久没开了,有点儿生疏了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì kāi chē, kě shì hǎo jiǔ méi kāi le, yǒu diǎn ér shēng shū le。
examples.en: I can drive, but I haven't in a long time and I'm a bit rusty.

examples.zh: 只要你坚持练习,总有一天会成功的。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐ yào nǐ jiān chí liàn xí, zǒng yǒu yī tiān huì chéng gōng de。
examples.en: As long as you keep practicing, one day you'll succeed.

examples.zh: 这种事以后还会发生,我们得早做准备。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shì yǐ hòu hái huì fā shēng, wǒ men děi zǎo zuò zhǔn bèi。
examples.en: This kind of thing will happen again; we must prepare early.

examples.zh: 他不会轻易放弃,遇到困难反而更有干劲。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì qīng yì fàng qì, yù dào kùn nán fǎn ér gèng yǒu gàn jìn。
examples.en: He won't give up easily; difficulties only make him more driven.

examples.zh: 你要是这样对他,他会伤心的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì zhè yàng duì tā, tā huì shāng xīn de。
examples.en: If you treat him like this, he'll be hurt.

examples.zh: 她学得很快,相信不久就会说得很流利。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué de hěn kuài, xiāng xìn bù jiǔ jiù huì shuō de hěn liú lì。
examples.en: She learns fast; I believe she'll soon speak fluently.

examples.zh: 天上乌云那么厚,看来一会儿会下雨。
examples.pinyin: Tiān shàng wū yún nà me hòu, kàn lái yī huì er huì xià yǔ。
examples.en: The clouds are so thick; it looks like it'll rain soon.

examples.zh: 我会永远记得你对我的好,谢谢你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì yǒng yuǎn jì de nǐ duì wǒ de hǎo, xiè xiè nǐ。
examples.en: I'll always remember your kindness to me; thank you.

examples.zh: 这么难的题,一般人是不会做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me nán de tí, yì bān rén shì bú huì zuò de。
examples.en: Such a hard problem — ordinary people can't solve it.

examples.zh: 你放心去吧,家里的事我会照顾好的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn qù ba, jiā lǐ de shì wǒ huì zhào gù hǎo de。
examples.en: Go without worry; I'll take good care of things at home.

examples.zh: 他答应会来,可到现在还没出现,是不是出事了?
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng huì lái, kě dào xiàn zài hái méi chū xiàn, shì bú shì chū shì le?
examples.en: He promised he'd come, but he's not here yet; did something happen?

examples.zh: 只要用心去做,再难的事也会变得简单。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐ yào yòng xīn qù zuò, zài nán de shì yě huì biàn de jiǎn dān。
examples.en: As long as you do it wholeheartedly, even hard things become simple.

title: "想" ile istek/niyet
summary: "想" (xiǎng) bir fiilin önünde "...-mek istemek, canı istemek" anlamı verir: 我想去 = Gitmek istiyorum.
explanation: "想" bir fiilin önüne gelerek bir istek, arzu ya da niyet bildirir: 我想喝咖啡 (Kahve içmek istiyorum), 他想去看电影 (Sinemaya gitmek istiyor). "要"dan daha yumuşak, daha istek/arzu odaklıdır ("要" daha kararlı/kesin niyet bildirir). Olumsuzu "不想" = "...-mek istememek": 我不想去 (Gitmek istemiyorum). "想" ayrıca tek başına bir fiil olarak "düşünmek" ve "özlemek" anlamlarına da gelir: 我想家 (Evimi/ailemi özlüyorum), 让我想想 (Bir düşüneyim). Bu konuda özellikle "...-mek istemek" (arzu) anlamını ele alıyoruz. Nazik isteklerde çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 忙了一整天,我现在只想回家好好睡一觉。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī zhěng tiān, wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ xiǎng huí jiā hǎo hǎo shuì yī jiào。
examples.en: After a busy day, all I want now is to go home and sleep well.

examples.zh: 放假的时候,我想去海边待上几天,什么都不想。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià de shí hòu, wǒ xiǎng qù hǎi biān dài shàng jǐ tiān, shén me dōu bù xiǎng。
examples.en: During the holiday, I want to spend a few days by the sea, thinking of nothing.

examples.zh: 他想学做菜,好在周末给家人露一手。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xué zuò cài, hǎo zài zhōu mò gěi jiā rén lòu yī shǒu。
examples.en: He wants to learn to cook so he can show off for his family on weekends.

examples.zh: 我不想去那家饭馆了,上次的菜太咸了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù nà jiā fàn guǎn le, shàng cì de cài tài xián le。
examples.en: I don't want to go to that restaurant again; last time the food was too salty.

examples.zh: 孩子说他想养一只小猫,天天缠着我们。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuō tā xiǎng yǎng yī zhī xiǎo māo, tiān tiān chán zhe wǒ men。
examples.en: The child says he wants a kitten and pesters us every day.

examples.zh: 这些年在外面,我特别想念家乡的味道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián zài wài miàn, wǒ tè bié xiǎng niàn jiā xiāng de wèi dào。
examples.en: All these years away, I've really missed the taste of my hometown.

examples.zh: 你要是想说什么,就直接说,别憋在心里。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì xiǎng shuō shén me, jiù zhí jiē shuō, bié biē zài xīn lǐ。
examples.en: If you want to say something, just say it; don't bottle it up.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我想出去走走,你陪我去吗?
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo, wǒ xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu, nǐ péi wǒ qù ma?
examples.en: The weather's so nice; I want to go for a walk, will you come?

examples.zh: 我一直想学一门乐器,可是总找不到时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì zhí xiǎng xué yī mén yuè qì, kě shì zǒng zhǎo bú dào shí jiān。
examples.en: I've always wanted to learn an instrument, but I never find the time.

examples.zh: 他最近压力太大,只想找个安静的地方待着。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì jìn yā lì tài dà, zhǐ xiǎng zhǎo gè ān jìng de dì fāng dài zhe。
examples.en: He's under a lot of stress lately and just wants a quiet place to be.

examples.zh: 我想请你帮个忙,不知道你方不方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng gè máng, bù zhī dào nǐ fāng bù fāng biàn。
examples.en: I'd like to ask you a favor, if it's convenient.

examples.zh: 放学以后,同学们都想快点回家看比赛。
examples.pinyin: Fàng xué yǐ hòu, tóng xué men dōu xiǎng kuài diǎn huí jiā kàn bǐ sài。
examples.en: After school, the students all want to hurry home to watch the match.

examples.zh: 我不想让父母担心,所以从来报喜不报忧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng ràng fù mǔ dān xīn, suǒ yǐ cóng lái bào xǐ bú bào yōu。
examples.en: I don't want to worry my parents, so I only share good news.

examples.zh: 你想吃点儿什么?我这就去给你做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn ér shén me? wǒ zhè jiù qù gěi nǐ zuò。
examples.en: What would you like to eat? I'll go make it for you now.

examples.zh: 这本书太好看了,我真想一口气把它读完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài hǎo kàn le, wǒ zhēn xiǎng yì kǒu qì bǎ tā dú wán。
examples.en: This book is so good; I really want to finish it in one go.

examples.zh: 这么多年过去了,我还是很想再见他一面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián guò qù le, wǒ hái shì hěn xiǎng zài jiàn tā yí miàn。
examples.en: After all these years, I still really want to see him once more.

examples.zh: 他想换一份轻松点的工作,多陪陪孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huàn yī fèn qīng sōng diǎn de gōng zuò, duō péi péi hái zi。
examples.en: He wants to switch to an easier job to spend more time with his kids.

examples.zh: 我想了很久,还是决定听从自己的心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, hái shì jué dìng tīng cóng zì jǐ de xīn。
examples.en: I thought about it for a long time and decided to follow my heart.

examples.zh: 外面太吵了,我实在不想在这儿待下去了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn tài chǎo le, wǒ shí zài bù xiǎng zài zhè ér dài xià qù le。
examples.en: It's too noisy outside; I really don't want to stay here anymore.

examples.zh: 每逢过节,在外的游子都特别想家。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng guò jié, zài wài de yóu zi dōu tè bié xiǎng jiā。
examples.en: Every festival, those away from home especially miss it.

examples.zh: 我想给妈妈买件礼物,可是不知道她喜欢什么。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi mā mā mǎi jiàn lǐ wù, kě shì bù zhī dào tā xǐ huān shén me。
examples.en: I want to buy mom a gift, but I don't know what she likes.

examples.zh: 如果有机会,我想去看看外面更大的世界。
examples.pinyin: Rú guǒ yǒu jī huì, wǒ xiǎng qù kàn kàn wài miàn gèng dà de shì jiè。
examples.en: If I get the chance, I want to see the bigger world out there.

examples.zh: 他现在只想安安静静地读书,别的什么都不想。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài zhǐ xiǎng ān ān jìng jìng de dú shū, bié de shén me dōu bù xiǎng。
examples.en: Right now he just wants to study quietly and think of nothing else.

examples.zh: 我不想跟你吵架,咱们心平气和地谈谈好吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng gēn nǐ chǎo jià, zán men xīn píng qì hé de tán tán hǎo ma?
examples.en: I don't want to argue with you; can we talk calmly?

examples.zh: 忙了这么久,真想好好休个假,什么都不管。
examples.pinyin: Máng le zhè me jiǔ, zhēn xiǎng hǎo hǎo xiū gè jiǎ, shén me dōu bù guǎn。
examples.en: After being busy so long, I really want a proper vacation, ignoring everything.

title: Ardışık eylemler (seri fiiller)
summary: Bir özne art arda birkaç eylem yapıyorsa, fiiller olma SIRASINA göre yan yana dizilir: 我去商店买东西 = Alışverişe (gidip) mağazaya giderim.
explanation: Aynı özne art arda birden çok eylem yapıyorsa, Çince bu fiilleri gerçekleşme SIRASINA göre üst üste dizer; araya bağlaç KOYMAYA gerek yoktur: 我去超市买菜 (Markete gidip sebze alırım). İlk fiil çoğu zaman ikincisinin amacını ya da yöntemini/aracını verir: 他坐飞机去北京 (Uçakla Pekin'e gider — 坐飞机 araç, 去北京 hedef). Türkçedeki "...-ip / ...-erek" mantığına benzer ama Çince sadece sırayla dizer. Fiillerin sırası olayların gerçek sırasını yansıtır; sırayı değiştirmek anlamı bozar. Bu, günlük dilde son derece yaygın bir yapıdır.

examples.zh: 我下班以后要去超市买点儿菜回家做饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu yào qù chāo shì mǎi diǎn ér cài huí jiā zuò fàn。
examples.en: After work I'll go to the supermarket, buy some vegetables, and cook at home.

examples.zh: 他每天早上坐地铁去公司上班。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shàng zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī shàng bān。
examples.en: Every morning he takes the subway to go to work.

examples.zh: 周末我想去图书馆借几本书看。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù tú shū guǎn jiè jǐ běn shū kàn。
examples.en: This weekend I want to go to the library and borrow some books to read.

examples.zh: 妈妈上街买了些水果回来给我们吃。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā shàng jiē mǎi le xiē shuǐ guǒ huí lái gěi wǒ men chī。
examples.en: Mom went to the street, bought some fruit, and brought it back for us.

examples.zh: 我们打算开车去海边玩儿一天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dǎ suàn kāi chē qù hǎi biān wán ér yī tiān。
examples.en: We plan to drive to the seaside and play for a day.

examples.zh: 他拿起电话给远方的父母报了个平安。
examples.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ diàn huà gěi yuǎn fāng de fù mǔ bào le gè píng ān。
examples.en: He picked up the phone and let his faraway parents know he was safe.

examples.zh: 孩子放学回家先写作业再看电视。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi fàng xué huí jiā xiān xiě zuò yè zài kàn diàn shì。
