examples.en: After school the child goes home, does homework first, then watches TV.

examples.zh: 我要用这些鸡蛋和面粉做一个蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào yòng zhè xiē jī dàn huó miàn fěn zuò yí gè dàn gāo。
examples.en: I'll use these eggs and flour to make a cake.

examples.zh: 他站起来走到窗边打开窗户透透气。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn qǐ lái zǒu dào chuāng biān dǎ kāi chuāng hù tòu tòu qì。
examples.en: He stood up, walked to the window, and opened it for some fresh air.

examples.zh: 下课以后我们一起去食堂吃午饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù shí táng chī wǔ fàn ba。
examples.en: After class let's go to the canteen together for lunch.

examples.zh: 她坐下来倒了杯茶,慢慢地跟我聊起了往事。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò xià lái dào le bēi chá, màn màn de gēn wǒ liáo qǐ le wǎng shì。
examples.en: She sat down, poured a cup of tea, and slowly reminisced with me.

examples.zh: 我要去银行取点钱再去商场买件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yín háng qǔ diǎn qián zài qù shāng chǎng mǎi jiàn yī fú。
examples.en: I'll go to the bank to withdraw money, then to the mall to buy clothes.

examples.zh: 爷爷每天早上去公园散步锻炼身体。
examples.pinyin: Yé yé měi tiān zǎo shàng qù gōng yuán sàn bù duàn liàn shēn tǐ。
examples.en: Grandpa goes to the park every morning to walk and exercise.

examples.zh: 他骑自行车去菜市场买了一大袋蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Tā qí zì xíng chē qù cài shì chǎng mǎi le yī dà dài shū cài。
examples.en: He biked to the market and bought a big bag of vegetables.

examples.zh: 我们进屋放下行李就出去吃饭了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jìn wū fàng xià xíng lǐ jiù chū qù chī fàn le。
examples.en: We went inside, put down our luggage, and went out to eat.

examples.zh: 你去厨房拿两个碗过来,我们准备吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù chú fáng ná liǎng gè wǎn guò lái, wǒ men zhǔn bèi chī fàn。
examples.en: Go to the kitchen and bring two bowls; we're about to eat.

examples.zh: 他每天下班回家陪孩子做游戏、讲故事。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān xià bān huí jiā péi hái zi zuò yóu xì、 jiǎng gù shì。
examples.en: Every day after work he goes home to play games and tell stories with his kids.

examples.zh: 我想坐火车去外地看看不一样的风景。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò huǒ chē qù wài dì kàn kàn bù yí yàng de fēng jǐng。
examples.en: I want to take the train to another place and see different scenery.

examples.zh: 她关上电脑站起来伸了个懒腰,准备休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā guān shàng diàn nǎo zhàn qǐ lái shēn le gè lǎn yāo, zhǔn bèi xiū xī。
examples.en: She closed the computer, stood up, stretched, and got ready to rest.

examples.zh: 我们去公园拍了很多照片留作纪念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men qù gōng yuán pāi le hěn duō zhào piān liú zuò jì niàn。
examples.en: We went to the park and took many photos as keepsakes.

examples.zh: 他跑到楼下买了份早饭又匆匆赶回来。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo dào lóu xià mǎi le fèn zǎo fàn yòu cōng cōng gǎn huí lái。
examples.en: He ran downstairs, bought breakfast, and hurried back.

examples.zh: 放假我要回老家看看年迈的爷爷奶奶。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià wǒ yào huí lǎo jiā kàn kàn nián mài de yé yé nǎi nǎi。
examples.en: During the holiday I'll go home to see my aging grandparents.

examples.zh: 你先去洗个手过来帮我一起包饺子。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù xǐ gè shǒu guò lái bāng wǒ yì qǐ bāo jiǎo zi。
examples.en: Go wash your hands first, then come help me wrap dumplings.

examples.zh: 我打算下午去邮局寄封信再去趟书店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ suàn xià wǔ qù yóu jú jì fēng xìn zài qù tàng shū diàn。
examples.en: This afternoon I plan to go to the post office to mail a letter, then to the bookstore.

examples.zh: 他每天晚上都要喝杯牛奶再上床睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu yào hē bēi niú nǎi zài shàng chuáng shuì jiào。
examples.en: Every night he drinks a glass of milk before going to bed.

title: "难" ile "...-ması zor / güç"
summary: "难" (nán) bir fiilin önüne gelip "...-ması zor" anlamı verir: 难写 = yazması zor; 难懂 = anlaşılması güç.
explanation: "难" bir fiilin önüne gelerek o eylemin YAPILMASININ zor olduğunu belirtir ve bir tür sıfat gibi davranır: 这个字很难写 (Bu karakteri yazmak zor), 他的话很难懂 (Sözlerini anlamak güç), 这种菜很难做 (Bu yemeği yapmak zor). Karşıtı "好"dır: 好写 (yazması kolay), 好懂 (anlaşılır). "难" + fiil bileşiği "很, 太, 真" gibi zarflarla derecelendirilebilir: 太难找了 (bulması çok zor). Ayrıca "难吃" (tadı kötü), "难看" (çirkin), "难听" (kulağa hoş gelmeyen) gibi olumsuz değerlendirme bileşikleri de kurar. Bir eylemin zorluğunu anlatmanın en doğal yoludur.

examples.zh: 这个汉字笔画太多,又难写又难记。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hàn zì bǐ huà tài duō, yòu nán xiě yòu nán jì。
examples.en: This character has too many strokes; it's hard to write and remember.

examples.zh: 他说话带着很重的口音,我们都觉得很难懂。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō huà dài zhe hěn zhòng de kǒu yīn, wǒ men dōu jué de hěn nán dǒng。
examples.en: He speaks with a heavy accent, and we all find it hard to understand.

examples.zh: 这道菜看起来简单,做起来其实很难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài kàn qǐ lái jiǎn dān, zuò qǐ lái qí shí hěn nán。
examples.en: This dish looks simple, but it's actually hard to make.

examples.zh: 这种药很难买,好几家药店都没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào hěn nán mǎi, hǎo jǐ jiā yào diàn dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: This medicine is hard to buy; several pharmacies didn't have it.

examples.zh: 他家住的地方特别难找,我们绕了半天才到。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā zhù de dì fāng tè bié nán zhǎo, wǒ men rào le bàn tiān cái dào。
examples.en: His place is really hard to find; we circled around for ages before arriving.

examples.zh: 这本书写得太专业,普通人很难看懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū xiě de tài zhuān yè, pǔ tōng rén hěn nán kàn dǒng。
examples.en: This book is too technical; ordinary people find it hard to follow.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会很难得,你可一定要抓住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de jī huì hěn nán de, nǐ kě yí dìng yào zhuā zhù。
examples.en: Such a good opportunity is rare; you must seize it.

examples.zh: 外面的路又黑又滑,晚上很难走。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn de lù yòu hēi yòu huá, wǎn shàng hěn nán zǒu。
examples.en: The road outside is dark and slippery, hard to walk at night.

examples.zh: 他的脾气那么倔,这件事恐怕很难说服他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pí qì nà me jué, zhè jiàn shì kǒng pà hěn nán shuō fú tā。
examples.en: He's so stubborn; this matter will be hard to convince him of.

examples.zh: 这种老式的零件现在很难找了,只能自己想办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng lǎo shì de líng jiàn xiàn zài hěn nán zhǎo le, zhǐ néng zì jǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ。
examples.en: This old-style part is hard to find now; you can only improvise.

examples.zh: 刚学汉语的时候,我觉得声调最难掌握。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xué hàn yǔ de shí hòu, wǒ jué de shēng diào zuì nán zhǎng wò。
examples.en: When I first learned Chinese, I found tones the hardest to master.

examples.zh: 那家饭馆的菜真难吃,我们再也不去了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā fàn guǎn de cài zhēn nán chī, wǒ men zài yě bù qù le。
examples.en: The food at that restaurant tastes terrible; we're never going again.

examples.zh: 这个问题很难回答,让我好好想一想。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí hěn nán huí dá, ràng wǒ hǎo hǎo xiǎng yī xiǎng。
examples.en: This question is hard to answer; let me think it over carefully.

examples.zh: 好东西往往来之不易,越难得到越要珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo dōng xī wǎng wǎng lái zhī bù yì, yuè nán dé dào yuè yào zhēn xī。
examples.en: Good things often come hard; the harder to get, the more to cherish.

examples.zh: 他画的画那么难看,自己却觉得很得意。
examples.pinyin: Tā huà de huà nà me nán kàn, zì jǐ què jué de hěn dé yì。
examples.en: His paintings are so ugly, yet he's quite pleased with them.

examples.zh: 这种感情一旦失去了,就很难再找回来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎn qíng yí dàn shī qù le, jiù hěn nán zài zhǎo huí lái。
examples.en: Once this kind of feeling is lost, it's hard to get back.

examples.zh: 春运的时候火车票特别难买,得提前很久抢。
examples.pinyin: Chūn yùn de shí hòu huǒ chē piào tè bié nán mǎi, de tí qián hěn jiǔ qiǎng。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival rush, train tickets are hard to buy; you must grab them early.

examples.zh: 这首歌唱得跑调了,听起来实在难听。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē chàng de pǎo diào le, tīng qǐ lái shí zài nán tīng。
examples.en: This song is sung off-key; it really sounds unpleasant.

examples.zh: 他做事总是三分钟热度,很难坚持到底。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì zǒng shì sān fēn zhōng rè dù, hěn nán jiān chí dào dǐ。
examples.en: He always starts with enthusiasm but finds it hard to see things through.

examples.zh: 这道数学题太难解了,全班没几个人做对。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào shù xué tí tài nán jiě le, quán bān méi jǐ gè rén zuò duì。
examples.en: This math problem is too hard; few in the class got it right.

examples.zh: 好习惯难养成,坏习惯却很容易染上。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo xí guàn nán yǎng chéng, huài xí guàn què hěn róng yì rǎn shàng。
examples.en: Good habits are hard to form, but bad ones are easy to pick up.

examples.zh: 那位老人的方言很难听懂,我们只能连猜带比划。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo rén de fāng yán hěn nán tīng dǒng, wǒ men zhǐ néng lián cāi dài bǐ huà。
examples.en: That old man's dialect is hard to understand; we had to guess and gesture.

examples.zh: 这种木头很硬,很难加工成想要的形状。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng mù tou hěn yìng, hěn nán jiā gōng chéng xiǎng yào de xíng zhuàng。
examples.en: This wood is very hard, difficult to shape as desired.

examples.zh: 这么大的房子,一个人打扫起来真难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de fáng zi, yí gè rén dǎ sǎo qǐ lái zhēn nán。
examples.en: Such a big house is really hard to clean by oneself.

examples.zh: 感情的事最难说清楚,外人很难明白。
examples.pinyin: Gǎn qíng de shì zuì nán shuō qīng chǔ, wài rén hěn nán míng bái。
examples.en: Matters of the heart are hardest to explain; outsiders can hardly understand.

title: "从来" ile "hiçbir zaman, asla"
pattern: 从来 + 不 / 没(有) + Fiil
summary: "从来" (cónglái) olumsuzlukla birlikte "hiçbir zaman, asla" der: 我从来不抽烟 = Hiç sigara içmem; 他从来没来过 = Hiç gelmemişti.
explanation: "从来" geçmişten bugüne SÜREGELEN bir durumu vurgular ve neredeyse her zaman OLUMSUZLUKLA kullanılır: "从来不" (hiçbir zaman ...-maz — alışkanlık/genel gerçek) ve "从来没(有)...过" (hiç ...-madı — deneyim yokluğu). 我从来不喝酒 (Hiç içki içmem), 我从来没见过这么大的雪 (Bu kadar büyük kar hiç görmedim). "不" ile şimdiki/genel bir reddi, "没...过" ile geçmişte hiç yaşanmamış bir deneyimi anlatır. "从来" vurguyu güçlendirir; "asla, ömrümde bir kez bile" tonu katar. Olumlu cümlede nadiren, ancak "从来如此" (hep böyleydi) gibi kalıplarda görülür.

examples.zh: 他为人很正直,从来不说谎话骗人。
examples.pinyin: Tā wéi rén hěn zhèng zhí, cóng lái bù shuō huǎng huà piàn rén。
examples.en: He's an upright person and never lies to deceive people.

examples.zh: 我从来没吃过这么好吃的饺子,你手艺真棒。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái méi chī guò zhè me hǎo chī de jiǎo zi, nǐ shǒu yì zhēn bàng。
examples.en: I've never eaten such delicious dumplings; your skill is amazing.

examples.zh: 她做事很认真,从来不迟到,也从来不早退。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì hěn rèn zhēn, cóng lái bù chí dào, yě cóng lái bù zǎo tuì。
examples.en: She's very conscientious, never late and never leaving early.

examples.zh: 我活了这么大,从来没见过这么大的场面。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huó le zhè me dà, cóng lái méi jiàn guò zhè me dà de chǎng miàn。
examples.en: In all my years, I've never seen such a grand scene.

examples.zh: 他从来不把困难放在眼里,总是勇往直前。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái bù bǎ kùn nán fàng zài yǎn lǐ, zǒng shì yǒng wǎng zhí qián。
examples.en: He never lets difficulties intimidate him, always forging ahead.

examples.zh: 这些年他忙于工作,从来没好好陪过家人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián tā máng yú gōng zuò, cóng lái méi hǎo hǎo péi guò jiā rén。
examples.en: All these years he's been busy with work and never properly spent time with family.

examples.zh: 我从来不相信天上会掉馅饼这种事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái bù xiāng xìn tiān shàng huì diào xiàn bǐng zhè zhǒng shì。
examples.en: I never believe in things like pie falling from the sky.

examples.zh: 奶奶年纪大了,可是从来没麻烦过我们。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi nián jì dà le, kě shì cóng lái méi má fán guò wǒ men。
examples.en: Grandma is old, yet she has never troubled us.

examples.zh: 他从来不炫耀自己的成绩,一直很谦虚。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái bù xuàn yào zì jǐ de chéng jì, yì zhí hěn qiān xū。
examples.en: He never shows off his achievements and stays humble.

examples.zh: 我从来没想到,普普通通的一句话会改变我的一生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái méi xiǎng dào, pǔ pǔ tōng tōng de yī jù huà huì gǎi biàn wǒ de yī shēng。
examples.en: I never imagined an ordinary sentence would change my whole life.

examples.zh: 这家老店几十年了,味道从来没变过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diàn jǐ shí nián le, wèi dào cóng lái méi biàn guò。
examples.en: This old shop is decades old, and its flavor has never changed.

examples.zh: 他脾气特别好,我从来没见他发过火。
examples.pinyin: Tā pí qì tè bié hǎo, wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn tā fā guò huǒ。
examples.en: He has a great temper; I've never seen him lose it.

examples.zh: 我从来不在背后议论别人,那样太不厚道。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái bù zài bèi hòu yì lùn bié rén, nà yàng tài bù hòu dào。
examples.en: I never gossip about people behind their backs; that's too unkind.

examples.zh: 她坚持锻炼,几十年如一日,从来没间断过。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiān chí duàn liàn, jǐ shí nián rú yí rì, cóng lái méi jiàn duàn guò。
examples.en: She's exercised consistently for decades, never once stopping.

examples.zh: 这么多年,他从来没忘记过对老师的感恩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián, tā cóng lái méi wàng jì guò duì lǎo shī de gǎn ēn。
examples.en: All these years, he has never forgotten his gratitude to his teacher.

examples.zh: 我从来没求过别人,这次实在是没办法了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái méi qiú guò bié rén, zhè cì shí zài shì méi bàn fǎ le。
examples.en: I've never asked anyone for help; this time I truly have no choice.

examples.zh: 他从来不乱花钱,把每一分都用在该用的地方。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái bù luàn huā qián, bǎ měi yī fēn dōu yòng zài gāi yòng de dì fāng。
examples.en: He never spends recklessly, using every cent where it's needed.

examples.zh: 这种事我从来没经历过,心里难免有些紧张。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shì wǒ cóng lái méi jīng lì guò, xīn lǐ nán miǎn yǒu xiē jǐn zhāng。
examples.en: I've never been through this kind of thing, so I'm inevitably a bit nervous.

examples.zh: 他从来不轻易许诺,但答应了就一定做到。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái bù qīng yì xǔ nuò, dàn dā yìng le jiù yí dìng zuò dào。
examples.en: He never promises lightly, but once he does he always follows through.

examples.zh: 长这么大,我从来没让父母操过这么大的心。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎng zhè me dà, wǒ cóng lái méi ràng fù mǔ cāo guò zhè me dà de xīn。
examples.en: In all my life, I've never made my parents worry so much.

examples.zh: 她从来不化妆,可是看起来总是干干净净、精精神神的。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái bù huà zhuāng, kě shì kàn qǐ lái zǒng shì gān gān jìng jìng、 jīng jīng shén shén de。
examples.en: She never wears makeup, yet always looks clean and bright.

examples.zh: 我们是几十年的老朋友,他从来没骗过我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men shì jǐ shí nián de lǎo péng yǒu, tā cóng lái méi piàn guò wǒ。
examples.en: We've been friends for decades, and he's never once deceived me.

examples.zh: 他对工作从来一丝不苟,再小的细节也不放过。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōng zuò cóng lái yī sī bù gǒu, zài xiǎo de xì jié yě bù fàng guò。
examples.en: He's always meticulous about work, missing not even the smallest detail.

examples.zh: 我从来没后悔当初的选择,哪怕吃了不少苦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái méi hòu huǐ dāng chū de xuǎn zé, nǎ pà chī le bù shǎo kǔ。
examples.en: I've never regretted my original choice, even though it brought hardship.

examples.zh: 这条河的水一年四季从来没干过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ yī nián sì jì cóng lái méi gàn guò。
examples.en: The water in this river has never dried up in all four seasons.

title: "一起" ile "birlikte"
summary: "一起" (yìqǐ) bir eylemin birlikte yapıldığını gösterir ve fiilden önce gelir: 一起去 = birlikte gitmek.
explanation: "一起" bir eylemin birden çok kişi tarafından BİRLİKTE yapıldığını bildirir ve her zaman fiilin ÖNÜNDE durur: 我们一起吃饭 (Birlikte yemek yiyoruz). Kiminle birlikte olduğunu belirtmek için çoğu zaman "跟/和 ... 一起" kalıbı kullanılır: 我跟朋友一起去 (Arkadaşımla birlikte giderim). "一起" tek başına da "beraberce" anlamı verir ve zarf gibi davranır. Türkçedeki "birlikte, beraber" ile örtüşür. Bir yeri değil, eylemin ortaklaşa yapıldığını vurgular; bu yüzden mutlaka bir fiille birlikte gelir.

examples.zh: 周末我们一起去爬山吧,顺便呼吸一下新鲜空气。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men yì qǐ qù pá shān ba, shùn biàn hū xī yī xià xīn xiān kōng qì。
examples.en: Let's go hiking together this weekend and get some fresh air.

examples.zh: 每年春节,一家人都会围在一起吃年夜饭。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūn jié, yī jiā rén dū huì wéi zài yì qǐ chī nián yè fàn。
examples.en: Every Spring Festival, the whole family gathers to eat New Year's dinner together.

examples.zh: 我跟几个老同学约好一起去看那场演唱会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ gè lǎo tóng xué yuē hǎo yì qǐ qù kàn nà chǎng yǎn chàng huì。
examples.en: I've arranged with some old classmates to go to that concert together.

examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢聚在一起做游戏,笑声传得很远。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men xǐ huān jù zài yì qǐ zuò yóu xì, xiào shēng chuán de hěn yuǎn。
examples.en: The children love gathering to play games; their laughter carries far.

examples.zh: 有困难我们一起面对,你不用一个人扛着。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kùn nán wǒ men yì qǐ miàn duì, nǐ bù yòng yí gè rén káng zhe。
examples.en: Let's face difficulties together; you don't have to bear it alone.

examples.zh: 下课以后,我们一起去食堂吃了顿午饭。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ men yì qǐ qù shí táng chī le dùn wǔ fàn。
examples.en: After class, we went to the canteen for lunch together.

examples.zh: 咱们把这些桌子一起搬到那边去吧,一个人太重了。
examples.pinyin: Zán men bǎ zhè xiē zhuō zi yì qǐ bān dào nà biān qù ba, yí gè rén tài zhòng le。
examples.en: Let's move these tables over there together; it's too heavy for one.

examples.zh: 他们俩从小一起长大,感情比亲兄弟还好。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ cóng xiǎo yì qǐ zhǎng dà, gǎn qíng bǐ qīn xiōng dì hái hǎo。
examples.en: The two grew up together and are closer than real brothers.

examples.zh: 放假的时候,全家人打算一起去南方旅行。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià de shí hòu, quán jiā rén dǎ suàn yì qǐ qù nán fāng lǚ xíng。
examples.en: During the holiday, the whole family plans to travel south together.

examples.zh: 你要是不忙,咱们一起研究一下这个难题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì bù máng, zán men yì qǐ yán jiū yī xià zhè ge nán tí。
examples.en: If you're free, let's study this tough problem together.

examples.zh: 这么好的电影,咱们一起去看多有意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de diàn yǐng, zán men yì qǐ qù kàn duō yǒu yì si。
examples.en: Such a good movie — how fun it would be to watch it together.

examples.zh: 我们几个凑在一起,合买了一份生日礼物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jǐ gè còu zài yì qǐ, hé mǎi le yī fèn shēng rì lǐ wù。
examples.en: A few of us pooled together and jointly bought a birthday gift.

examples.zh: 每天晚饭后,他都要跟老伴一起散散步。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān wǎn fàn hòu, tā dōu yào gēn lǎo bàn yì qǐ sàn sàn bù。
examples.en: Every evening after dinner, he takes a walk with his wife.

examples.zh: 同学们一起动手,很快就把教室打扫干净了。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xué men yì qǐ dòng shǒu, hěn kuài jiù bǎ jiào shì dǎ sǎo gān jìng le。
examples.en: The students worked together and quickly cleaned the classroom.

examples.zh: 我们把各自的想法放在一起讨论,效率高多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ gè zì de xiǎng fǎ fàng zài yì qǐ tǎo lùn, xiào lǜ gāo duō le。
examples.en: We put our ideas together to discuss, which is far more efficient.

examples.zh: 过节的时候,亲戚朋友聚在一起格外热闹。
examples.pinyin: Guò jié de shí hòu, qīn qī péng yǒu jù zài yì qǐ gé wài rè nào。
examples.en: During festivals, relatives and friends gather together, extra lively.

examples.zh: 你带的菜跟我带的正好可以一起分着吃。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài de cài gēn wǒ dài de zhèng hǎo kě yǐ yì qǐ fēn zhe chī。
examples.en: The food you brought and mine can be shared together nicely.

examples.zh: 咱们一起加把劲,争取今天把工作做完。
examples.pinyin: Zán men yì qǐ jiā bǎ jìn, zhēng qǔ jīn tiān bǎ gōng zuò zuò wán。
examples.en: Let's put in more effort together and try to finish the work today.

examples.zh: 孩子和爷爷一起在院子里种了几棵小树。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hé yé yé yì qǐ zài yuàn zi lǐ zhǒng le jǐ kē xiǎo shù。
examples.en: The child planted a few small trees in the yard with grandpa.

examples.zh: 我们一起走过了那么多困难的日子,更懂得珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu guò le nà me duō kùn nán de rì zi, gèng dǒng de zhēn xī。
examples.en: We've been through so many hard days together and cherish it more.

examples.zh: 大家一起唱起了那首熟悉的老歌,眼里都有泪光。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā yì qǐ chàng qǐ le nà shǒu shú xī de lǎo gē, yǎn lǐ dōu yǒu lèi guāng。
examples.en: Everyone sang that familiar old song together, tears in their eyes.

examples.zh: 放学后我常常和朋友一起在操场上打篮球。
examples.pinyin: Fàng xué hòu wǒ cháng cháng hé péng yǒu yì qǐ zài cāo chǎng shàng dǎ lán qiú。
examples.en: After school I often play basketball with friends on the field.

examples.zh: 这件事咱们一起商量商量,总能找到办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zán men yì qǐ shāng liáng shāng liáng, zǒng néng zhǎo dào bàn fǎ。
examples.en: Let's discuss this together; we're sure to find a way.

examples.zh: 过年时,一大家子人挤在一起包饺子,特别温馨。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián shí, yī dà jiā zi rén jǐ zài yì qǐ bāo jiǎo zi, tè bié wēn xīn。
examples.en: At New Year, the whole big family crowds together making dumplings, so cozy.

examples.zh: 我们把行李一起放在门口,准备一会儿出发。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ xíng lǐ yì qǐ fàng zài mén kǒu, zhǔn bèi yī huì er chū fā。
examples.en: We put the luggage together by the door, ready to leave soon.

title: "了" ile süre belirtme
summary: Fiilden sonra "了" ve ardından bir süre gelirse eylemin ne kadar sürdüğü anlatılır: 我学了三年汉语 = Üç yıl Çince öğrendim.
explanation: Bir eylemin NE KADAR sürdüğünü anlatmak için kalıp: Fiil + 了 + süre (+ nesne). 我等了半个小时 (Yarım saat bekledim), 他睡了八个小时 (Sekiz saat uyudu). Nesne varsa süre nesneden ÖNCE gelir ve genelde "的" ile bağlanabilir: 我学了三年(的)汉语 (Üç yıl Çince öğrendim). Bu "了" tamamlanmış, bitmiş bir süreyi bildirir — eylem artık sona ermiştir. Süre bir zaman NOKTASI değil, zaman UZUNLUĞUDUR (三年, 两个小时, 半天). Fiilden sonraki bu konum, süreyi cümlenin başındaki zaman sözcüklerinden (o zaman "ne zaman"ı gösterir) ayırır.

examples.zh: 为了准备这次考试,我复习了整整一个月。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le zhǔn bèi zhè cì kǎo shì, wǒ fù xí le zhěng zhěng yí gè yuè。
examples.en: To prepare for this exam, I reviewed for a whole month.

examples.zh: 他在这家公司工作了十年,对这里很有感情。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le shí nián, duì zhè lǐ hěn yǒu gǎn qíng。
examples.en: He worked at this company for ten years and is attached to it.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上我们聊了三个多小时才依依不舍地告别。
examples.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men liáo le sān gè duō xiǎo shí cái yī yī bù shě de gào bié。
examples.en: Last night we talked for over three hours before reluctantly parting.

examples.zh: 这场大雨下了一天一夜,河水都涨起来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà yǔ xià le yī tiān yī yè, hé shuǐ dōu zhǎng qǐ lái le。
examples.en: This heavy rain fell for a day and a night, and the river rose.

examples.zh: 我在门口等了半个小时,他才慢悠悠地出现。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí, tā cái màn yōu yōu de chū xiàn。
examples.en: I waited at the door for half an hour before he leisurely appeared.

examples.zh: 为了学好这门手艺,他跟着师傅学了整整三年。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le xué hǎo zhè mén shǒu yì, tā gēn zhe shī fù xué le zhěng zhěng sān nián。
examples.en: To master this craft, he studied under his master for a full three years.

examples.zh: 孩子发烧了,妈妈守在床边照顾了他一整夜。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi fā shāo le, mā mā shǒu zài chuáng biān zhào gù le tā yī zhěng yè。
examples.en: The child had a fever, and mom watched over and cared for him all night.

examples.zh: 这本厚厚的小说,我断断续续读了两个星期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn hòu hòu de xiǎo shuō, wǒ duàn duàn xù xù dú le liǎng gè xīng qī。
examples.en: This thick novel took me two weeks of on-and-off reading.

examples.zh: 他们排队买票排了两个小时,腿都站酸了。
examples.pinyin: Tā men pái duì mǎi piào pái le liǎng gè xiǎo shí, tuǐ dōu zhàn suān le。
examples.en: They queued for tickets for two hours until their legs ached.

examples.zh: 我在国外生活了五年,慢慢习惯了那里的一切。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài guó wài shēng huó le wǔ nián, màn màn xí guàn le nà lǐ de yī qiè。
examples.en: I lived abroad for five years and gradually got used to everything there.

examples.zh: 这场比赛打了将近三个小时,双方都拼尽了全力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐ sài dǎ le jiāng jìn sān gè xiǎo shí, shuāng fāng dōu pīn jǐn le quán lì。
examples.en: This match lasted nearly three hours, both sides giving their all.

examples.zh: 为了这个方案,我们讨论了好几天才最终定下来。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le zhè ge fāng àn, wǒ men tǎo lùn le hǎo jǐ tiān cái zuì zhōng dìng xià lái。
examples.en: For this plan, we discussed for several days before finalizing it.

examples.zh: 他盯着那幅画看了很久,好像想起了什么往事。
examples.pinyin: Tā dīng zhe nà fú huà kàn le hěn jiǔ, hǎo xiàng xiǎng qǐ le shén me wǎng shì。
examples.en: He stared at that painting for a long time, as if recalling the past.

examples.zh: 我练了半年的字,总算写得像模像样了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ liàn le bàn nián de zì, zǒng suàn xiě de xiàng mú xiàng yàng le。
examples.en: I practiced writing for half a year and it finally looks decent.

examples.zh: 这台旧机器用了二十年,到现在还能正常运转。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù jī qì yòng le èr shí nián, dào xiàn zài hái néng zhèng cháng yùn zhuàn。
examples.en: This old machine has been used for twenty years and still works fine.

examples.zh: 我们在雪地里走了两个小时,终于看到了灯光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài xuě de lǐ zǒu le liǎng gè xiǎo shí, zhōng yú kàn dào le dēng guāng。
examples.en: We walked in the snow for two hours before finally seeing lights.

examples.zh: 他抱着孩子在屋里来回走了半天,孩子才睡着。
examples.pinyin: Tā bào zhe hái zi zài wū lǐ lái huí zǒu le bàn tiān, hái zi cái shuì zháo。
examples.en: He carried the child pacing the room for a long time before it fell asleep.

examples.zh: 为了赶这份报告,他熬了一个通宵。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le gǎn zhè fèn bào gào, tā áo le yí gè tōng xiāo。
examples.en: To finish this report, he stayed up the whole night.

examples.zh: 这门外语我断断续续学了好几年,现在还能说几句。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén wài yǔ wǒ duàn duàn xù xù xué le hǎo jǐ nián, xiàn zài hái néng shuō jǐ jù。
examples.en: I studied this foreign language on and off for years and can still speak a bit.

examples.zh: 老人在这个村子里住了大半辈子,舍不得离开。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo rén zài zhè ge cūn zi lǐ zhù le dà bàn bèi zi, shě bù de lí kāi。
examples.en: The old man lived in this village most of his life and can't bear to leave.

examples.zh: 我们在海边待了三天,晒得又黑又健康。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài hǎi biān dài le sān tiān, shài de yòu hēi yòu jiàn kāng。
examples.en: We stayed by the sea for three days and got tanned and healthy.

examples.zh: 他一口气跑了十公里,累得连话都说不出来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì kǒu qì pǎo le shí gōng lǐ, lèi de lián huà dōu shuō bù chū lái。
examples.en: He ran ten kilometers in one go, too tired to even speak.

examples.zh: 这件事我想了一整天,还是没想出好办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ xiǎng le yī zhěng tiān, hái shì méi xiǎng chū hǎo bàn fǎ。
examples.en: I thought about this all day but still couldn't come up with a good idea.

examples.zh: 为了见你一面,我坐了十几个小时的火车。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le jiàn nǐ yí miàn, wǒ zuò le shí jǐ gè xiǎo shí de huǒ chē。
examples.en: To see you once, I took a train for over ten hours.

examples.zh: 他们相爱了很多年,最后终于走进了婚姻。
examples.pinyin: Tā men xiāng ài le hěn duō nián, zuì hòu zhōng yú zǒu jìn le hūn yīn。
examples.en: They loved each other for many years and finally married.

title: İki "了" ile süregelen süre
summary: İki "了" (fiilden sonra ve cümle sonunda) eylemin hâlâ SÜRDÜĞÜNÜ ve şimdiye dek ne kadar sürdüğünü bildirir: 我学了三年汉语了 = Üç yıldır Çince öğreniyorum (hâlâ devam).
explanation: Kalıp: Fiil + 了 + süre + 了 — iki "了" birlikte, eylemin geçmişte başlayıp ŞU ANA KADAR SÜRDÜĞÜNÜ ve daha da sürebileceğini bildirir. 我等了一个小时了 (Bir saattir bekliyorum — hâlâ bekliyorum), 他病了三天了 (Üç gündür hasta — hâlâ hasta). Tek "了"lu "我等了一个小时" ise beklemenin BİTTİĞİNİ ima eder; ikinci "了" ise sürecin HÂLÂ devam ettiğini vurgular. Türkçedeki "...-dır/...-dir ...-ıyor" (üç gündür yağıyor) mantığına denk gelir. Bu ince fark HSK2 düzeyinde önemli bir ayrımdır.

examples.zh: 我们已经等了他一个多小时了,他怎么还不来?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ jīng děng le tā yí gè duō xiǎo shí le, tā zěn me hái bù lái?
examples.en: We've been waiting for him over an hour now; why isn't he here yet?

examples.zh: 这场雨下了三天了,到现在还没有要停的意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ xià le sān tiān le, dào xiàn zài hái méi yǒu yào tíng de yì si。
examples.en: It's been raining for three days now, with no sign of stopping.

examples.zh: 他学汉语已经学了两年了,现在能看懂新闻了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué hàn yǔ yǐ jīng xué le liǎng nián le, xiàn zài néng kàn dǒng xīn wén le。
examples.en: He's been learning Chinese for two years now and can read the news.

examples.zh: 我在这家公司干了八年了,早就把这儿当成家了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gàn le bā nián le, zǎo jiù bǎ zhè ér dàng chéng jiā le。
examples.en: I've worked at this company for eight years now and see it as home.

examples.zh: 孩子睡了快十个小时了,估计是这几天太累了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuì le kuài shí gè xiǎo shí le, gū jì shì zhè jǐ tiān tài lèi le。
examples.en: The child has been sleeping nearly ten hours; probably too tired lately.

examples.zh: 我站在这儿等你半天了,你到底去哪儿了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn zài zhè ér děng nǐ bàn tiān le, nǐ dào dǐ qù nǎ ér le?
examples.en: I've been standing here waiting for you for ages; where did you go?

examples.zh: 他们认识都快十年了,感情一直特别好。
examples.pinyin: Tā men rèn shí dōu kuài shí nián le, gǎn qíng yì zhí tè bié hǎo。
examples.en: They've known each other nearly ten years now and remain very close.

examples.zh: 我看这本书已经看了一个星期了,还没看到一半。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhè běn shū yǐ jīng kàn le yí gè xīng qī le, hái méi kàn dào yí bàn。
examples.en: I've been reading this book for a week now and I'm not even halfway.

examples.zh: 这台空调开了一整天了,屋里还是有点儿热。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái kōng tiáo kāi le yī zhěng tiān le, wū lǐ hái shì yǒu diǎn ér rè。
examples.en: The AC has been on all day now, yet the room is still a bit warm.

examples.zh: 我练这首曲子练了一个月了,总算能弹下来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ liàn zhè shǒu qǔ zi liàn le yí gè yuè le, zǒng suàn néng dàn xià lái le。
examples.en: I've been practicing this piece for a month now and can finally play it.

examples.zh: 老人在窗前坐了很久了,一直望着回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo rén zài chuāng qián zuò le hěn jiǔ le, yì zhí wàng zhe huí jiā de lù。
examples.en: The old man has been sitting by the window a long time, watching the road home.

examples.zh: 我减肥都坚持三个月了,可惜效果不太明显。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiǎn féi dōu jiān chí sān gè yuè le, kě xī xiào guǒ bù tài míng xiǎn。
examples.en: I've stuck to my diet for three months now, but sadly the results aren't obvious.

examples.zh: 这件事我想了好几天了,还是拿不定主意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ xiǎng le hǎo jǐ tiān le, hái shì ná bù dìng zhǔ yì。
examples.en: I've been thinking about this for several days now and still can't decide.

examples.zh: 他咳嗽好几天了,你劝他早点去看看医生吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā ké sòu hǎo jǐ tiān le, nǐ quàn tā zǎo diǎn qù kàn kàn yī shēng ba。
examples.en: He's been coughing for days now; urge him to see a doctor soon.

examples.zh: 我们在路上堵了快一个小时了,眼看要迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài lù shàng dǔ le kuài yí gè xiǎo shí le, yǎn kàn yào chí dào le。
examples.en: We've been stuck in traffic nearly an hour now and are about to be late.

examples.zh: 这双鞋我穿了好几年了,舒服得舍不得扔。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié wǒ chuān le hǎo jǐ nián le, shū fú de shě bù de rēng。
examples.en: I've worn these shoes for years now; they're too comfortable to throw away.

examples.zh: 他出国工作已经三年了,一家人都很想念他。
examples.pinyin: Tā chū guó gōng zuò yǐ jīng sān nián le, yī jiā rén dōu hěn xiǎng niàn tā。
examples.en: He's been working abroad for three years now, and the family misses him.

examples.zh: 我在这个城市住了十几年了,对每条街都很熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè ge chéng shì zhù le shí jǐ nián le, duì měi tiáo jiē dōu hěn shú xī。
examples.en: I've lived in this city for over ten years now and know every street.

examples.zh: 孩子看电视都看了两个小时了,该让他歇歇眼睛了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi kàn diàn shì dōu kàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí le, gāi ràng tā xiē xiē yǎn jīng le。
examples.en: The child has watched TV for two hours now; time to rest his eyes.

examples.zh: 这个问题我们讨论半天了,还是没有一致的结论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí wǒ men tǎo lùn bàn tiān le, hái shì méi yǒu yí zhì de jié lùn。
examples.en: We've been discussing this for a long while now with no consensus.

examples.zh: 他等这个机会等了很多年了,这次一定不会放过。
examples.pinyin: Tā děng zhè ge jī huì děng le hěn duō nián le, zhè cì yí dìng bú huì fàng guò。
examples.en: He's waited many years for this chance and won't let it slip this time.

examples.zh: 我盼这一天盼了好久了,今天终于实现了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pàn zhè yī tiān pàn le hǎo jiǔ le, jīn tiān zhōng yú shí xiàn le。
examples.en: I've longed for this day for so long, and today it's finally come true.

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑用了七八年了,速度越来越慢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù diàn nǎo yòng le qī bā nián le, sù dù yuè lái yuè màn。
examples.en: This old computer has been used for seven or eight years now and keeps slowing.

examples.zh: 雪已经下了一夜了,外面积了厚厚的一层。
examples.pinyin: Xuě yǐ jīng xià le yī yè le, wài miàn jī le hòu hòu de yī céng。
examples.en: It's been snowing all night now, and a thick layer has piled up outside.

examples.zh: 我们排队都排了一个多小时了,前面还有好多人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men pái duì dōu pái le yí gè duō xiǎo shí le, qián miàn hái yǒu hǎo duō rén。
examples.en: We've been queuing over an hour now, with many people still ahead.

title: "没办法" ile çaresizlik
summary: "没办法" (méi bànfǎ) "çaresi yok, elden bir şey gelmez, ...-amıyorum" anlamı verir: 我没办法帮你 = Sana yardım edemem (elimden gelmez).
explanation: "没办法" kelimesi kelimesine "yöntem/çare yok" demektir ve bir şeyi yapmanın MÜMKÜN olmadığını, çaresizliği bildirir. İki biçimde kullanılır: (1) tek başına, "elden bir şey gelmez, ne yapalım" — 没办法,只能这样了 (Çare yok, ancak böyle olur). (2) "没办法 + fiil" biçiminde "...-amıyorum, ...-mak elimde değil" — 我没办法帮你 (Sana yardım edemiyorum). Çoğu zaman dış koşulların engellediği bir durumu, isteksizlikten değil imkânsızlıktan doğan bir kabullenişi anlatır. Türkçedeki "çaresi yok, elimden gelmiyor, mecbur" tonlarını taşır.

examples.zh: 外面堵车堵得厉害,我实在没办法准时赶到。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn dǔ chē dǔ de lì hài, wǒ shí zài méi bàn fǎ zhǔn shí gǎn dào。
examples.en: The traffic is terrible; I really can't get there on time.

examples.zh: 他的脾气就是那样,我们也没办法改变他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pí qì jiù shì nà yàng, wǒ men yě méi bàn fǎ gǎi biàn tā。
examples.en: That's just his temper; there's nothing we can do to change him.

examples.zh: 对不起,这件事超出了我的能力,我没办法帮你。
examples.pinyin: Duì bù qǐ, zhè jiàn shì chāo chū le wǒ de néng lì, wǒ méi bàn fǎ bāng nǐ。
examples.en: Sorry, this is beyond me; I can't help you with it.

examples.zh: 钱不够,又没办法借到,他只好放弃了那个计划。
examples.pinyin: Qián bù gòu, yòu méi bàn fǎ jiè dào, tā zhǐ hǎo fàng qì le nà ge jì huà。
examples.en: Short of money and unable to borrow, he had no choice but to drop the plan.

examples.zh: 孩子一直哭,我们怎么哄都没办法让他安静下来。

examples.zh: 下这么大的雪,飞机没办法起飞,只能改签了。

examples.zh: 他不肯听劝,我们也没办法,只好由着他去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù kěn tīng quàn, wǒ men yě méi bàn fǎ, zhǐ hǎo yóu zhe tā qù le。
examples.en: He won't listen to advice; we can do nothing but let him be.

examples.zh: 我试了很多次,还是没办法打开这个盖子。

examples.en: I tried many times but still can't open this lid.

examples.zh: 时间太紧了,我没办法把每个细节都检查一遍。

examples.en: Time is too tight; I can't check every detail.

examples.zh: 既然事情已经这样了,着急也没办法,慢慢来吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán shì qíng yǐ jīng zhè yàng le, zháo jí yě méi bàn fǎ, màn màn lái ba。
examples.en: Since it's come to this, worrying won't help; let's take it slow.

examples.zh: 他住得太远,平时没办法经常回来看父母。

examples.zh: 孩子太小,一个人在家没办法照顾自己。

examples.en: The child is too young to look after himself alone at home.

examples.zh: 票已经卖光了,我们没办法,只能等下一场了。

examples.en: Tickets are sold out; we have no choice but to wait for the next show.

examples.zh: 他伤了腿,这段时间没办法参加训练了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shāng le tuǐ, zhè duàn shí jiān méi bàn fǎ cān jiā xùn liàn le。
examples.en: He hurt his leg and can't join training for a while.

examples.zh: 我普通话说得不好,没办法把这件事解释清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pǔ tōng huà shuō de bù hǎo, méi bàn fǎ bǎ zhè jiàn shì jiě shì qīng chǔ。
examples.en: My Mandarin isn't good; I can't explain this clearly.

examples.zh: 规定就是规定,我们做工作人员的也没办法。
examples.pinyin: Guī dìng jiù shì guī dìng, wǒ men zuò gōng zuò rén yuán de yě méi bàn fǎ。

examples.zh: 信号太差,我在山里没办法给家里打电话。
examples.pinyin: Xìn hào tài chà, wǒ zài shān lǐ méi bàn fǎ gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà。
examples.en: The signal is too weak; in the mountains I can't call home.

examples.zh: 他认准了的事,谁说都没办法让他回头。
examples.pinyin: Tā rèn zhǔn le de shì, shuí shuō dōu méi bàn fǎ ràng tā huí tóu。
examples.en: Once he's set on something, no one can make him reconsider.

examples.zh: 材料还没准备好,今天没办法把手续办完。
examples.pinyin: Cái liào hái méi zhǔn bèi hǎo, jīn tiān méi bàn fǎ bǎ shǒu xù bàn wán。
examples.en: The documents aren't ready; the procedure can't be completed today.

examples.zh: 我实在困得不行了,没办法再熬下去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shí zài kùn de bù xíng le, méi bàn fǎ zài áo xià qù le。
examples.en: I'm so sleepy I really can't stay up any longer.

examples.zh: 他们的要求太高,我们没办法完全满足。
examples.pinyin: Tā men de yāo qiú tài gāo, wǒ men méi bàn fǎ wán quán mǎn zú。
examples.en: Their demands are too high; we can't fully meet them.

examples.zh: 没办法,谁让咱们答应了人家呢,再累也得做完。
examples.pinyin: Méi bàn fǎ, shuí ràng zán men dā yìng le rén jiā ne, zài lèi yě de zuò wán。
examples.en: No choice — we did promise them, so tired or not, we must finish.

title: Fiilden önce "在" ile yer belirtme
summary: "在 + yer" fiilden ÖNCE gelip eylemin nerede yapıldığını gösterir: 我在家看书 = Evde kitap okuyorum.
explanation: Bir eylemin NEREDE yapıldığını belirtmek için "在 + yer" öbeği FİİLDEN ÖNCE gelir: Özne + 在 + yer + fiil. 我在图书馆学习 (Kütüphanede çalışıyorum), 他们在公园散步 (Parkta yürüyorlar). Türkçenin aksine yer bildiren öbek fiilden ÖNCEDEDİR, sonrasında değil. "在" burada bir edattır ("...-de/da"). Bunu "在"nın süreklilik bildiren kullanımından (在 + fiil = ...-mekte, bkz. 正在) ayırmak gerekir: burada "在"dan sonra bir YER gelir, fiil değil. Bazı fiiller (住, 放, 坐, 站, 挂 gibi) "在"yı fiilden SONRA da alabilir (bkz. ayrı konu), ama genel eylem yeri için "在" fiilden öncedir.

examples.zh: 我平时喜欢在家做饭,觉得比在外面吃干净。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píng shí xǐ huān zài jiā zuò fàn, jué de bǐ zài wài miàn chī gān jìng。

examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zài dì tiě shàng kàn huì er shū, chōng fèn lì yòng shí jiān。
examples.en: He reads a bit on the subway every day, making full use of the time.

examples.zh: 我们在那家咖啡馆聊了一个下午的天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài nà jiā kā fēi guǎn liáo le yí gè xià wǔ de tiān。
examples.en: We chatted the whole afternoon at that café.

examples.zh: 奶奶最喜欢在院子里晒太阳、和邻居说话。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi zuì xǐ huān zài yuàn zi lǐ shài tài yáng、 hé lín jū shuō huà。
examples.en: Grandma loves basking in the sun and chatting with neighbors in the yard.

examples.zh: 他在办公室加班到很晚,常常错过末班车。

examples.zh: 孩子在房间里写作业,你们说话小声一点。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zài fáng jiān lǐ xiě zuò yè, nǐ men shuō huà xiǎo shēng yì diǎn。

examples.zh: 我们在山顶上看了一场特别美的日出。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài shān dǐng shàng kàn le yī cháng tè bié měi de rì chū。
examples.en: We watched a beautiful sunrise from the mountaintop.

examples.zh: 周末我常常在公园里跑步,呼吸新鲜空气。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ cháng cháng zài gōng yuán lǐ pǎo bù, hū xī xīn xiān kōng qì。
examples.en: On weekends I often run in the park and breathe fresh air.

examples.zh: 他在厨房里忙了半天,做了一大桌子菜。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chú fáng lǐ máng le bàn tiān, zuò le yī dà zhuō zi cài。
examples.en: He busied himself in the kitchen and made a whole table of dishes.

examples.zh: 我们一家人喜欢在客厅里一起看电视、聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yī jiā rén xǐ huān zài kè tīng lǐ yì qǐ kàn diàn shì、 liáo tiān。
examples.en: Our family likes watching TV and chatting together in the living room.

examples.zh: 学生们在教室里安安静静地听老师讲课。
examples.pinyin: Xué shēng men zài jiào shì lǐ ān ān jìng jìng de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè。
examples.en: The students listen quietly to the teacher in the classroom.

examples.zh: 他在河边钓了一下午的鱼,收获还不小。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hé biān diào le yī xià wǔ de yú, shōu huò hái bù xiǎo。
examples.en: He fished by the river all afternoon with a decent catch.

examples.zh: 我在超市遇到了一位好久不见的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chāo shì yù dào le yī wèi hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn de lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: I ran into an old friend I hadn't seen in ages at the supermarket.

examples.zh: 孩子们在草地上追来追去,玩得满头大汗。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men zài cǎo dì shàng zhuī lái zhuī qù, wán de mǎn tóu dà hán。
examples.en: The children chased each other on the grass, playing until sweaty.

examples.zh: 他习惯在睡觉前在阳台上站一会儿,看看星星。
examples.pinyin: Tā xí guàn zài shuì jiào qián zài yáng tái shàng zhàn yī huì er, kàn kàn xīng xīng。
examples.en: He likes standing on the balcony before bed to look at the stars.

examples.zh: 我们在图书馆一直待到关门才离开。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài tú shū guǎn yì zhí dài dào guān mén cái lí kāi。
examples.en: We stayed in the library until closing before leaving.

examples.zh: 妈妈在灯下缝补衣服,一坐就是大半夜。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zài dēng xià féng bǔ yī fú, yī zuò jiù shì dà bàn yè。
examples.en: Mom mends clothes under the lamp, sitting for half the night.

examples.zh: 他每天在同一个路口等车,已经等了好多年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zài tóng yī gè lù kǒu děng chē, yǐ jīng děng le hǎo duō nián le。
examples.en: He waits for the bus at the same corner every day, for many years now.

examples.zh: 我们在海边的沙滩上捡了很多漂亮的贝壳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài hǎi biān de shā tān shàng jiǎn le hěn duō piào liàng de bèi ké。
examples.en: We collected many pretty shells on the beach by the sea.

examples.zh: 他喜欢在安静的夜里写作,灵感总是特别多。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐ huān zài ān jìng de yè lǐ xiě zuò, líng gǎn zǒng shì tè bié duō。
examples.en: He likes writing in the quiet night; inspiration always flows.

examples.zh: 孩子在爷爷的书房里发现了很多有趣的老照片。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zài yé yé de shū fáng lǐ fā xiàn le hěn duō yǒu qù de lǎo zhào piān。
examples.en: The child found many interesting old photos in grandpa's study.

examples.zh: 我们在火车上认识,没想到成了一辈子的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài huǒ chē shàng rèn shí, méi xiǎng dào chéng le yī bèi zi de péng yǒu。
examples.en: We met on the train and unexpectedly became lifelong friends.

examples.zh: 他在工厂里工作了大半辈子,对机器了如指掌。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōng chǎng lǐ gōng zuò le dà bàn bèi zi, duì jī qì liǎo rú zhǐ zhǎng。
examples.en: He worked in the factory most of his life and knows the machines inside out.

examples.zh: 大家在会议室里争论了很久,最后达成了一致。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā zài huì yì shì lǐ zhēng lùn le hěn jiǔ, zuì hòu dá chéng le yí zhì。
examples.en: Everyone argued in the meeting room for a long time and finally agreed.

title: Fiil ikilemesi (yumuşatma)
summary: Bir fiili ikileyerek eylemi kısaltıp yumuşatırsınız: "biraz ...-mek, bir ...-ıvermek": 看看 = bir bakmak; 休息休息 = biraz dinlenmek.
explanation: Bir fiili tekrarlamak (ikilemek), eylemi KISA, HAFİF ve RAHAT gösterir: "biraz, bir kerecik, şöyle bir" anlamı katar ve tonu yumuşatır. Tek heceli fiiller: 看看 / 看一看 (bir bakmak), 试试 (bir denemek). İki heceli fiiller: 休息休息 (biraz dinlenmek), 商量商量 (biraz görüşmek) — ABAB biçiminde. Arasına "一" ya da geçmişte "了" girebilir: 看了看 (şöyle bir baktı). Türkçedeki "...-ıver, bir ...-sene, şöyle bir ..." tonlarına yakındır. İstek ve önerileri kibarlaştırır: 你尝尝 (bir tatsana), 咱们聊聊 (biraz sohbet edelim). İkilenen fiil çoğu zaman gündelik, samimi konuşmada geçer.

examples.zh: 这件衣服你先试试,合适的话再买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú nǐ xiān shì shì, hé shì de huà zài mǎi。
examples.en: Try this on first; buy it if it fits.

examples.zh: 你脸色不太好,坐下来休息休息吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ liǎn sè bù tài hǎo, zuò xià lái xiū xī xiū xī ba。
examples.en: You don't look well; sit down and rest a bit.

examples.zh: 这道菜是我新学的,你尝尝味道怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì wǒ xīn xué de, nǐ cháng cháng wèi dào zěn me yàng。
examples.en: I just learned this dish; taste it and see how it is.

examples.zh: 这件事咱们再商量商量,别急着做决定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zán men zài shāng liáng shāng liáng, bié jí zhe zuò jué dìng。
examples.en: Let's discuss this a bit more; don't rush the decision.

examples.zh: 有空的时候,我喜欢在公园里走走、看看风景。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kòng de shí hòu, wǒ xǐ huān zài gōng yuán lǐ zǒu zǒu、 kàn kàn fēng jǐng。
examples.en: When free, I like strolling in the park and taking in the scenery.

examples.zh: 你把你的想法跟大家说说,听听别人的意见。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ nǐ de xiǎng fǎ gēn dà jiā shuō shuō, tīng tīng bié rén de yì jiàn。
examples.en: Share your ideas with everyone and hear others' opinions.

examples.zh: 他拿起那封信看了看,脸上露出了微笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ nà fēng xìn kàn le kàn, liǎn shàng lù chū le wēi xiào。
examples.en: He picked up the letter, glanced at it, and smiled.

examples.zh: 周末在家没事,我就收拾收拾房间,洗洗衣服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò zài jiā méi shì, wǒ jiù shōu shí shōu shí fáng jiān, xǐ xǐ yī fú。
examples.en: With nothing to do at home on weekends, I tidy the room and do laundry.

examples.zh: 你别总坐着,起来活动活动筋骨。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zǒng zuò zhe, qǐ lái huó dòng huó dòng jīn gǔ。
examples.en: Don't just sit; get up and move your body a bit.

examples.zh: 这个问题我也不太懂,咱们一起研究研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí wǒ yě bù tài dǒng, zán men yì qǐ yán jiū yán jiū。
examples.en: I don't quite get this problem either; let's look into it together.

examples.zh: 他想了想,还是决定把真相告诉父母。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng le xiǎng, hái shì jué dìng bǎ zhēn xiàng gào sù fù mǔ。
examples.en: He thought for a moment and decided to tell his parents the truth.

examples.zh: 累了就闭上眼睛歇歇,别硬撑着。
examples.pinyin: Lèi le jiù bì shàng yǎn jīng xiē xiē, bié yìng chēng zhe。
examples.en: If you're tired, close your eyes and rest; don't force it.

examples.zh: 你把这几个方案比较比较,选一个最好的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zhè jǐ gè fāng àn bǐ jiào bǐ jiào, xuǎn yí gè zuì hǎo de。
examples.en: Compare these plans and pick the best one.

examples.zh: 孩子,过来让奶奶好好看看,又长高了不少。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi, guò lái ràng nǎi nǎi hǎo hǎo kàn kàn, yòu zhǎng gāo le bù shǎo。
examples.en: Come here, child, let grandma take a good look — you've grown taller.

examples.zh: 周末我们去郊外转转,散散心,别老闷在家里。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men qù jiāo wài zhuǎn zhuǎn, sàn sàn xīn, bié lǎo mēn zài jiā lǐ。
examples.en: Let's go to the countryside this weekend to unwind, not stay cooped up.

examples.zh: 这段话你多读读,慢慢就能背下来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn huà nǐ duō dú dú, màn màn jiù néng bèi xià lái le。
examples.en: Read this passage a few more times and you'll gradually memorize it.

examples.zh: 他低头闻了闻杯子里的茶,满意地点了点头。
examples.pinyin: Tā dī tóu wén le wén bēi zi lǐ de chá, mǎn yì dì diǎn le diǎn tóu。
examples.en: He lowered his head, smelled the tea, and nodded with satisfaction.

examples.zh: 你先冷静冷静,别在气头上做决定。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān lěng jìng lěng jìng, bié zài qì tóu shàng zuò jué dìng。
examples.en: Calm down first; don't decide while you're angry.

examples.zh: 有什么心事就跟我聊聊,别一个人憋着。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me xīn shì jiù gēn wǒ liáo liáo, bié yí gè rén biē zhe。
examples.en: If something's on your mind, talk to me; don't bottle it up.

examples.zh: 这些照片你拿去看看,都是那年旅行拍的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān nǐ ná qù kàn kàn, dōu shì nà nián lǚ xíng pāi de。
examples.en: Take these photos and have a look; they're all from that year's trip.

examples.zh: 妈妈尝了尝汤,又加了一点点盐。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā cháng le cháng tāng, yòu jiā le yì diǎn diǎn yán。
examples.en: Mom tasted the soup and added a tiny bit more salt.

examples.zh: 你去问问老师,这道题到底该怎么做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù wèn wèn lǎo shī, zhè dào tí dào dǐ gāi zěn me zuò。
examples.en: Go ask the teacher exactly how this problem should be done.

examples.zh: 下班以后,他喜欢弹弹吉他放松一下。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān yǐ hòu, tā xǐ huān dàn dàn jí tā fàng sōng yī xià。
examples.en: After work he likes to strum the guitar to relax.

examples.zh: 这件事你考虑考虑,想好了再答复我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ, xiǎng hǎo le zài dá fù wǒ。
examples.en: Think this over; reply to me once you've decided.

examples.zh: 咱们出去散散步吧,顺便消化消化。
examples.pinyin: Zán men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba, shùn biàn xiāo huà xiāo huà。
examples.en: Let's go for a walk and help our food digest.

title: Fiilden sonra "在" ile konum
summary: Bazı fiiller "在 + yer"i SONRA alır ve eylem sonunda nesnenin nerede DURDUĞUNU gösterir: 放在桌子上 = masanın üstüne koymak.
explanation: Genel eylem yeri "在"yı fiilden ÖNCE alır (在家看书), ama bazı fiiller — özellikle bir şeyi bir yere KONUMLANDIRAN 放 (koymak), 坐 (oturmak), 站 (durmak), 躺 (uzanmak), 挂 (asmak), 住 (oturmak/kalmak), 写 (yazmak) gibi — "在 + yer"i fiilden SONRA alır: 把书放在桌子上 (Kitabı masaya koy), 他坐在椅子上 (Sandalyeye oturdu), 名字写在纸上 (İsmi kâğıda yaz). Buradaki "在 + yer" eylemin SONUÇTA nesneyi nereye yerleştirdiğini/sabitlediğini gösterir (bir yerleşme/varış sonucu). Kısaca: eylem bir konum SONUCU doğuruyorsa "在" fiilden sonra gelir.

examples.zh: 请把钥匙放在门口的柜子上,别弄丢了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yào shi fàng zài mén kǒu de guì zi shàng, bié nòng diū le。
examples.en: Please put the keys on the cabinet by the door; don't lose them.

examples.zh: 他累得一回家就躺在沙发上睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lèi de yī huí jiā jiù tǎng zài shā fā shàng shuì zháo le。
examples.en: He was so tired he lay on the sofa and fell asleep as soon as he got home.

examples.zh: 孩子把画好的画挂在了自己房间的墙上。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bǎ huà hǎo de huà guà zài le zì jǐ fáng jiān de qiáng shàng。
examples.en: The child hung the finished painting on his bedroom wall.

examples.zh: 你先坐在这儿等一会儿,我去叫经理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zuò zài zhè ér děng yī huì er, wǒ qù jiào jīng lǐ。
examples.en: Sit here and wait a moment; I'll go get the manager.

examples.zh: 我们全家现在都住在城市东边的一个小区里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men quán jiā xiàn zài dōu zhù zài chéng shì dōng biān de yí gè xiǎo qū lǐ。
examples.en: Our whole family now lives in a neighborhood on the east side of the city.

examples.zh: 请把您的名字和电话写在这张表格上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nín de míng zì hé diàn huà xiě zài zhè zhāng biǎo gé shàng。
examples.en: Please write your name and phone number on this form.

examples.zh: 他把车停在了楼下的停车场,走上来的。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ chē tíng zài le lóu xià de tíng chē chǎng, zǒu shàng lái de。
examples.en: He parked the car in the lot downstairs and walked up.

examples.zh: 那本书一直放在书架的最上面,我够不着。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū yì zhí fàng zài shū jià de zuì shàng miàn, wǒ gòu bù zhe。
examples.en: That book has been on the top of the shelf; I can't reach it.

examples.zh: 老人靠在窗边,静静地望着外面的风景。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo rén kào zài chuāng biān, jìng jìng de wàng zhe wài miàn de fēng jǐng。
examples.en: The old man leaned by the window, quietly gazing at the view outside.

examples.zh: 妈妈把刚洗好的衣服晾在了阳台上。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā bǎ gāng xǐ hǎo de yī fú liàng zài le yáng tái shàng。
examples.en: Mom hung the freshly washed clothes on the balcony.

examples.zh: 你别把手机放在床上,睡觉的时候容易压坏。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài chuáng shàng, shuì jiào de shí hòu róng yì yā huài。
examples.en: Don't put your phone on the bed; it's easily crushed while you sleep.

examples.zh: 会议的时间和地点都写在通知的最后。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì de shí jiān hé dì diǎn dōu xiě zài tōng zhī de zuì hòu。
examples.en: The meeting's time and place are written at the end of the notice.

examples.zh: 小猫喜欢趴在暖和的地方,一睡就是一下午。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo māo xǐ huān pā zài nuǎn huo de dì fāng, yī shuì jiù shì yī xià wǔ。
examples.en: The kitten likes lying in warm spots, sleeping for whole afternoons.

examples.zh: 请大家把垃圾扔在指定的垃圾桶里。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā bǎ lā jī rēng zài zhǐ dìng de lā jī tǒng lǐ。
examples.en: Please throw trash in the designated bins.

examples.zh: 他把重要的文件锁在了抽屉里,谁也拿不到。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhòng yào de wén jiàn suǒ zài le chōu tì lǐ, shuí yě ná bú dào。
examples.en: He locked the important documents in the drawer; no one can get them.

examples.zh: 客人的外套挂在门后的衣架上呢。
examples.pinyin: Kè rén de wài tào guà zài mén hòu de yī jià shàng ne。
examples.en: The guest's coat is hanging on the rack behind the door.

examples.zh: 我习惯把当天要做的事记在本子上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xí guàn bǎ dàng tiān yào zuò de shì jì zài běn zi shàng。
examples.en: I'm used to writing the day's tasks in a notebook.

examples.zh: 他站在讲台上,认真地给学生们讲课。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài jiǎng tái shàng, rèn zhēn de gěi xué shēng men jiǎng kè。
examples.en: He stood at the podium, earnestly lecturing the students.

examples.zh: 这幅全家福一直摆在客厅最显眼的位置。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú quán jiā fú yì zhí bǎi zài kè tīng zuì xiǎn yǎn de wèi zhì。
examples.en: This family photo has always sat in the most prominent spot in the living room.

examples.zh: 你把水杯放在桌子边上,很容易碰倒。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shuǐ bēi fàng zài zhuō zi biān shàng, hěn róng yì pèng dào。
examples.en: You put the cup at the edge of the table; it's easy to knock over.

examples.zh: 孩子把小秘密藏在了只有自己知道的地方。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bǎ xiǎo mì mì cáng zài le zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ zhī dào de dì fāng。
examples.en: The child hid the little secret in a place only he knows.

examples.zh: 那张照片被他小心地夹在了书的中间。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhāng zhào piān bèi tā xiǎo xīn de jiā zài le shū de zhōng jiān。
examples.en: He carefully tucked that photo in the middle of the book.

examples.zh: 请把您的行李放在座位上方的行李架上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nín de xíng lǐ fàng zài zuò wèi shàng fāng de xíng lǐ jià shàng。
examples.en: Please put your luggage on the rack above the seats.

examples.zh: 他每天把自行车停在楼道口,方便早上出门。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài lóu dào kǒu, fāng biàn zǎo shàng chū mén。
examples.en: He parks his bike at the corridor entrance daily for easy morning departures.

examples.zh: 奶奶总是把糖果藏在柜子里,留给来做客的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi zǒng shì bǎ táng guǒ cáng zài guì zi lǐ, liú gěi lái zuò kè de hái zi。
examples.en: Grandma always keeps candy in the cupboard for visiting children.

title: "很" ile duygu/istek fiilleri
pattern: 很 + Fiil (很喜欢 / 很想 / 很了解)
summary: "很" normalde sıfatları güçlendirir, ama bazı duygu/istek fiillerinin de önüne gelir: 很喜欢 = çok sevmek; 很想 = çok istemek.
explanation: "很" (çok) genelde sıfatları derecelendirir (很高, 很好), ama bir grup DUYGU, İSTEK ve ZİHİN fiilinin önünde de kullanılır çünkü bu fiiller derece bildirebilir: 很喜欢 (çok sevmek), 很想 (çok istemek/özlemek), 很爱 (çok sevmek), 很了解 (çok iyi tanımak/anlamak), 很希望 (çok ummak), 很担心 (çok endişelenmek), 很相信 (çok güvenmek). Sıradan eylem fiilleri (吃, 走, 买) "很" ile KULLANILMAZ (很吃 yanlış). Yalnızca duygu/tutum/istek bildiren fiiller "很" alır. Bu, Türkçedeki "çok seviyorum, çok istiyorum" mantığına denk gelir ve öznenin hislerinin derecesini gösterir.

examples.zh: 我很喜欢这座安静的小城,住得特别舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè zuò ān jìng de xiǎo chéng, zhù de tè bié shū fú。
examples.en: I really like this quiet little town; living here is very comfortable.

examples.zh: 离家这么久,他很想念父母和家乡的味道。
examples.pinyin: Lí jiā zhè me jiǔ, tā hěn xiǎng niàn fù mǔ hé jiā xiāng de wèi dào。
examples.en: Away from home so long, he deeply misses his parents and hometown flavors.

examples.zh: 我们都很担心他一个人在外面过得好不好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dōu hěn dān xīn tā yí gè rén zài wài miàn guò de hǎo bù hǎo。
examples.en: We're all very worried about how he's doing on his own out there.

examples.zh: 这些年相处下来,我很了解他的脾气和习惯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián xiāng chǔ xià lái, wǒ hěn liǎo jiě tā de pí qì hé xí guàn。
examples.en: After years together, I know his temper and habits well.

examples.zh: 孩子很希望爸爸能抽空来参加他的运动会。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hěn xī wàng bà bà néng chōu kòng lái cān jiā tā de yùn dòng huì。
examples.en: The child really hopes dad can find time to attend his sports day.

examples.zh: 她很爱笑,走到哪儿都能带来好心情。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn ài xiào, zǒu dào nǎ ér dōu néng dài lái hǎo xīn qíng。
examples.en: She loves to smile and brings good cheer wherever she goes.

examples.zh: 我很相信你的能力,这件事就交给你了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiāng xìn nǐ de néng lì, zhè jiàn shì jiù jiāo gěi nǐ le。
examples.en: I really trust your ability; I'll leave this to you.

examples.zh: 听到这个好消息,大家都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī, dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng。
examples.en: Hearing this good news, everyone was very happy.

examples.zh: 他很在乎别人的看法,常常为此睡不好觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zài hū bié rén de kàn fǎ, cháng cháng wèi cǐ shuì bù hǎo jué。
examples.en: He cares a lot about others' opinions, often losing sleep over it.

examples.zh: 我很感谢这些年一直支持我的家人和朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gǎn xiè zhè xiē nián yì zhí zhī chí wǒ de jiā rén hé péng yǒu。
examples.en: I'm very grateful to the family and friends who've supported me all these years.

examples.zh: 对于这次的安排,我个人很满意。
examples.pinyin: Duì yú zhè cì de ān pái, wǒ gè rén hěn mǎn yì。
examples.en: Personally, I'm very satisfied with this arrangement.

examples.zh: 他很讨厌别人打断自己说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn tǎo yàn bié rén dǎ duàn zì jǐ shuō huà。
examples.en: He really dislikes being interrupted when speaking.

examples.zh: 我很期待周末的这次聚会,好久没见老朋友了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn qī dài zhōu mò de zhè cì jù huì, hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn lǎo péng yǒu le。
examples.en: I'm really looking forward to this weekend's gathering; I haven't seen old friends in ages.

examples.zh: 父母很理解我的选择,一直默默地支持我。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ hěn lǐ jiě wǒ de xuǎn zé, yì zhí mò mò de zhī chí wǒ。
examples.en: My parents understand my choice well and quietly support me.

examples.zh: 这么多年过去,我依然很怀念学生时代的日子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián guò qù, wǒ yī rán hěn huái niàn xué shēng shí dài de rì zi。
examples.en: After all these years, I still fondly miss my student days.

examples.zh: 大家都很佩服他面对困难时的那份冷静。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu hěn pèi fú tā miàn duì kùn nán shí de nà fèn lěng jìng。
examples.en: Everyone admires the calmness he shows in the face of difficulties.

examples.zh: 我很欣赏那些踏踏实实做事的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīn shǎng nà xiē tà tà shí shí zuò shì de rén。
examples.en: I really appreciate people who work in a down-to-earth way.

examples.zh: 孩子很信任老师,有什么话都愿意跟老师说。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hěn xìn rèn lǎo shī, yǒu shén me huà dōu yuàn yì gēn lǎo shī shuō。
examples.en: The child trusts the teacher and shares everything with him.

examples.zh: 我很关心你最近的身体状况,一定要按时吃药。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn guān xīn nǐ zuì jìn de shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng, yí dìng yào àn shí chī yào。
examples.en: I care a lot about your health lately; be sure to take your medicine on time.

examples.zh: 他对家乡的变化感到很惊讶,几乎认不出来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì jiā xiāng de biàn huà gǎn dào hěn jīng yà, jī hū rèn bù chū lái le。
examples.en: He was very surprised at his hometown's changes; he could barely recognize it.

examples.zh: 我们很尊重每个人的想法,不会强迫任何人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men hěn zūn zhòng měi gè rén de xiǎng fǎ, bú huì qiǎng pò rèn hé rén。
examples.en: We deeply respect everyone's ideas and won't force anyone.

examples.zh: 看到孩子这么懂事,当妈妈的心里很安慰。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào hái zi zhè me dǒng shì, dāng mā mā de xīn lǐ hěn ān wèi。
examples.en: Seeing the child so sensible, the mother feels much comforted.

examples.zh: 我很想去看看外面的世界,可是又舍不得家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn kàn wài miàn de shì jiè, kě shì yòu shě bù de jiā。
examples.en: I really want to see the world outside, yet I can't bear to leave home.

examples.zh: 他很羡慕那些能自由支配时间的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xiàn mù nà xiē néng zì yóu zhī pèi shí jiān de rén。
examples.en: He really envies people who can freely manage their own time.

examples.zh: 这次比赛虽然输了,但我们很享受这个过程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐ sài suī rán shū le, dàn wǒ men hěn xiǎng shòu zhè ge guò chéng。
examples.en: Though we lost this match, we really enjoyed the process.

title: "到" ile "...-e varmak / gitmek"
summary: "到" (dào) bir yere ulaşmayı/gitmeyi gösterir: 到北京 = Pekin'e (varmak/gitmek); 到学校去 = okula gitmek.
explanation: "到" bir hedefe VARMAYI/ulaşmayı bildiren bir fiildir: 我到家了 (Eve vardım), 火车到站了 (Tren istasyona geldi). Bir yere GİTMEYİ anlatmak için sık sık "到 + yer + 去/来" kalıbı kurulur: 我要到北京去 (Pekin'e gideceğim), 到这儿来 (buraya gel). "到" ayrıca başka fiillerin ardına gelip "ulaşma/başarma" sonucunu gösteren bir tümleç olur (bkz. 结果补语): 找到 (bulmak), 看到 (görmek), 买到 (satın alabilmek). Bu konuda özellikle "到 + yer" (bir yere varmak/gitmek) kullanımını ele alıyoruz. Ayrıca zamanda bir noktaya kadar sürmeyi de anlatır: 从早到晚 (sabahtan akşama).

examples.zh: 我们到火车站的时候,车刚好进站。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dào huǒ chē zhàn de shí hòu, chē gāng hǎo jìn zhàn。
examples.en: Just as we reached the station, the train pulled in.

examples.zh: 你到家以后给我发个消息,我好放心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào jiā yǐ hòu gěi wǒ fā gè xiāo xī, wǒ hǎo fàng xīn。
examples.en: Message me once you're home so I can relax.

examples.zh: 明天我要到城里去办点事,可能回来得晚。
examples.pinyin: Míng tiān wǒ yào dào chéng lǐ qù bàn diǎn shì, kě néng huí lái de wǎn。
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm going into the city on some errands; I may be back late.

examples.zh: 这趟车到上海一共要停八个站。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tàng chē dào shàng hǎi yī gòng yào tíng bā gè zhàn。
examples.en: This train makes a total of eight stops before Shanghai.

examples.zh: 孩子第一次自己坐车到外婆家,大家都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dì yī cì zì jǐ zuò chē dào wài pó jiā, dà jiā dōu hěn dān xīn。
examples.en: The child took the bus to grandma's alone for the first time; everyone worried.

examples.zh: 你到了机场先别急,我会去接你的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào le jī chǎng xiān bié jí, wǒ huì qù jiē nǐ de。
examples.en: Once you reach the airport, don't rush; I'll come pick you up.

examples.zh: 我们走了很久,天黑了才到山下的村子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu le hěn jiǔ, tiān hēi le cái dào shān xià de cūn zi。
examples.en: We walked a long time and reached the village at the foot only after dark.

examples.zh: 每天早上八点,他准时到公司,从不迟到。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shàng bā diǎn, tā zhǔn shí dào gōng sī, cóng bù chí dào。
examples.en: Every morning at eight sharp he arrives at the office, never late.

examples.zh: 请问,从这儿到市中心大概要多长时间?
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wèn, cóng zhè ér dào shì zhōng xīn dà gài yào duō zhǎng shí jiān?
examples.en: Excuse me, how long does it take from here to the city center?

examples.zh: 等你到了那边,记得替我向大家问好。
examples.pinyin: Děng nǐ dào le nà biān, jì de tì wǒ xiàng dà jiā wèn hǎo。
examples.en: When you get there, remember to send everyone my regards.

examples.zh: 我到超市去买点东西,你要不要一起去?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào chāo shì qù mǎi diǎn dōng xī, nǐ yào bù yào yì qǐ qù?
examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some things; want to come along?

examples.zh: 信寄出去一个星期后才到了他手里。
examples.pinyin: Xìn jì chū qù yí gè xīng qī hòu cái dào le tā shǒu lǐ。
examples.en: The letter reached him only a week after it was sent.

examples.zh: 我们打算这个暑假到南方的几个城市走走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dǎ suàn zhè ge shǔ jià dào nán fāng de jǐ gè chéng shì zǒu zǒu。
examples.en: We plan to visit a few southern cities this summer.

examples.zh: 他一路上换了三种车,才到了那个偏远的小镇。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī lù shàng huàn le sān zhǒng chē, cái dào le nà ge piān yuǎn de xiǎo zhèn。
examples.en: He changed vehicles three times before reaching that remote town.

examples.zh: 你到了以后,先在门口等我,别自己乱走。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào le yǐ hòu, xiān zài mén kǒu děng wǒ, bié zì jǐ luàn zǒu。
examples.en: When you arrive, wait for me at the entrance and don't wander off.

examples.zh: 快到中午了,我们找个地方吃点东西吧。
examples.pinyin: Kuài dào zhōng wǔ le, wǒ men zhǎo gè dì fāng chī diǎn dōng xī ba。
examples.en: It's almost noon; let's find somewhere to eat.

examples.zh: 从山脚到山顶,他们整整爬了四个小时。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shān jiǎo dào shān dǐng, tā men zhěng zhěng pá le sì gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: From the foot to the summit, they climbed for a full four hours.

examples.zh: 这封信要到下个月初才能到收信人手里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn yào dào xià gè yuè chū cái néng dào shōu xìn rén shǒu lǐ。
examples.en: This letter won't reach the recipient until early next month.

examples.zh: 我们到公园去散散步,顺便消化一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dào gōng yuán qù sàn sàn bù, shùn biàn xiāo huà yī xià。
examples.en: Let's go to the park for a walk and help our food settle.

examples.zh: 他坐飞机到北京,又转火车到了老家。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò fēi jī dào běi jīng, yòu zhuǎn huǒ chē dào le lǎo jiā。
examples.en: He flew to Beijing, then transferred to a train to his hometown.

examples.zh: 等货到了仓库,我们马上通知你来取。
examples.pinyin: Děng huò dào le cāng kù, wǒ men mǎ shàng tōng zhī nǐ lái qǔ。
examples.en: Once the goods arrive at the warehouse, we'll notify you to collect them.

examples.zh: 那年冬天,他一个人到很远的地方去打工。
examples.pinyin: Nà nián dōng tiān, tā yí gè rén dào hěn yuǎn de dì fāng qù dǎ gōng。
examples.en: That winter, he went far away alone to work.

examples.zh: 从家到学校,她每天要走将近一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jiā dào xué xiào, tā měi tiān yào zǒu jiāng jìn yí gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: From home to school, she walks nearly an hour every day.

examples.zh: 你要是到我们这个城市来,一定要联系我。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì dào wǒ men zhè ge chéng shì lái, yí dìng yào lián xì wǒ。
examples.en: If you come to our city, be sure to contact me.

examples.zh: 船到岸边的时候,岸上早已站满了迎接的人。
examples.pinyin: Chuán dào àn biān de shí hòu, àn shàng zǎo yǐ zhàn mǎn le yíng jiē de rén。
examples.en: When the boat reached the shore, people were already waiting to greet it.

title: "好" ile "...-ması kolay / hoş"
summary: "好" (hǎo) bir fiilin önüne gelip "...-ması kolay" ya da "hoş/güzel ..." anlamı verir: 好找 = bulması kolay; 好吃 = lezzetli (yemesi güzel).
explanation: "好" bir fiilin önüne gelerek o eylemin YAPILMASININ kolay ya da hoş olduğunu belirtir; "难"nın karşıtıdır. İki anlam çıkar: (1) KOLAYLIK — 好找 (bulması kolay), 好记 (akılda tutması kolay), 好走 (yürümesi/gitmesi kolay), 好用 (kullanışlı). (2) DUYU AÇISINDAN HOŞLUK — 好吃 (lezzetli), 好喝 (içimi güzel), 好看 (güzel/hoş görünen), 好听 (kulağa hoş gelen). Yani "好 + duyu fiili" o duyuya hoş gelen anlamı verir. Karşıtı çoğu zaman "难" ile kurulur: 难吃 (tadı kötü), 难找 (bulması zor). Günlük değerlendirmelerde son derece yaygındır.

examples.zh: 这个地方很好找,一出地铁站就能看到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dì fāng hěn hǎo zhǎo, yī chū dì tiě zhàn jiù néng kàn dào。
examples.en: This place is easy to find; you can see it right out of the subway.

examples.zh: 妈妈做的红烧肉又香又好吃,我一口气吃了两碗饭。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zuò de hóng shāo ròu yòu xiāng yòu hǎo chī, wǒ yì kǒu qì chī le liǎng wǎn fàn。
examples.en: Mom's braised pork is fragrant and delicious; I ate two bowls of rice.

examples.zh: 这几个生词编成了一句顺口溜,特别好记。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè shēng cí biān chéng le yī jù shùn kǒu liū, tè bié hǎo jì。
examples.en: These new words are made into a rhyme, so they're easy to remember.

examples.zh: 这条新修的路又平又宽,开车特别好走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīn xiū de lù yòu píng yòu kuān, kāi chē tè bié hǎo zǒu。
examples.en: This newly built road is flat and wide, very easy to drive on.

examples.zh: 这款软件设计得很简单,老人用起来也很好用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎn jiàn shè jì de hěn jiǎn dān, lǎo rén yòng qǐ lái yě hěn hǎo yòng。
examples.en: This app is simply designed and easy even for the elderly to use.

examples.zh: 这首歌旋律优美,歌词也好听,难怪这么流行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē xuán lǜ yōu měi, gē cí yě hǎo tīng, nán guài zhè me liú xíng。
examples.en: This song has a lovely melody and nice lyrics; no wonder it's popular.

examples.zh: 这种茶清香回甘,喝起来特别好喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chá qīng xiāng huí gān, hē qǐ lái tè bié hǎo hē。
examples.en: This tea is fragrant with a sweet aftertaste, very pleasant to drink.

examples.zh: 她今天穿了一条新裙子,大家都说很好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān chuān le yī tiáo xīn qún zi, dà jiā dōu shuō hěn hǎo kàn。
examples.en: She wore a new dress today, and everyone said it looks lovely.

examples.zh: 这个牌子的鞋子既结实又好穿,我买了好几双。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge pái zi de xié zi jì jiē shí yòu hǎo chuān, wǒ mǎi le hǎo jǐ shuāng。
examples.en: This brand of shoes is durable and comfortable; I bought several pairs.

examples.zh: 他的名字很好记,听一遍就忘不了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de míng zì hěn hǎo jì, tīng yī biàn jiù wàng bù liǎo。
examples.en: His name is easy to remember; hear it once and you won't forget.

examples.zh: 这家店的招牌就在路口,特别好认。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de zhāo pái jiù zài lù kǒu, tè bié hǎo rèn。
examples.en: This shop's sign is right at the corner, very easy to spot.

examples.zh: 这道菜看着普通,没想到这么好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài kàn zhe pǔ tōng, méi xiǎng dào zhè me hǎo chī。
examples.en: This dish looks ordinary, but surprisingly it's so tasty.

examples.zh: 新买的这把椅子坐着很舒服,也很好搬。
examples.pinyin: Xīn mǎi de zhè bǎ yǐ zi zuò zhe hěn shū fú, yě hěn hǎo bān。
examples.en: This newly bought chair is comfortable to sit in and easy to move.

examples.zh: 超市就在小区门口,买东西特别好买。
examples.pinyin: Chāo shì jiù zài xiǎo qū mén kǒu, mǎi dōng xī tè bié hǎo mǎi。
examples.en: The supermarket is right at the neighborhood gate; shopping is very convenient.

examples.zh: 这本词典查起来很好查,例句也很实用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cí diǎn chá qǐ lái hěn hǎo chá, lì jù yě hěn shí yòng。
examples.en: This dictionary is easy to look things up in, with practical examples.

examples.zh: 这种花不但好看,而且好养,不用天天浇水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhòng huā bù dàn hǎo kàn, ér qiě hǎo yǎng, bù yòng tiān tiān jiāo shuǐ。
examples.en: This flower is not only pretty but also easy to grow, no daily watering.

examples.zh: 孩子的字写得工工整整,特别好认。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi de zì xiě de gōng gōng zhěng zhěng, tè bié hǎo rèn。
examples.en: The child writes neatly, and it's very easy to read.

examples.zh: 这条路线很好记,你跟着走一次就熟了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù xiàn hěn hǎo jì, nǐ gēn zhe zǒu yī cì jiù shú le。
examples.en: This route is easy to remember; follow it once and you'll know it.

examples.zh: 这家理发店的师傅手艺好,剪得也好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǐ fà diàn de shī fù shǒu yì hǎo, jiǎn de yě hǎo kàn。
examples.en: The barber here is skilled, and the cuts look great.

examples.zh: 这台机器操作简单,新员工也很好上手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì cāo zuò jiǎn dān, xīn yuán gōng yě hěn hǎo shàng shǒu。
examples.en: This machine is simple to operate; new staff pick it up easily.

examples.zh: 这种水果不但好吃,价钱也不贵,大家都爱买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ bù dàn hǎo chī, jià qián yě bù guì, dà jiā dōu ài mǎi。
examples.en: This fruit is tasty and cheap, so everyone loves buying it.

examples.zh: 他讲的故事生动有趣,大家都觉得很好听。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎng de gù shì shēng dòng yǒu qù, dà jiā dōu jué de hěn hǎo tīng。
examples.en: The stories he tells are vivid and fun; everyone enjoys listening.

examples.zh: 这个包又轻又好背,出门旅行特别方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bāo yòu qīng yòu hǎo bèi, chū mén lǚ xíng tè bié fāng biàn。
examples.en: This bag is light and easy to carry, very handy for traveling.

examples.zh: 窗外的景色一年四季都很好看,让人看不够。
examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài de jǐng sè yī nián sì jì dōu hěn hǎo kàn, ràng rén kàn bù gòu。
examples.en: The view outside the window is beautiful all year; you never tire of it.

examples.zh: 这种材料软软的,又好剪又好折,做手工正合适。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cái liào ruǎn ruǎn de, yòu hǎo jiǎn yòu hǎo zhé, zuò shǒu gōng zhèng hé shì。
examples.en: This material is soft, easy to cut and fold, perfect for crafts.

title: "一下" ile kısa/hafif eylem
summary: Fiilden sonra "一下" (yíxià) eylemi kısaltıp yumuşatır: "bir kere, biraz, şöyle bir": 看一下 = bir bakmak; 等一下 = biraz beklemek.
explanation: Fiilin ardına gelen "一下" eylemi KISA, hafif ve rahat gösterir ve ricaları yumuşatır: 等一下 (bir dakika bekle), 看一下 (bir bakıver), 休息一下 (biraz dinlen). İşlevi fiil ikilemesine (看看) çok yakındır: "bir kerecik, şöyle bir" anlamı katar ve emri nazikleştirir. Nesne "一下"tan SONRA gelir: 介绍一下自己 (kendini bir tanıt). Türkçedeki "...-ıver, bir ...-sene" tonuna denk gelir. Günlük konuşmada ricaları kibarlaştırmanın en yaygın yollarından biridir; "帮我一下" (bana bir yardım et) gibi kalıplarda çok geçer.

examples.zh: 请你等一下,我马上就来,不会让你久等。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ děng yí xià, wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái, bú huì ràng nǐ jiǔ děng。
examples.en: Please wait a moment; I'll be right there, I won't keep you long.

examples.zh: 你能帮我看一下这句话是什么意思吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ kàn yī xià zhè jù huà shì shén me yì si ma?
examples.en: Could you help me check what this sentence means?

examples.zh: 忙了一上午,咱们坐下来休息一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī shàng wǔ, zán men zuò xià lái xiū xī yī xià ba。
examples.en: After a busy morning, let's sit down and rest a bit.

examples.zh: 请大家安静一下,我有件事要宣布。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā ān jìng yī xià, wǒ yǒu jiàn shì yào xuān bù。
examples.en: Everyone please quiet down; I have something to announce.

examples.zh: 你先尝一下这个汤,看看咸淡合适不合适。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān cháng yī xià zhè ge tāng, kàn kàn xián dàn hé shì bù hé shì。
examples.en: Taste this soup first and see if the seasoning is right.

examples.zh: 麻烦你帮我拿一下那本书,我够不着。
examples.pinyin: Má fán nǐ bāng wǒ ná yī xià nà běn shū, wǒ gòu bù zhe。
examples.en: Could you please grab that book for me? I can't reach it.

examples.zh: 新同事来了,请你给大家介绍一下他。
examples.pinyin: Xīn tóng shì lái le, qǐng nǐ gěi dà jiā jiè shào yī xià tā。
examples.en: The new colleague has arrived; please introduce him to everyone.

examples.zh: 我出去一下就回来,你在这儿看着行李。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chū qù yī xià jiù huí lái, nǐ zài zhè ér kàn zhe xíng lǐ。
examples.en: I'll step out for a moment and be back; watch the luggage here.

examples.zh: 这件衣服你试一下,不合适咱们再换。

title: İki nesne alan fiiller
pattern: Özne + Fiil + Dolaylı Nesne + Dolaysız Nesne
summary: Bazı fiiller iki nesne alır: önce KİME, sonra NE: 给我一本书 = bana bir kitap ver; 教你汉语 = sana Çince öğret.
explanation: Bir grup fiil aynı anda İKİ nesne alır: önce dolaylı nesne (KİME/kime yönelik — genelde bir kişi), sonra dolaysız nesne (NE — bir şey). Kalıp: Özne + Fiil + kişi + şey. 老师教我们汉语 (Öğretmen bize Çince öğretiyor), 他给了我一个礼物 (Bana bir hediye verdi), 我问你一个问题 (Sana bir soru soruyorum). Bu "çift nesneli" fiiller sınırlıdır ve çoğu verme/iletme/bildirme anlamı taşır: 给 (vermek), 教 (öğretmek), 送 (hediye etmek), 问 (sormak), 告诉 (söylemek), 还 (geri vermek), 借 (ödünç vermek/almak). Türkçede "-e" ve "-i" hâlleriyle kurulan yapı, Çince'de iki nesnenin art arda dizilmesiyle olur.

examples.en: The teacher teaches us a lot of useful knowledge every day.

title: Olanaksızlık tümleci: "不懂"
titleEn: Potential complement "-bu dong" for not understanding
summary: "看不懂 / 听不懂" bir şeyi (bakarak/dinleyerek) ANLAYAMAMAYI bildirir; olumlusu "看得懂 / 听得懂"tur.
explanation: "懂" (anlamak) bir fiilin ardına "olanak tümleci" olarak gelir ve eylemin sonucunda ANLAMANIN mümkün olup olmadığını gösterir. OLUMSUZ (yapamama): fiil + 不 + 懂 — 看不懂 (bakınca anlayamıyor/okuyamıyor), 听不懂 (dinleyince anlayamıyor). OLUMLU (yapabilme): fiil + 得 + 懂 — 看得懂 (anlayabiliyor), 听得懂 (anlayabiliyor). Yani "不/得" fiil ile "懂" arasına girer. Bu yapı bir YETENEK/olanak bildirir ("anlayabilmek"), tamamlanmış bir eylemi değil. Aynı mantık başka sonuç tümleçleriyle de işler: 做不完 (bitiremiyor), 买不到 (bulup alamıyor). Anlamayla ilgili en sık kalıp "看不懂/听不懂"tur.
