examples.zh: 孩子说他长大以后要当一名飞行员。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuō tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yào dāng yī míng fēi xíng yuán。
examples.en: The child says he wants to be a pilot when he grows up.

examples.zh: 这么晚了,我不想出去了,就在家吃点吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le, wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù le, jiù zài jiā chī diǎn ba。
examples.en: It's so late; I don't feel like going out, let's just eat at home.

examples.zh: 我要把这件事情办好,绝不能让大家失望。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào bǎ zhè jiàn shì qíng bàn hǎo, jué bù néng ràng dà jiā shī wàng。
examples.en: I'm determined to do this well and not let everyone down.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我真想出去走走,晒晒太阳。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo, wǒ zhēn xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu, shài shài tài yáng。
examples.en: The weather's so nice; I really feel like going out to enjoy the sun.

examples.zh: 你到底要不要去?大家都在等你一句话呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ yào bù yào qù? dà jiā dōu zài děng nǐ yī jù huà ne。
examples.en: Are you going or not? Everyone's waiting for your word.

examples.zh: 我想给妈妈买个礼物,可是不知道买什么好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi mā mā mǎi gè lǐ wù, kě shì bù zhī dào mǎi shén me hǎo。
examples.en: I'd like to buy mom a gift, but I don't know what to get.

examples.zh: 会开完以后,我要马上赶去机场接一位客人。
examples.pinyin: Huì kāi wán yǐ hòu, wǒ yào mǎ shàng gǎn qù jī chǎng jiē yī wèi kè rén。
examples.en: After the meeting, I have to rush to the airport to pick up a guest.

examples.zh: 我不想跟你吵架,咱们能不能好好说话?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng gēn nǐ chǎo jià, zán men néng bù néng hǎo hǎo shuō huà?
examples.en: I don't want to argue; can we talk nicely?

examples.zh: 他想换个环境,所以决定到外地去发展。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huàn gè huán jìng, suǒ yǐ jué dìng dào wài dì qù fā zhǎn。
examples.en: He wants a change of environment, so he decided to work in another city.

examples.zh: 你要多少我给你多少,别客气,尽管拿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō shǎo wǒ gěi nǐ duō shǎo, bié kè qì, jǐn guǎn ná。
examples.en: Take as much as you want; don't be shy, help yourself.

examples.zh: 我好想回家看看爸妈,可是最近实在太忙了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo xiǎng huí jiā kàn kàn bà mā, kě shì zuì jìn shí zài tài máng le。
examples.en: I really want to go home and see my parents, but I'm too busy lately.

examples.zh: 医生说他要按时吃药,还要多注意休息。
examples.pinyin: Yī shēng shuō tā yào àn shí chī yào, hái yào duō zhù yì xiū xī。
examples.en: The doctor says he must take medicine on time and rest more.

examples.zh: 如果可以重来,我想我还是会做同样的选择。
examples.pinyin: Rú guǒ kě yǐ zhòng lái, wǒ xiǎng wǒ hái shì huì zuò tóng yàng de xuǎn zé。
examples.en: If I could start over, I think I'd still make the same choice.

examples.zh: 这件事我一定要弄清楚,不然心里总是不踏实。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yí dìng yào nòng qīng chǔ, bù rán xīn lǐ zǒng shì bù tà shí。

examples.zh: 我不太想去那么远的地方,来回太折腾了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xiǎng qù nà me yuǎn de dì fāng, lái huí tài zhē teng le。
examples.en: I don't really want to go so far; the round trip is too much hassle.

examples.zh: 天冷了,我想给家里的老人添几件厚衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, wǒ xiǎng gěi jiā lǐ de lǎo rén tiān jǐ jiàn hòu yī fú。
examples.en: It's cold; I want to get some warm clothes for the elders at home.

examples.zh: 你要是不想说,我也不勉强,等你愿意了再说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì bù xiǎng shuō, wǒ yě bù miǎn qiǎng, děng nǐ yuàn yì le zài shuō。

examples.zh: 从今天起,我要早睡早起,好好锻炼身体。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ yào zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, hǎo hǎo duàn liàn shēn tǐ。
examples.en: From today, I'm going to sleep early, rise early, and exercise well.

title: "极了" ile "son derece, aşırı"
summary: Sıfattan sonra "极了" (jí le) o niteliği en üst dereceye çıkarır: 好极了 = harika, muhteşem; 累极了 = bitkin.
explanation: "极了" bir sıfatın (ya da bazı duygu fiillerinin) ARDINA gelip o niteliğin EN ÜST DERECEDE olduğunu bildirir: 好极了 (harika), 漂亮极了 (çok güzel), 累极了 (bitkin/aşırı yorgun), 高兴极了 (son derece mutlu). "太...了" ya da "非常"dan daha güçlü, abartılı bir vurgu taşır. Yapısı basittir: sıfat + 极了 (araya bir şey girmez). Yalnız OLUMLU/güçlü ifadelerde kullanılır; "很/非常" gibi sıfatın önüne DEĞİL, ardına gelmesi dikkat çekicidir. Türkçedeki "son derece, aşırı, olağanüstü, müthiş" abartılarına denk gelir ve konuşmacının güçlü duygusunu belirtir.

examples.zh: 站在山顶往下看,景色美极了,让人舍不得离开。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shān dǐng wǎng xià kàn, jǐng sè měi jí le, ràng rén shě bù de lí kāi。
examples.en: Looking down from the summit, the view is stunning; you can't bear to leave.

examples.zh: 忙了一整天,回到家我已经累极了,倒头就睡。

examples.en: After a busy day, I was utterly exhausted at home and fell right asleep.

examples.zh: 听到自己被录取的消息,他高兴极了。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zì jǐ bèi lù qǔ de xiāo xī, tā gāo xìng jí le。
examples.en: Hearing he'd been admitted, he was overjoyed.

examples.zh: 这道菜香极了,还没端上桌我就闻到了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài xiāng jí le, hái méi duān shàng zhuō wǒ jiù wén dào le。
examples.en: This dish smells wonderful; I could smell it before it hit the table.

examples.zh: 外面冷极了,风一吹,脸都疼了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn lěng jí le, fēng yī chuī, liǎn dōu téng le。
examples.en: It's freezing outside; the wind makes your face hurt.

examples.zh: 孩子第一次上台表演,紧张极了,手心全是汗。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dì yī cì shàng tái biǎo yǎn, jǐn zhāng jí le, shǒu xīn quán shì hàn。
examples.en: Performing on stage for the first time, the child was so nervous his palms sweated.

examples.zh: 这个消息来得太突然,大家都惊讶极了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī lái de tài tū rán, dà jiā dōu jīng yà jí le。
examples.en: The news came so suddenly that everyone was extremely surprised.

examples.zh: 妈妈做的红烧肉好吃极了,我一口气吃了两碗饭。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zuò de hóng shāo ròu hǎo chī jí le, wǒ yì kǒu qì chī le liǎng wǎn fàn。
examples.en: Mom's braised pork is incredibly delicious; I ate two bowls of rice.

examples.zh: 考试没考好,他心里难过极了,一整天都没说话。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo shì méi kǎo hǎo, tā xīn lǐ nán guò jí le, yī zhěng tiān dōu méi shuō huà。
examples.en: Having done poorly on the exam, he was terribly upset and stayed silent all day.

examples.zh: 这几天热极了,大家都躲在空调房里不敢出门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān rè jí le, dà jiā dōu duǒ zài kōng tiáo fáng lǐ bù gǎn chū mén。
examples.en: It's been scorching these days; everyone hides in air-conditioned rooms.

examples.zh: 看到多年不见的老朋友,她激动极了,眼泪都出来了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào duō nián bú jiàn de lǎo péng yǒu, tā jī dòng jí le, yǎn lèi dōu chū lái le。
examples.en: Seeing an old friend after years, she was so moved that tears came.

examples.zh: 这个孩子聪明极了,老师教一遍他就记住了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hái zi cōng míng jí le, lǎo shī jiào yī biàn tā jiù jì zhù le。
examples.en: This child is extremely smart; he remembers after one lesson.

examples.zh: 刚下过雨,空气清新极了,让人心情舒畅。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xià guò yǔ, kōng qì qīng xīn jí le, ràng rén xīn qíng shū chàng。
examples.en: After the rain, the air is so fresh it lifts your spirits.

examples.zh: 那场演出精彩极了,观众们不停地鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng yǎn chū jīng cǎi jí le, guān zhòng men bù tíng de gǔ zhǎng。
examples.en: That performance was superb; the audience clapped endlessly.

examples.zh: 他做事认真极了,连最小的细节都不放过。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì rèn zhēn jí le, lián zuì xiǎo de xì jié dōu bù fàng guò。
examples.en: He works with utmost care, missing not even the smallest detail.

examples.zh: 这条路难走极了,又窄又陡,我们走得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù nán zǒu jí le, yòu zhǎi yòu dǒu, wǒ men zǒu de hěn màn。
examples.en: This road is terribly hard to walk, narrow and steep; we went slowly.

examples.zh: 拿到心爱的礼物,小女孩开心极了,又蹦又跳。
examples.pinyin: Ná dào xīn ài de lǐ wù, xiǎo nǚ hái kāi xīn jí le, yòu bèng yòu tiào。
examples.en: Getting her beloved gift, the little girl was thrilled, jumping about.

examples.zh: 这本书有意思极了,我一个晚上就看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu yì si jí le, wǒ yí gè wǎn shàng jiù kàn wán le。
examples.en: This book is fascinating; I finished it in one night.

examples.zh: 等了这么久他还不来,我烦极了。
examples.pinyin: Děng le zhè me jiǔ tā hái bù lái, wǒ fán jí le。
examples.en: He still hasn't come after all this waiting; I'm extremely annoyed.

examples.zh: 这里的夜晚安静极了,只能听见虫子的叫声。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de yè wǎn ān jìng jí le, zhǐ néng tīng jiàn chóng zi de jiào shēng。
examples.en: The nights here are extremely quiet; you hear only the insects.

examples.zh: 第一次坐飞机,他既好奇又害怕极了。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì zuò fēi jī, tā jì hào qí yòu hài pà jí le。
examples.en: On his first flight, he was both curious and terribly scared.

examples.zh: 这杯茶清香极了,喝一口整个人都放松了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi chá qīng xiāng jí le, hē yī kǒu zhěng gè rén dōu fàng sōng le。
examples.en: This tea is wonderfully fragrant; one sip relaxes you completely.

examples.zh: 看到孩子平安回来,妈妈心里踏实极了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào hái zi píng ān huí lái, mā mā xīn lǐ tà shí jí le。
examples.en: Seeing the child return safe, mom felt utterly reassured.

examples.zh: 那天的日落红极了,把半边天都染成了金色。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiān de rì luò hóng jí le, bǎ bàn biān tiān dōu rǎn chéng le jīn sè。
examples.en: The sunset that day was intensely red, dyeing half the sky gold.

examples.zh: 这双鞋舒服极了,走一天路脚也不觉得累。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié shū fú jí le, zǒu yī tiān lù jiǎo yě bù jué de lèi。
examples.en: These shoes are extremely comfortable; a whole day's walk and no fatigue.

title: "不怎么" ile "pek de ... değil"
summary: "不怎么" (bù zěnme) bir niteliği hafifçe olumsuzlar: "pek de ... değil, o kadar ... değil": 不怎么好 = pek iyi değil.
explanation: "不怎么" bir sıfatın ya da fiilin önüne gelip onu YUMUŞAKÇA, dolaylı biçimde olumsuzlar: "pek de ..., o kadar da ... değil". 这家店的菜不怎么好吃 (Bu dükkânın yemekleri pek de lezzetli değil), 我最近不怎么忙 (Son zamanlarda pek meşgul değilim), 他不怎么爱说话 (Pek konuşkan biri değil). "不太"ye benzer ama daha da örtülü, kaçamak bir olumsuzluk tonu taşır — açıkça "kötü/hayır" demeden hafif bir olumsuzluk. Tek başına "不怎么样" ise "şöyle böyle, pek iyi değil" anlamı verir. Türkçedeki "pek, o kadar da, öyle ... sayılmaz" ile örtüşür; nazik/dolaylı olumsuzlamanın yaygın bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 说实话,这家饭馆的菜不怎么好吃,我们换一家吧。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shí huà, zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài bù zěn me hǎo chī, wǒ men huàn yī jiā ba。
examples.en: Honestly, this restaurant's food isn't that good; let's try another.

examples.zh: 他最近好像不怎么开心,你知道发生了什么事吗?
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì jìn hǎo xiàng bù zěn me kāi xīn, nǐ zhī dào fā shēng le shén me shì ma?
examples.en: He doesn't seem very happy lately; do you know what happened?

examples.zh: 这部电影名气很大,可是我看了觉得不怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng míng qì hěn dà, kě shì wǒ kàn le jué de bù zěn me yàng。
examples.en: This movie is famous, but I found it nothing special.

examples.zh: 我对这方面不怎么了解,你还是问专业的人吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè fāng miàn bù zěn me liǎo jiě, nǐ hái shì wèn zhuān yè de rén ba。
examples.en: I don't know much about this; better ask a professional.

examples.zh: 今天天气不怎么好,阴沉沉的,好像要下雨。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān tiān qì bù zěn me hǎo, yīn chén chén de, hǎo xiàng yào xià yǔ。
examples.en: The weather isn't great today; it's gloomy, like it'll rain.

examples.zh: 他平时不怎么运动,所以爬两层楼就气喘吁吁。
examples.pinyin: Tā píng shí bù zěn me yùn dòng, suǒ yǐ pá liǎng céng lóu jiù qì chuǎn xū xū。
examples.en: He doesn't exercise much, so two flights of stairs leave him panting.

examples.zh: 这条裤子的样子我不怎么喜欢,颜色也太暗了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kù zi de yàng zi wǒ bù zěn me xǐ huān, yán sè yě tài àn le。
examples.en: I don't much like the style of these trousers, and the color's too dark.

examples.zh: 最近工作不怎么忙,我终于有时间陪陪家人了。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn gōng zuò bù zěn me máng, wǒ zhōng yú yǒu shí jiān péi péi jiā rén le。
examples.en: Work isn't very busy lately; I finally have time for family.

examples.zh: 他汉语说得还行,可是写字不怎么好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā hàn yǔ shuō de hái xíng, kě shì xiě zì bù zěn me hǎo kàn。
examples.en: His spoken Chinese is okay, but his handwriting isn't very nice.

examples.zh: 这个牌子我以前不怎么听说过,质量靠谱吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge pái zi wǒ yǐ qián bù zěn me tīng shuō guò, zhì liàng kào pǔ ma?
examples.en: I hadn't heard much of this brand before; is the quality reliable?

examples.zh: 她不怎么爱打扮,可是看起来总是很精神。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù zěn me ài dǎ bàn, kě shì kàn qǐ lái zǒng shì hěn jīng shén。
examples.en: She doesn't fuss over her appearance, yet she always looks bright.

examples.zh: 这道题其实不怎么难,你静下心来就会做了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí qí shí bù zěn me nán, nǐ jìng xià xīn lái jiù huì zuò le。
examples.en: This problem isn't really that hard; calm down and you'll solve it.

examples.zh: 这几天胃口不怎么好,吃什么都没什么味道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wèi kǒu bù zěn me hǎo, chī shén me dōu méi shén me wèi dào。
examples.en: My appetite hasn't been great these days; nothing tastes good.

examples.zh: 那个地方不怎么出名,可是风景特别原始、安静。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge dì fāng bù zěn me chū míng, kě shì fēng jǐng tè bié yuán shǐ、 ān jìng。
examples.en: That place isn't very famous, but the scenery is wild and quiet.

examples.zh: 他这个人不怎么会说话,可是心眼儿特别好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè ge rén bù zěn me huì shuō huà, kě shì xīn yǎn ér tè bié hǎo。
examples.en: He's not very articulate, but he's really kind-hearted.

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑现在不怎么好用了,常常死机。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù diàn nǎo xiàn zài bù zěn me hǎo yòng le, cháng cháng sǐ jī。
examples.en: This old computer isn't very usable now; it often freezes.

examples.zh: 我跟他不怎么熟,只是见面点头打个招呼而已。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā bù zěn me shú, zhǐ shì jiàn miàn diǎn tóu dǎ gè zhāo hū ér yǐ。
examples.en: I don't know him well; we just nod hello when we meet.

examples.zh: 最近他上课不怎么专心,总是走神。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn tā shàng kè bù zěn me zhuān xīn, zǒng shì zǒu shén。
examples.en: He hasn't been very focused in class lately, always drifting off.

examples.zh: 这种花不怎么好养,稍不注意就枯萎了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhòng huā bù zěn me hǎo yǎng, shāo bù zhù yì jiù kū wěi le。
examples.en: This flower isn't easy to keep; a little neglect and it wilts.

examples.zh: 外面的动静我不怎么听得清,你去看看是怎么回事。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn de dòng jìng wǒ bù zěn me tīng de qīng, nǐ qù kàn kàn shì zěn me huí shì。
examples.en: I can't quite hear what's going on outside; go check what it is.

examples.zh: 他的身体最近不怎么好,你们别让他太操劳了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēn tǐ zuì jìn bù zěn me hǎo, nǐ men bié ràng tā tài cāo láo le。
examples.en: His health hasn't been great lately; don't let him overwork.

examples.zh: 这条路我不怎么熟,还是打开导航跟着走吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ bù zěn me shú, hái shì dǎ kāi dǎo háng gēn zhe zǒu ba。

examples.zh: 这次的安排我不怎么满意,还有很多可以改进的地方。

examples.zh: 他刚来的时候不怎么合群,现在跟大家都很熟了。

examples.zh: 这种天气不怎么适合出门,咱们改天再去吧。

examples.en: This weather isn't great for going out; let's go another day.

title: "全" ile "bütün, hep, tamamen"
summary: "全" (quán) bir bütünün TAMAMINI kapsar: 全家 = bütün aile; 全都知道 = hepsini biliyor.
explanation: "全" bir şeyin TAMAMINI, istisnasız hepsini belirtir ve iki türlü kullanılır: (1) Bir ismin önünde "bütün, tüm" — 全家 (bütün aile), 全班 (bütün sınıf), 全世界 (bütün dünya), 全身 (tüm vücut). (2) Bir zarf olarak yüklemden önce "hep, hepsi, tamamen" — genelde "都" ile pekişir: 他们全都来了 (Hepsi geldi), 桌子上全是书 (Masanın üstü baştan aşağı kitap). "都"ye yakındır ama "全" "eksiksiz bütünlük" fikrini daha güçlü verir; ikisi "全都" biçiminde birlikte de gelir. Türkçedeki "bütün, tüm, hep, baştan aşağı, tamamen" karşılıklarına denk gelir; kapsayıcılığı vurgulamanın güçlü bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 这个好消息一传开,全公司的人都跑来向他祝贺。

examples.zh: 他为了这个项目,几乎把全部的时间都投进去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le zhè ge xiàng mù, jī hū bǎ quán bù de shí jiān dōu tóu jìn qù le。
examples.en: For this project, he poured almost all his time into it.

examples.zh: 孩子在外面玩了一下午,回来全身都是泥。

examples.zh: 桌子上全是资料,我一时都不知道从哪儿看起。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng quán shì zī liào, wǒ yī shí dōu bù zhī dào cóng nǎ ér kàn qǐ。

examples.zh: 这次比赛,我们全班同学都到操场上去加油了。

examples.zh: 听了他的解释,大家心里的疑问全都消失了。
examples.pinyin: Tīng le tā de jiě shì, dà jiā xīn lǐ de yí wèn quán dōu xiāo shī le。
examples.en: After his explanation, everyone's doubts vanished completely.

examples.zh: 过年的时候,全家人围坐在一起,热闹极了。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián de shí hòu, quán jiā rén wéi zuò zài yì qǐ, rè nào jí le。
examples.en: At New Year, the whole family sits together, very lively.

examples.zh: 这场大雨把我们全淋湿了,只好躲进了旁边的商店。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà yǔ bǎ wǒ men quán lín shī le, zhǐ hǎo duǒ jìn le páng biān de shāng diàn。
examples.en: The downpour soaked us all, so we ducked into a nearby shop.

examples.zh: 他把攒下的钱全都拿出来,给父母买了一台新电视。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zǎn xià de qián quán dōu ná chū lái, gěi fù mǔ mǎi le yī tái xīn diàn shì。
examples.en: He took out all his savings to buy his parents a new TV.

examples.zh: 经过这件事,我才明白他说的话全是真的。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè jiàn shì, wǒ cái míng bái tā shuō de huà quán shì zhēn de。
examples.en: Only after this did I realize everything he said was true.

examples.zh: 这道菜的材料我全买齐了,晚上就能做。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de cái liào wǒ quán mǎi qí le, wǎn shàng jiù néng zuò。
examples.en: I've bought all the ingredients for this dish; I can make it tonight.

examples.zh: 全世界的人都在关注这场重要的比赛。
examples.pinyin: Quán shì jiè de rén dōu zài guān zhù zhè chǎng zhòng yào de bǐ sài。
examples.en: People all over the world are following this important match.

examples.zh: 他一激动,准备好的话全忘光了,一句也说不出来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī jī dòng, zhǔn bèi hǎo de huà quán wàng guāng le, yī jù yě shuō bù chū lái。
examples.en: In his excitement he forgot all his prepared words and couldn't speak.

examples.zh: 我们全组的努力终于有了回报,任务提前完成了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men quán zǔ de nǔ lì zhōng yú yǒu le huí bào, rèn wù tí qián wán chéng le。
examples.en: Our whole team's efforts finally paid off; the task was done early.

examples.zh: 这些照片记录了他们全家这些年的点点滴滴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān jì lù le tā men quán jiā zhè xiē nián de diǎn diǎn dī dī。
examples.en: These photos record their whole family's little moments over the years.

examples.zh: 他把房间从上到下全打扫了一遍,累得腰都直不起来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ fáng jiān cóng shàng dào xià quán dǎ sǎo le yī biàn, lèi de yāo dōu zhí bù qǐ lái le。
examples.en: He cleaned the room top to bottom, so tired he couldn't straighten his back.

examples.zh: 停电以后,整栋楼全黑了,大家只好用手机照明。
examples.pinyin: Tíng diàn yǐ hòu, zhěng dòng lóu quán hēi le, dà jiā zhǐ hǎo yòng shǒu jī zhào míng。
examples.en: After the power cut, the whole building went dark; everyone used phone lights.

examples.zh: 这次考试的题目他全都做对了,一分没丢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì de tí mù tā quán dōu zuò duì le, yī fēn méi diū。
examples.en: He got every question on the exam right, losing not a single point.

examples.zh: 为了照顾生病的母亲,她把全部的心思都放在了家里。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le zhào gù shēng bìng de mǔ qīn, tā bǎ quán bù de xīn sī dōu fàng zài le jiā lǐ。
examples.en: To care for her sick mother, she put all her attention on home.

examples.zh: 春天一到,山上全开满了各种各样的野花。
examples.pinyin: Chūn tiān yī dào, shān shàng quán kāi mǎn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de yě huā。
examples.en: Once spring comes, the mountains bloom all over with wildflowers.

examples.zh: 他讲的那些道理,我到现在才全明白。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎng de nà xiē dào lǐ, wǒ dào xiàn zài cái quán míng bái。
examples.en: Only now do I fully understand all the reasoning he spoke of.

examples.zh: 这袋苹果全烂了,估计是放得太久了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dài píng guǒ quán làn le, gū jì shì fàng de tài jiǔ le。
examples.en: This whole bag of apples has rotted; probably left too long.

examples.zh: 全班就他一个人没交作业,老师特意找他谈了话。
examples.pinyin: Quán bān jiù tā yí gè rén méi jiāo zuò yè, lǎo shī tè yì zhǎo tā tán le huà。
examples.en: He was the only one in class who didn't hand in homework; the teacher spoke to him.

examples.zh: 经历过风风雨雨,他们全家人反而更团结了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng lì guò fēng fēng yǔ yǔ, tā men quán jiā rén fǎn ér gèng tuán jié le。
examples.en: Having weathered many storms, the whole family became even closer.

title: Sıfat ikilemesi
summary: Bir sıfatı ikilemek onu daha canlı, vurgulu ve betimleyici yapar: 高高 = upuzun; 干干净净 = tertemiz.
explanation: Sıfat ikilemesi niteliği daha CANLI, betimleyici ve çoğu zaman sevecen/vurgulu kılar. Tek heceli sıfat AA olur: 高高的 (upuzun), 红红的 (kıpkırmızı), 慢慢地 (yavaş yavaş). İki heceli sıfat AABB olur: 干干净净 (tertemiz), 高高兴兴 (neşe içinde), 漂漂亮亮 (pırıl pırıl güzel), 清清楚楚 (apaçık). İkilenen sıfat isim niteliyorsa "的", fiil niteliyorsa "地" alır. İkileme, "很" gibi bir derece zarfı GEREKTİRMEZ — tekrar zaten güçlendirir (很高高的 yanlıştır). AA biçiminde ikinci hece çoğu zaman birinci tonda okunur. Türkçedeki "upuzun, tertemiz, yavaş yavaş" gibi pekiştirmelere ve ikilemelere benzer; canlı, resimsi bir anlatım katar.

examples.zh: 他有一双大大的眼睛,笑起来特别可爱。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jīng, xiào qǐ lái tè bié kě ài。
examples.en: He has big eyes and looks especially cute when he smiles.

examples.zh: 放假前,同学们高高兴兴地收拾书包回家了。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià qián, tóng xué men gāo gāo xìng xìng de shōu shí shū bāo huí jiā le。
examples.en: Before the holiday, the students happily packed their bags and went home.

examples.zh: 妈妈把房间收拾得干干净净,一尘不染。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā bǎ fáng jiān shōu shí de gān gān jìng jìng, yī chén bù rǎn。

examples.zh: 小女孩穿得漂漂亮亮的,去参加朋友的生日会。

title: Sıfat + "地" ile zarf yapma
summary: Bir sıfata "地" (de) eklenince zarf olur ve fiili niteler: 认真地学习 = ciddiyetle çalışmak; 高兴地笑 = sevinçle gülmek.
explanation: Bir sıfatı (ya da bir durum sözcüğünü) ZARFA çevirip eylemin NASIL yapıldığını anlatmak için "地" (bu bağlamda "de" okunur) eklenir: Sıfat + 地 + fiil. 认真地听 (dikkatlice dinlemek), 慢慢地走 (yavaş yavaş yürümek), 高兴地跳起来 (sevinçle zıplamak), 大声地说 (yüksek sesle söylemek). "地" niteleyici öbek ile fiili bağlar; Türkçedeki "-ce/-erek/ile" (dikkatlice, koşarak, sevinçle) zarf yapım eklerine benzer. İki heceli sıfatlar ve ikilemeler neredeyse her zaman "地" alır; tek heceli bazı sıfatlar (快, 慢) "地"siz de fiile bağlanabilir. "地"nin işlevini isim niteleyen "的" ve tümleç bağlayan "得"ten ayırmak önemlidir (her üçü de "de" okunur).

examples.zh: 他认真地听着老师讲课,不时地记下几笔。

title: "正好" ile "tam, tam da"
summary: "正好" (zhènghǎo) bir şeyin tam denk geldiğini/tam uygun olduğunu bildirir: 你来得正好 = Tam zamanında geldin.
explanation: "正好" iki yakın anlam taşır: (1) ZAMAN/DURUM DENK GELMESİ — bir olayın başka bir şeyle tam çakışması: 我正好路过,就进来看看 (Tam yoldan geçiyordum, bir uğradım), 你来得正好 (Tam zamanında geldin). (2) TAM UYGUNLUK/ÖLÇÜ — miktar, boyut, zamanın tam yerinde olması: 这件衣服大小正好 (Bu giysi tam bedenime), 还差五块,你这五块正好 (Tam beş lira eksikti, bu beşlik tam oldu). Türkçedeki "tam, tam da, tam zamanında, tam kararında" ifadelerine denk gelir. Bir rastlantının işe yaramasını ya da bir ölçünün tam tutmasını vurgular; "恰好" ile eş anlamlıdır ama "正好" konuşma dilinde daha yaygındır.

examples.zh: 你来得正好,我正想找个人帮我搬一下桌子。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhèng hǎo, wǒ zhèng xiǎng zhǎo gè rén bāng wǒ bān yī xià zhuō zi。

examples.zh: 我正好要去超市,顺便帮你把这封信寄了吧。

examples.zh: 这件外套你穿正好,不大也不小,就买它吧。

examples.zh: 我到车站的时候,那趟车正好进站,一点儿没耽误。

examples.zh: 你要的那本书我正好也有一本,借给你看吧。

examples.zh: 时间正好,我们不用着急,慢慢走过去就行。

examples.zh: 我正好路过你家门口,就上来看看你。

examples.zh: 这些钱正好够买两张票,一分不多一分不少。

examples.zh: 我们到山顶的时候,正好赶上了美丽的日出。

examples.zh: 桌子放在这个位置正好,既不挡路又方便拿东西。

examples.zh: 你打电话来的时候,我正好在开车,所以没接。

examples.zh: 你提的这个建议正好解决了我们一直头疼的问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tí de zhè ge jiàn yì zhèng hǎo jiě jué le wǒ men yì zhí tóu téng de wèn tí。
examples.en: Your suggestion happens to solve the problem that's been vexing us.

examples.zh: 我正好也顺路,可以开车送你一段。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng hǎo yě shùn lù, kě yǐ kāi chē sòng nǐ yī duàn。
examples.en: I happen to be going the same way; I can drive you part of it.

examples.zh: 这幅画挂在这面墙上正好,大小、颜色都很合适。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà guà zài zhè miàn qiáng shàng zhèng hǎo, dà xiǎo、 yán sè dōu hěn hé shì。
examples.en: This painting fits this wall perfectly in size and color.

examples.zh: 我正准备给你打电话,你的电话正好就来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zhǔn bèi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà, nǐ de diàn huà zhèng hǎo jiù lái le。
examples.en: I was about to call you, and your call came at just that moment.

examples.zh: 这点儿剩菜正好够我一个人晚上吃一顿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn ér shèng cài zhèng hǎo gòu wǒ yí gè rén wǎn shàng chī yī dùn。
examples.en: These leftovers are just enough for my dinner alone.

examples.zh: 你今天不忙的话,咱们正好把上次没聊完的事聊完。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān bù máng de huà, zán men zhèng hǎo bǎ shàng cì méi liáo wán de shì liáo wán。
examples.en: If you're not busy today, we can finish the talk we didn't finish last time.

examples.zh: 我正好认识那家医院的一位大夫,可以帮你问问。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng hǎo rèn shí nà jiā yī yuàn de yī wèi dà fū, kě yǐ bāng nǐ wèn wèn。
examples.en: I happen to know a doctor at that hospital; I can ask for you.

title: "还" ile "hâlâ, daha" (süreklilik)
summary: "还" (hái) bir durumun HÂLÂ sürdüğünü bildirir: 他还在睡觉 = Hâlâ uyuyor; 天还早 = Daha erken.
explanation: "还" bu kullanımda bir durumun beklenenin ötesinde HÂLÂ, DAHA sürdüğünü bildirir: 他还在开会 (Hâlâ toplantıda), 都十二点了,你还不睡? (Saat on iki oldu, hâlâ uyumadın mı?), 时间还早,不用着急 (Daha erken, acele etmeye gerek yok). Fiil ya da sıfatın önüne gelir ve bir eylemin/durumun sürekliliğini, tamamlanmamışlığını ya da beklenenden fazla devam ettiğini vurgular. Çoğu zaman "还在" (hâlâ ...-mekte), "还没" (henüz ...-medi) kalıplarında görülür. Türkçedeki "hâlâ, daha, hen üz" karşılıklarına denk gelir. ("还"ın "ayrıca/bir de" ve "neyse ki/idare eder" gibi başka anlamları da vardır; bağlam belirler.)

examples.zh: 都这么晚了,他怎么还在办公室加班?
examples.pinyin: Dōu zhè me wǎn le, tā zěn me hái zài bàn gōng shì jiā bān?
examples.en: It's so late; why is he still working overtime at the office?

examples.zh: 你别催,饭还没做好呢,再等十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié cuī, fàn hái méi zuò hǎo ne, zài děng shí fēn zhōng。
examples.en: Don't rush; the meal isn't ready yet, wait ten more minutes.

examples.zh: 天还早呢,咱们再多聊一会儿,不用急着走。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hái zǎo ne, zán men zài duō liáo yī huì er, bù yòng jí zhe zǒu。
examples.en: It's still early; let's chat a while longer, no need to rush off.

examples.zh: 我给他发了好几条消息,他到现在还没回。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā fā le hǎo jǐ tiáo xiāo xī, tā dào xiàn zài hái méi huí。
examples.en: I sent him several messages, but he still hasn't replied.

examples.zh: 外面还下着雨,你带上伞再出门吧。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn hái xià zhe yǔ, nǐ dài shàng sǎn zài chū mén ba。
examples.en: It's still raining outside; take an umbrella before you leave.

examples.zh: 这么多年过去了,他还记得我们第一次见面的情景。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián guò qù le, tā hái jì de wǒ men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de qíng jǐng。
examples.en: After all these years, he still remembers our first meeting.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,很多道理他一时还不能明白。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hái xiǎo, hěn duō dào lǐ tā yī shí hái bù néng míng bái。
examples.en: The child is still young; he can't grasp many things yet.

examples.zh: 我以为他早走了,没想到他还在门口等着我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi tā zǎo zǒu le, méi xiǎng dào tā hái zài mén kǒu děng zhe wǒ。
examples.en: I thought he'd left, but he was still waiting for me at the door.

examples.zh: 这件事还没有最后决定,你先别到处去说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hái méi yǒu zuì hòu jué dìng, nǐ xiān bié dào chù qù shuō。
examples.en: This isn't finally decided yet; don't go telling everyone.

examples.zh: 都春天了,北方有些地方还这么冷。
examples.pinyin: Dōu chūn tiān le, běi fāng yǒu xiē dì fāng hái zhè me lěng。
examples.en: It's spring already, yet some places in the north are still this cold.

examples.zh: 他学汉语好几年了,可是有些字还是不会写。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué hàn yǔ hǎo jǐ nián le, kě shì yǒu xiē zì hái shì bú huì xiě。
examples.en: He's studied Chinese for years, yet still can't write some characters.

examples.zh: 你怎么还站着?快坐下歇歇,忙一天了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me hái zhàn zhe? kuài zuò xià xiē xiē, máng yī tiān le。
examples.en: Why are you still standing? Sit and rest, you've been busy all day.

examples.zh: 我问他愿不愿意去,他到现在还没给我准信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā yuàn bù yuàn yì qù, tā dào xiàn zài hái méi gěi wǒ zhǔn xìn。
examples.en: I asked if he'd go, but he still hasn't given me a firm answer.

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑用了七八年,居然还能正常开机。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù diàn nǎo yòng le qī bā nián, jū rán hái néng zhèng cháng kāi jī。
examples.en: This old computer, used for seven or eight years, still boots up fine.

examples.zh: 已经过了饭点,他还在忙,连口水都没顾上喝。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ jīng guò le fàn diǎn, tā hái zài máng, lián kǒu shuǐ dōu méi gù shàng hē。
examples.en: Past mealtime and he's still busy, without even a sip of water.

examples.zh: 这么冷的天,他还坚持每天早上出去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me lěng de tiān, tā hái jiān chí měi tiān zǎo shàng chū qù pǎo bù。
examples.en: In such cold weather, he still insists on running every morning.

examples.zh: 我以为你早忘了,没想到你还惦记着这件小事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ zǎo wàng le, méi xiǎng dào nǐ hái diàn jì zhe zhè jiàn xiǎo shì。
examples.en: I thought you'd forgotten, but you still remember this small thing.

examples.zh: 现在才五点,天还亮着,不用开灯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn, tiān hái liàng zhe, bù yòng kāi dēng。
examples.en: It's only five; it's still light out, no need for lights.

examples.zh: 他病了好几天了,到现在还没完全好。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng le hǎo jǐ tiān le, dào xiàn zài hái méi wán quán hǎo。
examples.en: He's been ill for days and still hasn't fully recovered.

examples.zh: 这个问题我们讨论了半天,到现在还没有结论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí wǒ men tǎo lùn le bàn tiān, dào xiàn zài hái méi yǒu jié lùn。
examples.en: We've discussed this for a long while and still have no conclusion.

examples.zh: 都工作十年了,他还像刚毕业时那样有干劲。
examples.pinyin: Dōu gōng zuò shí nián le, tā hái xiàng gāng bì yè shí nà yàng yǒu gàn jìn。
examples.en: Ten years on the job, he's still as driven as when he graduated.

examples.zh: 你怎么还在为那件事生气?早就该放下了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me hái zài wèi nà jiàn shì shēng qì? zǎo jiù gāi fàng xià le。
examples.en: Why are you still angry about that? You should've let it go long ago.

examples.zh: 虽然搬走了很多年,他还常常回来看看老邻居。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán bān zǒu le hěn duō nián, tā hái cháng cháng huí lái kàn kàn lǎo lín jū。
examples.en: Though he moved away years ago, he still often comes back to see old neighbors.

examples.zh: 这么晚了商店还开着门,真是方便了不少人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le shāng diàn hái kāi zhe mén, zhēn shì fāng biàn le bù shǎo rén。
examples.en: The shop's still open this late, which is convenient for many.

examples.zh: 我说了半天,他好像还没完全听明白。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuō le bàn tiān, tā hǎo xiàng hái méi wán quán tīng míng bái。
examples.en: I've explained for a while, but he still doesn't seem to fully get it.

title: "就是" ile vurgulama
summary: "就是" (jiùshì) bir şeyi kesinleştirir ve vurgular: "tam da, ta kendisi, kesinlikle": 我就是不同意 = Kesinlikle katılmıyorum.
explanation: "就是" güçlü bir vurgu ve kesinlik katar. İşlevleri: (1) TAM O, ta kendisi — 他就是我们的新老师 (İşte o bizim yeni öğretmenimiz). (2) KARARLI/ısrarlı vurgu, çoğu zaman inatçı bir tonla — 我就是不去 (Gitmiyorum işte / kesinlikle gitmem), 他就是不肯听 (Bir türlü dinlemiyor). (3) KABUL/onaylama — 就是,就是,你说得对 (Aynen öyle, haklısın). (4) "sadece, yalnızca" küçük bir çekinceyle — 这件衣服挺好,就是有点儿贵 (Bu giysi güzel, sadece biraz pahalı). Türkçedeki "tam da, işte, ta kendisi, ille de, aynen" gibi vurgulara denk gelir; ısrarı, kesinliği ya da onayı güçlü biçimde belirtmenin bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 你别找了,我就是你要找的那个人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zhǎo le, wǒ jiù shì nǐ yào zhǎo de nà ge rén。
examples.en: Stop looking; I'm exactly the person you're searching for.

examples.zh: 不管你们怎么劝,我就是不改变主意。
examples.pinyin: Bù guǎn nǐ men zěn me quàn, wǒ jiù shì bù gǎi biàn zhǔ yì。
examples.en: No matter how you try to persuade me, I simply won't change my mind.

examples.zh: 这家店的招牌菜就是这道鱼,来的人都要点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de zhāo pái cài jiù shì zhè dào yú, lái de rén dōu yào diǎn。
examples.en: This shop's signature dish is exactly this fish; everyone orders it.

examples.zh: 这孩子就是聪明,一点就通,教起来特别省心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi jiù shì cōng míng, yì diǎn jiù tōng, jiào qǐ lái tè bié shěng xīn。
examples.en: This child is just smart; he gets it instantly, easy to teach.

examples.zh: 我说的就是这个意思,你总算听明白了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuō de jiù shì zhè ge yì si, nǐ zǒng suàn tīng míng bái le。
examples.en: That's exactly what I meant; you finally understand.

examples.zh: 他就是太老实了,常常吃亏也不知道计较。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiù shì tài lǎo shí le, cháng cháng chī kuī yě bù zhī dào jì jiào。
examples.en: He's just too honest, often losing out without minding.

examples.zh: 这道题的关键就是这一步,弄懂了就不难了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de guān jiàn jiù shì zhè yī bù, nòng dǒng le jiù bù nán le。
examples.en: The key to this problem is exactly this step; once you get it, it's easy.

examples.zh: 你放心,答应你的事我就是拼了命也会做到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, dā yìng nǐ de shì wǒ jiù shì pīn le mìng yě huì zuò dào。
examples.en: Rest assured; I'll keep my promise to you even at all costs.

examples.zh: 这件衣服哪儿都好,就是价钱贵了点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú nǎ ér dōu hǎo, jiù shì jià qián guì le diǎn ér。
examples.en: This outfit is good in every way, except the price is a bit high.

examples.zh: 别人都同意了,就是他一个人坚决反对。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén dōu tóng yì le, jiù shì tā yí gè rén jiān jué fǎn duì。
examples.en: Everyone else agreed; only he was firmly opposed.

examples.zh: 我要的就是这种颜色,找了好久终于找到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào de jiù shì zhè zhǒng yán sè, zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ zhōng yú zhǎo dào le。
examples.en: This is exactly the color I wanted; I searched long and finally found it.

examples.zh: 你说得没错,问题就是出在这个地方。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méi cuò, wèn tí jiù shì chū zài zhè ge dì fāng。
examples.en: You're right; the problem lies precisely here.

examples.zh: 他这个人就是这样,刀子嘴豆腐心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè ge rén jiù shì zhè yàng, dāo zi zuǐ dòu fǔ xīn。
examples.en: That's just how he is: sharp-tongued but soft-hearted.

examples.zh: 说了这么多,我的意思就是希望你别太累着自己。
examples.pinyin: Shuō le zhè me duō, wǒ de yì si jiù shì xī wàng nǐ bié tài lèi zhe zì jǐ。
examples.en: After all this, my point is simply that I hope you won't overwork.

examples.zh: 这次能成功,靠的就是大家齐心协力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì néng chéng gōng, kào de jiù shì dà jiā qí xīn xié lì。
examples.en: The reason we succeeded this time is precisely everyone's teamwork.

examples.zh: 你怎么说他都不听,他就是这么固执。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me shuō tā dōu bù tīng, tā jiù shì zhè me gù zhí。
examples.en: He won't listen no matter what you say; he's just that stubborn.

examples.zh: 我最喜欢的季节就是秋天,不冷不热,天高云淡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jì jié jiù shì qiū tiān, bù lěng bù rè, tiān gāo yún dàn。
examples.en: My favorite season is exactly autumn: mild, with high skies and light clouds.

examples.zh: 这条路我走过无数遍,闭着眼睛就是不会走错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ zǒu guò wú shù biàn, bì zhuó yǎn jīng jiù shì bú huì zǒu cuò。
examples.en: I've walked this road countless times; I couldn't go wrong even blindfolded.

examples.zh: 大家都别争了,今天这顿饭就是我请。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu bié zhēng le, jīn tiān zhè dùn fàn jiù shì wǒ qǐng。
examples.en: Stop arguing, everyone; this meal is definitely on me today.

examples.zh: 他不是不会做,就是懒,不愿意动手。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì bú huì zuò, jiù shì lǎn, bù yuàn yì dòng shǒu。
examples.en: It's not that he can't do it; he's just lazy and unwilling.

examples.zh: 我要的答案很简单,就是一个字:去还是不去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào de dá àn hěn jiǎn dān, jiù shì yí gè zì: qù hái shì bù qù。
examples.en: The answer I want is simple: just one thing — go or not.

examples.zh: 这台机器别的都好,就是声音大了点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì bié de dōu hǎo, jiù shì shēng yīn dà le diǎn ér。
examples.en: This machine is good in every way, just a bit noisy.

examples.zh: 你猜对了,我今天来找你就是为了这件事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cāi duì le, wǒ jīn tiān lái zhǎo nǐ jiù shì wèi le zhè jiàn shì。
examples.en: You guessed right; I came to see you today precisely for this.

examples.zh: 无论多难,他认准的事就是要做到底。
examples.pinyin: Wú lùn duō nán, tā rèn zhǔn de shì jiù shì yào zuò dào dǐ。
examples.en: No matter how hard, once he's set on something, he sees it through.

examples.zh: 我说的就是他,那个总爱帮助别人的年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuō de jiù shì tā, nà ge zǒng ài bāng zhù bié rén de nián qīng rén。
examples.en: The one I mean is exactly him, that young man who loves helping others.

title: "又不/又没" ile pekiştirilmiş olumsuzluk
summary: "又不/又没" bir olumsuzluğu itiraz/gerekçe tonuyla pekiştirir: 我又不是小孩子 = Ben küçük çocuk değilim ki.
explanation: "又" burada bir OLUMSUZLUĞUN önüne gelip onu pekiştirir ve çoğu zaman bir İTİRAZ, gerekçe ya da rahatlatma tonu katar — "...değil ki, ...-medi ki, ...-e gerek yok": 我又不是小孩子,这点事我能处理 (Ben çocuk değilim ki, bu kadar şeyi hallederim), 你又没做错,别道歉 (Yanlış bir şey yapmadın ki, özür dileme), 天又不黑,着什么急 (Daha hava kararmadı ki, ne acele). "又" burada "tekrar" değil, karşıdakinin (varsayılan) beklentisini çürüten bir vurgu taşır: "oysa aslında öyle değil". Türkçedeki "...değil ki, hem ... değil, zaten ... değil" itiraz kalıplarına denk gelir; bir gerekçe sunarken ya da endişeyi gidermek için sık kullanılır.

examples.zh: 你别紧张,又不是什么大事,慢慢说就行。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié jǐn zhāng, yòu bú shì shén me dà shì, màn màn shuō jiù xíng。
examples.en: Don't be nervous; it's not a big deal, just take your time.

examples.zh: 我又不是故意的,你何必生这么大的气?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòu bú shì gù yì de, nǐ hé bì shēng zhè me dà de qì?
examples.en: I didn't do it on purpose; why get so angry?

examples.zh: 天又没黑,你着什么急,再多待一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān yòu méi hēi, nǐ zhe shén me jí, zài duō dài yī huì er ba。
examples.en: It's not even dark yet; why the rush? Stay a bit longer.

examples.zh: 这点小忙算什么,我们又不是外人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo máng suàn shén me, wǒ men yòu bú shì wài rén。
examples.en: Such a small favor is nothing; we're not strangers, after all.

examples.zh: 你又没做错事,干嘛跟人家道歉?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yòu méi zuò cuò shì, gàn má gēn rén jiā dào qiàn?
examples.en: You didn't do anything wrong; why apologize to them?

examples.zh: 这条路我又不是没走过,放心,不会迷路的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ yòu bú shì méi zǒu guò, fàng xīn, bú huì mí lù de。
examples.en: It's not like I've never walked this road; don't worry, I won't get lost.

examples.zh: 你别怕他,他又不能把你怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié pà tā, tā yòu bù néng bǎ nǐ zěn me yàng。
examples.en: Don't be afraid of him; it's not like he can do anything to you.

examples.zh: 这件衣服又不贵,喜欢就买下来吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú yòu bù guì, xǐ huān jiù mǎi xià lái ba。
examples.en: This outfit isn't even expensive; if you like it, buy it.

examples.zh: 我又没答应他,他凭什么怪我?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòu méi dā yìng tā, tā píng shén me guài wǒ?
examples.en: I never agreed to him; on what grounds does he blame me?

examples.zh: 你别客气了,又不是第一次来我家。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kè qì le, yòu bú shì dì yī cì lái wǒ jiā。
examples.en: Don't stand on ceremony; it's not your first time at my place.

examples.zh: 这道题又不难,你怎么会做错呢?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yòu bù nán, nǐ zěn me huì zuò cuò ne?
examples.en: This problem isn't even hard; how did you get it wrong?

examples.zh: 他又没说不来,你先别自己瞎担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu méi shuō bù lái, nǐ xiān bié zì jǐ xiā dān xīn。
examples.en: He didn't say he wouldn't come; don't worry needlessly.

examples.zh: 你又不是不知道他的脾气,何必跟他计较。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yòu bú shì bù zhī dào tā de pí qì, hé bì gēn tā jì jiào。
examples.en: It's not like you don't know his temper; why bother arguing?

examples.zh: 这么早就睡?天又不晚,再看会儿书吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zǎo jiù shuì? tiān yòu bù wǎn, zài kàn huì er shū ba。
examples.en: Sleeping so early? It's not even late; read a bit more.

examples.zh: 我又不图什么回报,帮你只是因为咱们是朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòu bù tú shén me huí bào, bāng nǐ zhǐ shì yīn wèi zán men shì péng yǒu。
examples.en: I'm not after any reward; I help you simply because we're friends.

examples.zh: 你哭什么,又没有人骂你,别难过了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kū shén me, yòu méi yǒu rén mà nǐ, bié nán guò le。
examples.en: Why are you crying? No one scolded you; don't be sad.

examples.zh: 这点钱我还是有的,又不用你操心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn qián wǒ hái shì yǒu de, yòu bù yòng nǐ cāo xīn。
examples.en: I do have this bit of money; you needn't worry about it.

examples.zh: 他又不是三岁小孩,这点道理还用你教?
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu bú shì sān suì xiǎo hái, zhè diǎn dào lǐ hái yòng nǐ jiào?
examples.en: He's not a three-year-old; does he need you to teach him this?

examples.zh: 你别拦着我,我又没打算做什么坏事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lán zhe wǒ, wǒ yòu méi dǎ suàn zuò shén me huài shì。
examples.en: Don't stop me; I'm not planning to do anything bad.

examples.zh: 路又不远,咱们走过去就行,不用打车。
examples.pinyin: Lù yòu bù yuǎn, zán men zǒu guò qù jiù xíng, bù yòng dǎ chē。
examples.en: The road isn't far; we can just walk, no need for a taxi.

examples.zh: 这又不是你的错,你没必要一直自责。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yòu bú shì nǐ de cuò, nǐ méi bì yào yì zhí zì zé。
examples.en: This isn't your fault; there's no need to keep blaming yourself.

examples.zh: 我又没说要走,你怎么就开始收拾我的东西了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòu méi shuō yào zǒu, nǐ zěn me jiù kāi shǐ shōu shí wǒ de dōng xī le?
examples.en: I never said I'd leave; why are you already packing my things?

examples.zh: 你放心大胆地去做,失败了又不会怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn dà dǎn de qù zuò, shī bài le yòu bú huì zěn me yàng。
examples.en: Go do it boldly; even if you fail, nothing bad will happen.

examples.zh: 这么点儿路又累不着,就当散步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me diǎn er lù yòu lèi bù zhe, jiù dāng sàn bù le。
examples.en: This little walk won't tire you; just treat it as a stroll.

examples.zh: 他又不缺钱,送他礼物还真不好挑。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu bù quē qián, sòng tā lǐ wù hái zhēn bù hǎo tiāo。
examples.en: He's not short of money, so it's really hard to pick a gift for him.

title: "就要...了" ile yakın gelecek
pattern: (还有 + Süre) + 就要 + Fiil + 了
summary: "就要...了" bir şeyin çok yakında olacağını bildirir ve belirli bir zamanla da kullanılabilir: 就要下雨了 = Birazdan yağmur yağacak; 明天就要考试了 = Yarın sınav var.
explanation: "就要...了" bir olayın ÇOK YAKINDA gerçekleşeceğini bildirir: 火车就要开了 (Tren birazdan kalkacak), 我们就要到了 (Neredeyse vardık). "快要...了"ya çok benzer, ancak önemli fark: "就要...了" belirli bir ZAMAN ifadesiyle birlikte kullanılabilir, "快要...了" genelde kullanılamaz — 明天就要放假了 (Yarın tatil başlıyor) doğru; "明天快要..." pek denmez. Sık kalıp: 还有 + süre + 就要 + fiil + 了 — 还有三天就要过年了 (Yeni yıla üç gün kaldı). "就" yakınlığı, aciliyeti vurgular. Türkçedeki "birazdan, neredeyse, az kaldı, ...-mek üzere" ile örtüşür; belirli bir zamana bağlı yakın geleceği anlatmada özellikle kullanışlıdır.

examples.zh: 快点收拾东西,火车再过十分钟就要开了。
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎn shōu shí dōng xī, huǒ chē zài guò shí fēn zhōng jiù yào kāi le。
examples.en: Hurry and pack; the train leaves in ten minutes.

examples.zh: 还有三天就要过年了,街上到处都是买年货的人。
examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu sān tiān jiù yào guò nián le, jiē shàng dào chù dōu shì mǎi nián huò de rén。
examples.en: Only three days until New Year; the streets are full of shoppers.

examples.zh: 你再不出门就要迟到了,快点儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù chū mén jiù yào chí dào le, kuài diǎn ér ba。
examples.en: If you don't leave now you'll be late; hurry up.

examples.zh: 孩子明年九月就要上小学了,我们得提前做准备。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi míng nián jiǔ yuè jiù yào shàng xiǎo xué le, wǒ men děi tí qián zuò zhǔn bèi。
examples.en: The child starts primary school next September; we must prepare early.

examples.zh: 天边的云越来越黑,看样子就要下大雨了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān biān de yún yuè lái yuè hēi, kàn yàng zi jiù yào xià dà yǔ le。
examples.en: The clouds are getting darker; it looks like heavy rain is coming.

examples.zh: 再有两站我们就要到了,你把行李收拾好。
examples.pinyin: Zài yǒu liǎng zhàn wǒ men jiù yào dào le, nǐ bǎ xíng lǐ shōu shí hǎo。
examples.en: Two more stops and we'll arrive; get your luggage ready.

examples.zh: 电影马上就要开始了,请大家把手机调成静音。
examples.pinyin: Diàn yǐng mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le, qǐng dà jiā bǎ shǒu jī diào chéng jìng yīn。
examples.en: The movie is about to start; please silence your phones.

examples.zh: 他准备了这么久,下周就要参加那场重要的比赛了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔn bèi le zhè me jiǔ, xià zhōu jiù yào cān jiā nà chǎng zhòng yào de bǐ sài le。
examples.en: After so much preparation, he competes in that big match next week.

examples.zh: 眼看太阳就要落山了,我们得赶紧下山。
examples.pinyin: Yǎn kàn tài yáng jiù yào luò shān le, wǒ men děi gǎn jǐn xià shān。
examples.en: The sun is about to set; we need to hurry down the mountain.

examples.zh: 还有一个星期,这个学期就要结束了。
examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu yí gè xīng qī, zhè ge xué qī jiù yào jié shù le。
examples.en: In another week, this semester will be over.

examples.zh: 你听,上课铃就要响了,快回教室吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, shàng kè líng jiù yào xiǎng le, kuài huí jiào shì ba。
examples.en: Listen, the class bell is about to ring; hurry back to the classroom.

examples.zh: 再等几分钟,水就要开了,你先把茶叶放进杯子里。
examples.pinyin: Zài děng jǐ fēn zhōng, shuǐ jiù yào kāi le, nǐ xiān bǎ chá yè fàng jìn bēi zi lǐ。
examples.en: A few more minutes and the water will boil; put the tea leaves in the cup first.

examples.zh: 他们俩下个月就要结婚了,现在正忙着布置新房。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ xià gè yuè jiù yào jié hūn le, xiàn zài zhèng máng zhe bù zhì xīn fáng。
examples.en: The two of them marry next month and are busy decorating their new home.

examples.zh: 我的假期就要结束了,真舍不得离开这个安静的小镇。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jià qī jiù yào jié shù le, zhēn shě bù de lí kāi zhè ge ān jìng de xiǎo zhèn。
examples.en: My holiday is about to end; I hate to leave this quiet little town.

examples.zh: 再过几分钟商店就要关门了,你要买什么赶紧买。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò jǐ fēn zhōng shāng diàn jiù yào guān mén le, nǐ yào mǎi shén me gǎn jǐn mǎi。
examples.en: The shop closes in a few minutes; buy what you need quickly.

examples.zh: 春天就要来了,你看,树枝上都冒出嫩芽了。
examples.pinyin: Chūn tiān jiù yào lái le, nǐ kàn, shù zhī shàng dōu mào chū nèn yá le。
examples.en: Spring is about to come; look, tender buds are sprouting on the branches.

examples.zh: 还有半个小时飞机就要起飞了,咱们赶紧过安检。
examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu bàn gè xiǎo shí fēi jī jiù yào qǐ fēi le, zán men gǎn jǐn guò ān jiǎn。
examples.en: The plane takes off in half an hour; let's hurry through security.

examples.zh: 他工作三十年,再过一个月就要退休了。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò sān shí nián, zài guò yí gè yuè jiù yào tuì xiū le。
examples.en: After thirty years of work, he retires in another month.

examples.zh: 眼看就要轮到我了,我的心跳得越来越快。
examples.pinyin: Yǎn kàn jiù yào lún dào wǒ le, wǒ de xīn tiào de yuè lái yuè kuài。
examples.en: It's almost my turn, and my heart beats faster and faster.

examples.zh: 外面天就要黑了,你一个人回去,路上小心点。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn tiān jiù yào hēi le, nǐ yí gè rén huí qù, lù shàng xiǎo xīn diǎn。
examples.en: It's about to get dark outside; going back alone, be careful.

examples.zh: 再过几天,门口那棵樱花树就要开花了。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò jǐ tiān, mén kǒu nà kē yīng huā shù jiù yào kāi huā le。
examples.en: In a few days, the cherry tree at the door will bloom.

examples.zh: 比赛就要结束了,双方的比分还是不相上下。
examples.pinyin: Bǐ sài jiù yào jié shù le, shuāng fāng de bǐ fēn hái shì bù xiāng shàng xià。
examples.en: The match is about to end, and the score is still neck and neck.

examples.zh: 孩子就要放暑假了,他早就计划好去哪儿玩了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi jiù yào fàng shǔ jià le, tā zǎo jiù jì huà hǎo qù nǎ ér wán le。
examples.en: The child's summer break is near; he's long planned where to go.

examples.zh: 你的生日就要到了,想好要什么礼物了吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shēng rì jiù yào dào le, xiǎng hǎo yào shén me lǐ wù le ma?
examples.en: Your birthday is coming; have you thought about what gift you want?

examples.zh: 天就要亮了,忙碌了一夜的医生们才稍稍松了口气。
examples.pinyin: Tiān jiù yào liàng le, máng lù le yī yè de yī shēng men cái shāo shāo sōng le kǒu qì。
examples.en: Dawn is near, and the doctors who worked all night finally breathe a little easier.

title: "再" ile gelecekte "tekrar"
summary: "再" (zài) henüz OLMAMIŞ, gelecekteki bir tekrarı bildirir: 明天再说 = Yarın yine konuşuruz; 再来一杯 = Bir tane daha (getir).
explanation: "再" GELECEKTE ya da henüz gerçekleşmemiş bir tekrarı/devamı anlatır: "tekrar, bir daha, yeniden". 你明天再来吧 (Yarın yine gel), 再等一会儿 (Biraz daha bekle), 服务员,再来一碗米饭 (Garson, bir kâse pilav daha). Çoğu zaman bir eylemin ERTELENDİĞİNİ ya da bir şart sonrası yapılacağını da gösterir: 吃完饭再走 (Yemekten sonra gidersin), 想好了再决定 (İyice düşünüp öyle karar ver). ÇOK ÖNEMLİ: geçmişte gerçekleşmiş bir tekrar için "再" DEĞİL "又" kullanılır (他又来了 = yine geldi). Yani "再" gelecek/gerçekleşmemiş, "又" geçmiş/gerçekleşmiş tekrardır. Türkçedeki "tekrar, bir daha, yeniden, sonra" karşılıklarına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 今天太晚了,这件事咱们明天再商量吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān tài wǎn le, zhè jiàn shì zán men míng tiān zài shāng liáng ba。
examples.en: It's too late today; let's discuss this again tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你先把饭吃完,吃完了再出去玩儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ fàn chī wán, chī wán le zài chū qù wán ér。
examples.en: Finish your meal first, then go out to play.

examples.zh: 这杯咖啡真好喝,服务员,请再给我来一杯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi kā fēi zhēn hǎo hē, fú wù yuán, qǐng zài gěi wǒ lái yī bēi。
examples.en: This coffee is great; waiter, please bring me another.

examples.zh: 你再坚持一下,我们马上就到山顶了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài jiān chí yī xià, wǒ men mǎ shàng jiù dào shān dǐng le。
examples.en: Hold on a bit more; we're almost at the summit.

examples.zh: 这个问题我一时也说不清,以后有机会再细谈。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí wǒ yī shí yě shuō bù qīng, yǐ hòu yǒu jī huì zài xì tán。
examples.en: I can't explain this fully now; let's talk in detail another time.

examples.zh: 你想好了再回答我,不用急着做决定。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hǎo le zài huí dá wǒ, bù yòng jí zhe zuò jué dìng。
examples.en: Think it over before answering; no need to rush.

examples.zh: 今天先到这儿吧,剩下的明天再接着做。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān xiān dào zhè ér ba, shèng xià de míng tiān zài jiē zhe zuò。
examples.en: Let's stop here today; we'll continue the rest tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这本书你要是喜欢,看完了再借给我看看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū nǐ yào shì xǐ huān, kàn wán le zài jiè gěi wǒ kàn kàn。
examples.en: If you like this book, lend it to me after you finish.

examples.zh: 外面还在下雨,咱们再等一会儿,雨停了再走。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn hái zài xià yǔ, zán men zài děng yī huì er, yǔ tíng le zài zǒu。
examples.en: It's still raining; let's wait a bit and go once it stops.

examples.zh: 这次没考好没关系,下次再努力就是了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì méi kǎo hǎo méi guān xì, xià cì zài nǔ lì jiù shì le。
examples.en: It's okay you didn't do well this time; just try harder next time.

examples.zh: 你要是不放心,可以再检查一遍,确认没错。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì bù fàng xīn, kě yǐ zài jiǎn chá yī biàn, què rèn méi cuò。
examples.en: If you're not sure, check once more to confirm it's correct.

examples.zh: 咱们先各自想想,过两天再碰头交流意见。
examples.pinyin: Zán men xiān gè zì xiǎng xiǎng, guò liǎng tiān zài pèng tóu jiāo liú yì jiàn。
examples.en: Let's each think it over and meet again in a couple of days.

examples.zh: 这道菜味道淡了点,你再加点儿盐吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wèi dào dàn le diǎn, nǐ zài jiā diǎn ér yán ba。
examples.en: This dish is a bit bland; add some more salt.

examples.zh: 时间还早,你再睡一会儿,我叫你起床。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān hái zǎo, nǐ zài shuì yī huì er, wǒ jiào nǐ qǐ chuáng。
examples.en: It's still early; sleep a bit more, I'll wake you.

examples.zh: 这件事我做不了主,得跟家里再商量商量。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ zuò bù liǎo zhǔ, de gēn jiā lǐ zài shāng liáng shāng liáng。
examples.en: I can't decide this alone; I need to discuss it with my family again.

examples.zh: 你先回去休息,身体好了再来上班也不迟。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān huí qù xiū xī, shēn tǐ hǎo le zài lái shàng bān yě bù chí。
examples.en: Go home and rest first; come back to work when you're well.

examples.zh: 如果这次还是不行,我们就换个办法再试试。
examples.pinyin: Rú guǒ zhè cì hái shì bù xíng, wǒ men jiù huàn gè bàn fǎ zài shì shì。
examples.en: If it still doesn't work this time, let's try another way.

examples.zh: 这些字你再多写几遍,慢慢就记住了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zì nǐ zài duō xiě jǐ biàn, màn màn jiù jì zhù le。
examples.en: Write these characters a few more times and you'll remember them.

examples.zh: 菜快凉了,你再不回来我们就先吃了。
examples.pinyin: Cài kuài liáng le, nǐ zài bù huí lái wǒ men jiù xiān chī le。
examples.en: The food's getting cold; if you don't come back we'll start eating.

examples.zh: 这件衣服我再考虑考虑,不急着现在买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú wǒ zài kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ, bù jí zhe xiàn zài mǎi。
examples.en: Let me think about this outfit more; no rush to buy it now.

examples.zh: 你说得太快了,能不能再说一遍,慢一点儿?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de tài kuài le, néng bù néng zài shuō yī biàn, màn yì diǎn ér?
examples.en: You spoke too fast; could you say it again, more slowly?

examples.zh: 等我忙完这阵子,咱们再找时间好好聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ máng wán zhè zhèn zi, zán men zài zhǎo shí jiān hǎo hǎo jù jù。
examples.en: Once I'm through this busy spell, let's find time to get together.

examples.zh: 这个方案还不够完善,回去再改一改吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng àn hái bù gòu wán shàn, huí qù zài gǎi yī gǎi ba。
examples.en: This plan isn't refined enough; go back and revise it.

examples.zh: 你别着急走,再坐一会儿,咱们好久没聊了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zháo jí zǒu, zài zuò yī huì er, zán men hǎo jiǔ méi liáo le。
examples.en: Don't rush off; stay a while longer, we haven't talked in ages.

examples.zh: 要是以后再遇到这种问题,你就照这个办法处理。
examples.pinyin: Yào shì yǐ hòu zài yù dào zhè zhǒng wèn tí, nǐ jiù zhào zhè ge bàn fǎ chǔ lǐ。
examples.en: If you meet this kind of problem again later, handle it this way.

title: "又...了" ile geçmişte "tekrar"
summary: "又...了" geçmişte GERÇEKLEŞMİŞ bir tekrarı bildirir: 他又迟到了 = Yine geç kaldı; 我又忘了 = Bir daha unuttum.
explanation: "又" GEÇMİŞTE gerçekleşmiş, tamamlanmış bir tekrarı bildirir ve çoğu zaman "了" ile biter: "yine, gene, bir daha". 他又迟到了 (Yine geç kaldı), 昨天又下雨了 (Dün yine yağmur yağdı), 你怎么又忘了? (Nasıl gene unuttun?). "再" ile temel farkı: "又" OLMUŞ/gerçekleşmiş tekrar (geçmiş), "再" ise henüz OLMAMIŞ/gelecek tekrar içindir. "又" çoğu zaman şaşkınlık, sitem ya da bıkkınlık tonu taşır ("yine mi!"). Ayrıca "又" gelecekteki KESİN/döngüsel bir tekrar için de kullanılabilir: 明天又是星期一了 (Yarın yine pazartesi). Türkçedeki "yine, gene, bir daha, tekrar" karşılıklarına denk gelir ve gerçekleşmiş bir yinelenmeyi vurgular.

examples.zh: 这个月他又迟到了好几次,老板已经很不高兴了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yuè tā yòu chí dào le hǎo jǐ cì, lǎo bǎn yǐ jīng hěn bù gāo xìng le。
examples.en: He was late several times again this month; the boss is displeased.

examples.zh: 你怎么又把钥匙忘在家里了?这已经是第三次了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me yòu bǎ yào shi wàng zài jiā lǐ le? zhè yǐ jīng shì dì sān cì le。
examples.en: How did you forget the keys at home again? This is the third time.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上又下了一场大雨,路上到处是积水。
examples.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǎn shàng yòu xià le yī cháng dà yǔ, lù shàng dào chù shì jī shuǐ。
examples.en: It rained heavily again last night; the roads are full of puddles.

examples.zh: 我刚把桌子擦干净,孩子又把它弄脏了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng bǎ zhuō zi cā gān jìng, hái zi yòu bǎ tā nòng zāng le。
examples.en: I just wiped the table clean, and the child dirtied it again.

examples.zh: 他戒了几次烟,可是没过多久又抽上了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè le jǐ cì yān, kě shì mò guò duō jiǔ yòu chōu shàng le。
examples.en: He quit smoking several times, but soon started again.

examples.zh: 这个星期我又胖了两斤,得开始控制饮食了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīng qī wǒ yòu pàng le liǎng jīn, de kāi shǐ kòng zhì yǐn shí le。
examples.en: I gained another two jin this week; I need to watch my diet.

examples.zh: 你们俩怎么又吵架了?昨天不是刚和好吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ men liǎ zěn me yòu chǎo jià le? zuó tiān bú shì gāng hé hǎo ma?
examples.en: Why are you two arguing again? Didn't you just make up yesterday?

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑又坏了,看来真该换新的了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù diàn nǎo yòu huài le, kàn lái zhēn gāi huàn xīn de le。
examples.en: This old computer broke down again; it really is time for a new one.

examples.zh: 我又把这道题算错了,一定是哪里没注意。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòu bǎ zhè dào tí suàn cuò le, yí dìng shì nǎ lǐ méi zhù yì。
examples.en: I got this problem wrong again; I must have missed something.

examples.zh: 时间过得真快,转眼一年又过去了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài, zhuǎn yǎn yī nián yòu guò qù le。
examples.en: Time flies; in a blink another year has passed.

examples.zh: 他昨天又加班到半夜,今天整个人没精神。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó tiān yòu jiā bān dào bàn yè, jīn tiān zhěng gè rén méi jīng shén。
examples.en: He worked overtime until midnight again; today he's listless.

examples.zh: 孩子刚睡着,门铃又响了,把他吵醒了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi gāng shuì zháo, mén líng yòu xiǎng le, bǎ tā chǎo xǐng le。
examples.en: The child had just fallen asleep when the doorbell rang and woke him.

examples.zh: 我劝了他好几次,可他又做了同样的傻事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ quàn le tā hǎo jǐ cì, kě tā yòu zuò le tóng yàng de shǎ shì。
examples.en: I advised him several times, yet he did the same foolish thing again.

examples.zh: 这个月的电费又涨了,大家都在抱怨。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yuè de diàn fèi yòu zhǎng le, dà jiā dōu zài bào yuàn。
examples.en: The electricity bill went up again this month; everyone's complaining.

examples.zh: 你看,天又阴下来了,估计一会儿要下雨。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, tiān yòu yīn xià lái le, gū jì yī huì er yào xià yǔ。
examples.en: Look, the sky has clouded over again; it'll probably rain soon.

examples.zh: 他又忘了带作业,被老师批评了一顿。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu wàng le dài zuò yè, bèi lǎo shī pī píng le yī dùn。
examples.en: He forgot his homework again and got scolded by the teacher.

examples.zh: 这条新闻我又看了一遍,还是觉得不可思议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīn wén wǒ yòu kàn le yī biàn, hái shì jué de bù kě sī yì。
examples.en: I read this news again and still find it unbelievable.

examples.zh: 刚修好没几天,那辆车又出毛病了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xiū hǎo méi jǐ tiān, nà liàng chē yòu chū máo bìng le。
examples.en: Just days after being fixed, that car broke down again.

examples.zh: 过年的时候,一家人又团聚在了一起。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián de shí hòu, yī jiā rén yòu tuán jù zài le yì qǐ。
examples.en: At New Year, the whole family reunited once again.

examples.zh: 我以为他改了,没想到他又犯了老毛病。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi tā gǎi le, méi xiǎng dào tā yòu fàn le lǎo máo bìng。
examples.en: I thought he'd changed, but he fell into his old habit again.

examples.zh: 这本书我又翻出来看了看,想起了很多往事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ yòu fān chū lái kàn le kàn, xiǎng qǐ le hěn duō wǎng shì。
examples.en: I dug out this book to read again and recalled many old memories.

examples.zh: 他又请了一天假,同事们都替他担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu qǐng le yī tiān jiǎ, tóng shì men dōu tì tā dān xīn。
examples.en: He took another day off; his colleagues are worried for him.

examples.zh: 下班路上又堵车了,我在车里坐了一个多小时。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān lù shàng yòu dǔ chē le, wǒ zài chē lǐ zuò le yí gè duō xiǎo shí。
examples.en: Traffic jammed again on the way home; I sat in the car over an hour.

examples.zh: 你怎么又没吃早饭?这样对身体很不好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me yòu méi chī zǎo fàn? zhè yàng duì shēn tǐ hěn bù hǎo。
examples.en: Why did you skip breakfast again? That's bad for your health.

examples.zh: 这已经是他这个星期又一次帮我了,真让人感动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yǐ jīng shì tā zhè ge xīng qī yòu yī cì bāng wǒ le, zhēn ràng rén gǎn dòng。
examples.en: This is yet another time he's helped me this week; truly touching.

title: "原来" ile "meğer / aslında, önceden"
summary: "原来" (yuánlái) iki anlam taşır: "meğer, demek ki" (yeni fark ediş) ve "eskiden, aslında, başlangıçta": 原来是你! = Meğer senmişsin!
explanation: "原来" iki temel anlama gelir: (1) YENİ FARK EDİŞ / gerçeği anlama — "meğer, demek ki, aslında öyleymiş": 原来是这么回事 (Meğer mesele buymuş), 原来你早就知道了 (Demek sen çoktan biliyormuşsun). Konuşmacının önceki yanlış varsayımının düzeldiğini, bir sırrın çözüldüğünü gösterir. (2) BAŞLANGIÇTAKİ DURUM — "eskiden, önceden, başlangıçta": 他原来住在北京,后来搬走了 (Eskiden Pekin'de otururdu, sonra taşındı), 这里原来是一片农田 (Burası eskiden tarlaydı). İlk anlamda çoğu zaman şaşkınlık/aydınlanma tonu vardır; ikinci anlamda ise bugünle bir karşılaştırma. Türkçedeki "meğer, demek ki" ve "eskiden, aslında, başlangıçta" karşılıklarına denk gelir; bağlam hangisi olduğunu belirler.

examples.zh: 我还以为是谁在敲门,原来是你回来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì shuí zài qiāo mén, yuán lái shì nǐ huí lái le。
examples.en: I wondered who was knocking; it turns out you're back.

examples.zh: 原来他一直默默地帮我,我却什么都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái tā yì zhí mò mò de bāng wǒ, wǒ què shén me dōu bù zhī dào。
examples.en: It turns out he'd been quietly helping me, and I knew nothing.

examples.zh: 这个地方原来是一片农田,现在都盖起了高楼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dì fāng yuán lái shì yī piàn nóng tián, xiàn zài dōu gài qǐ le gāo lóu。
examples.en: This area used to be farmland; now tall buildings stand here.

examples.zh: 怪不得今天路上这么堵,原来前面出了车祸。
examples.pinyin: Guài bù de jīn tiān lù shàng zhè me dǔ, yuán lái qián miàn chū le chē huò。
examples.en: No wonder the road's so jammed today; there was an accident ahead.

examples.zh: 原来你早就知道答案了,怎么一直不告诉我?
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái nǐ zǎo jiù zhī dào dá àn le, zěn me yì zhí bù gào sù wǒ?
examples.en: So you knew the answer all along; why didn't you tell me?

examples.zh: 他原来在这家公司上班,后来自己创业去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuán lái zài zhè jiā gōng sī shàng bān, hòu lái zì jǐ chuàng yè qù le。
examples.en: He used to work at this company, then went off to start his own business.

examples.zh: 我尝了一口才明白,原来这道菜里放了糖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng le yī kǒu cái míng bái, yuán lái zhè dào cài lǐ fàng le táng。
examples.en: One bite and I understood: this dish has sugar in it.

examples.zh: 原来这么简单,我刚才怎么就没想到呢?
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái zhè me jiǎn dān, wǒ gāng cái zěn me jiù méi xiǎng dào ne?
examples.en: It's this simple; how did I not think of it just now?

examples.zh: 这栋楼原来是一所学校,后来改成了图书馆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu yuán lái shì yī suǒ xué xiào, hòu lái gǎi chéng le tú shū guǎn。
examples.en: This building used to be a school, later turned into a library.

examples.zh: 听他解释了半天,我才知道原来是一场误会。
examples.pinyin: Tīng tā jiě shì le bàn tiān, wǒ cái zhī dào yuán lái shì yī cháng wù huì。
examples.en: After his long explanation, I realized it was all a misunderstanding.

examples.zh: 原来你们俩早就认识,难怪聊得这么投机。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái nǐ men liǎ zǎo jiù rèn shí, nán guài liáo de zhè me tóu jī。
examples.en: So you two knew each other already; no wonder you get along so well.

examples.zh: 这条路原来很窄,后来拓宽了不少,好走多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yuán lái hěn zhǎi, hòu lái tuò kuān le bù shǎo, hǎo zǒu duō le。
examples.en: This road used to be narrow; it was widened and is much better now.

examples.zh: 我一直找不到眼镜,原来就戴在自己头上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì zhí zhǎo bú dào yǎn jìng, yuán lái jiù dài zài zì jǐ tóu shàng。
examples.en: I couldn't find my glasses; turns out they were on my head.

examples.zh: 他原来性格很内向,这几年变得开朗多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuán lái xìng gé hěn nèi xiàng, zhè jǐ nián biàn de kāi lǎng duō le。
examples.en: He used to be introverted; these years he's become much more outgoing.

examples.zh: 看了说明书我才明白,原来这个机器要这样用。
examples.pinyin: Kàn le shuō míng shū wǒ cái míng bái, yuán lái zhè ge jī qì yào zhè yàng yòng。
examples.en: After reading the manual I understood how this machine is used.

examples.zh: 原来今天是你的生日,我竟然忘得一干二净。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái jīn tiān shì nǐ de shēng rì, wǒ jìng rán wàng de yī gān èr jìng。
examples.en: So today is your birthday; I completely forgot.

examples.zh: 这里的冬天原来没这么冷,不知道今年怎么了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de dōng tiān yuán lái méi zhè me lěng, bù zhī dào jīn nián zěn me le。
examples.en: Winters here used to be milder; I don't know what's happened this year.

examples.zh: 我一直以为他很严肃,接触后才发现原来他很幽默。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì zhí yǐ wéi tā hěn yán sù, jiē chù hòu cái fā xiàn yuán lái tā hěn yōu mò。
examples.en: I always thought he was serious; getting to know him, he's actually funny.

examples.zh: 门打不开,原来是钥匙拿错了,难怪。
examples.pinyin: Mén dǎ bù kāi, yuán lái shì yào shi ná cuò le, nán guài。
examples.en: The door wouldn't open; I'd brought the wrong key, no wonder.

examples.zh: 他原来的计划是出国留学,后来因故留了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuán lái de jì huà shì chū guó liú xué, hòu lái yīn gù liú le xià lái。
examples.en: His original plan was to study abroad; he later stayed for various reasons.

examples.zh: 我尝了半天也没猜出来,原来汤里放的是这种香料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng le bàn tiān yě méi cāi chū lái, yuán lái tāng lǐ fàng de shì zhè zhǒng xiāng liào。
examples.en: I tasted for a while but couldn't guess; the soup has this spice.

examples.zh: 原来你也喜欢这位作家,咱们真是有共同语言。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái nǐ yě xǐ huān zhè wèi zuò jiā, zán men zhēn shì yǒu gòng tóng yǔ yán。
examples.en: So you like this author too; we really have a lot in common.

examples.zh: 这台机器原来很好用,不知为什么最近老出问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì yuán lái hěn hǎo yòng, bù zhī wèi shén me zuì jìn lǎo chū wèn tí。
examples.en: This machine used to work well; lately it keeps having problems for some reason.

examples.zh: 直到看见照片,我才恍然大悟,原来他们是一家人。
examples.pinyin: Zhí dào kàn jiàn zhào piān, wǒ cái huǎng rán dà wù, yuán lái tā men shì yī jiā rén。
examples.en: Only on seeing the photo did I realize they're a family.

examples.zh: 原来打算周末去爬山,后来因为下雨改成了在家看书。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái dǎ suàn zhōu mò qù pá shān, hòu lái yīn wèi xià yǔ gǎi chéng le zài jiā kàn shū。
examples.en: We'd planned to hike on the weekend, but rain changed it to reading at home.

title: "一下子" ile "birden, aniden"
pattern: Özne + 一下子 + Fiil + 了
summary: "一下子" (yíxiàzi) bir eylemin/değişimin BİRDEN, kısa sürede olduğunu bildirir: 天一下子黑了 = Hava birden karardı.
explanation: "一下子" bir olayın ANİDEN, çok kısa sürede ya da tek hamlede gerçekleştiğini bildirir: "birden, birdenbire, bir anda, çabucak". 天一下子黑了 (Hava birden karardı), 他一下子就明白了 (Bir anda anlayıverdi), 这些东西一下子就卖光了 (Bunlar bir çırpıda satıldı). Çoğu zaman ani bir DEĞİŞİMİ vurgular ve cümle "了" ile biter. Fiilden önce gelir ve eylemin hızını/aniliğini betimler. "一下" (kısa/hafif eylem) ile karıştırılmamalı: "一下子" hızı/aniliği, "一下" ise eylemin kısalığını/denemesini anlatır. Türkçedeki "birden, bir anda, birdenbire, çabucak" ifadelerine denk gelir; ani gelişmeleri canlı biçimde anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 刚才还是晴天,天一下子就阴了下来,开始下雨。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái hái shì qíng tiān, tiān yī xià zi jiù yīn le xià lái, kāi shǐ xià yǔ。
examples.en: It was clear just now; the sky suddenly darkened and it began to rain.

examples.zh: 听到这个好消息,他一下子从椅子上跳了起来。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī, tā yī xià zi cóng yǐ zi shàng tiào le qǐ lái。
examples.en: Hearing the good news, he jumped up from his chair at once.

examples.zh: 这批限量的商品一上架,一下子就被抢光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī xiàn liàng de shāng pǐn yī shàng jià, yī xià zi jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le。
examples.en: As soon as these limited items hit the shelves, they sold out instantly.

examples.zh: 经老师这么一点,我一下子就明白了这道题。
examples.pinyin: Jīng lǎo shī zhè me yì diǎn, wǒ yī xià zi jiù míng bái le zhè dào tí。
examples.en: With the teacher's hint, I understood the problem all at once.

examples.zh: 几年不见,这个小村子一下子变得热闹了许多。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ nián bú jiàn, zhè ge xiǎo cūn zi yī xià zi biàn de rè nào le xǔ duō。
examples.en: After a few years apart, this village suddenly became much livelier.

examples.zh: 他一下子说了这么多,我一时还反应不过来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī xià zi shuō le zhè me duō, wǒ yī shí hái fǎn yìng bù guò lái。
examples.en: He said so much all at once that I couldn't react right away.

examples.zh: 孩子长得真快,一下子就比妈妈还高了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhǎng de zhēn kuài, yī xià zi jiù bǐ mā mā hái gāo le。
examples.en: The child grows so fast; suddenly he's taller than his mom.

examples.zh: 这么多活儿一下子压过来,他忙得团团转。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō huó er yī xià zi yā guò lái, tā máng de tuán tuán zhuàn。
examples.en: So much work piled on at once that he was rushed off his feet.

examples.zh: 听到那个坏消息,她的脸一下子就白了。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào nà ge huài xiāo xī, tā de liǎn yī xià zi jiù bái le。
examples.en: Hearing the bad news, her face went pale in an instant.

examples.zh: 放假的第一天,街上的人一下子少了很多。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià de dì yī tiān, jiē shàng de rén yī xià zi shǎo le hěn duō。
examples.en: On the first day of the holiday, the streets suddenly had far fewer people.

examples.zh: 这道菜太好吃了,一大盘一下子就被吃光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài tài hǎo chī le, yī dà pán yī xià zi jiù bèi chī guāng le。
examples.en: This dish was so tasty that a big plate vanished in a moment.

examples.zh: 停电了,整个屋子一下子陷入了黑暗。
examples.pinyin: Tíng diàn le, zhěng gè wū zi yī xià zi xiàn rù le hēi àn。
examples.en: The power went out, and the whole room plunged into darkness at once.

examples.zh: 他本来还很生气,听我一解释,气一下子就消了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn lái hái hěn shēng qì, tīng wǒ yī jiě shì, qì yī xià zi jiù xiāo le。
examples.en: He was angry, but after my explanation his anger vanished at once.

examples.zh: 这笔钱对他来说不是小数目,一下子拿不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián duì tā lái shuō bú shì xiǎo shù mù, yī xià zi ná bù chū lái。
examples.en: This sum is no small amount to him; he can't produce it all at once.

examples.zh: 春天一到,院子里的花一下子全开了。

title: "差点儿" ile "az kalsın, neredeyse"
summary: "差点儿" (chàdiǎnr) istenmeyen bir şeyin AZ KALSIN olduğunu (ama olmadığını) bildirir: 我差点儿迟到 = Az kalsın geç kalıyordum (ama kalmadım).
explanation: "差点儿" "az kalsın, neredeyse, ramak kaldı" anlamı taşır ve çoğu zaman İSTENMEYEN bir şeyin olmasına ramak kaldığını (ama olmadığını) belirtir: 我差点儿摔倒 (Az kalsın düşüyordum — ama düşmedim), 差点儿忘了 (Neredeyse unutuyordum). İlginç bir nokta: İSTENEN bir sonuç için "差点儿没..." da aynı "az kalsın olmuyordu, ucu ucuna oldu" anlamına gelebilir: 差点儿没赶上车 = az kalsın yetişemiyordum (ama yetiştim). Yani istenen olayla "差点儿VP" ve "差点儿没VP" çoğu zaman aynı sonucu (ucu ucuna gerçekleşti) verir. İstenmeyen olayla ise "差点儿VP" = olmadı. Türkçedeki "az kalsın, neredeyse, ramak kalmıştı" ifadelerine denk gelir; kıl payı kaçırılan ya da atlatılan durumları anlatır.

title: "都...了" ile "artık, çoktan" (vurgulu)
summary: "都...了" bir eşiğin çoktan geçildiğini şaşkınlık/sitem tonuyla vurgular: 都十点了 = Saat on olmuş bile!
explanation: "都...了" "已经...了"ya benzer ama daha DUYGUSAL, vurgulu bir "artık, çoktan, ...bile" anlamı taşır; çoğu zaman şaşkınlık, sabırsızlık ya da sitem tonu vardır. 都十二点了,你怎么还不睡? (Saat on iki olmuş, hâlâ neden uyumadın?), 孩子都这么大了 (Çocuk kocaman olmuş bile), 饭都凉了 (Yemek soğumuş bile). "都" burada "hepsi" değil, bir sınırın geçildiğini vurgulayan bir zarftır ve cümle "了" ile biter. Genelde zaman, yaş, miktar gibi bir ölçünün beklenenden ileri gittiğini belirtir. Türkçedeki "...olmuş bile, çoktan, artık" vurgularına denk gelir; konuşmacının bir gecikmeye ya da hızlı geçen zamana tepkisini yansıtır.

title: "从来都(是)" ile "her zaman, hep"
summary: "从来都是" geçmişten bugüne DEĞİŞMEYEN bir gerçeği/alışkanlığı vurgular: 他从来都是这么认真 = O hep böyle titizdir.
explanation: "从来" çoğu zaman olumsuzlukla "hiç(bir zaman)" anlamı verir, ancak "都" ya da "都是" ile OLUMLU bir vurgu da kurar: geçmişten bugüne HİÇ DEĞİŞMEDEN süregelen bir durum/alışkanlık — "her zaman, hep, baştan beri". 他从来都是说到做到 (O her zaman sözünü tutar), 我从来都很信任你 (Sana baştan beri hep güvendim), 她做事从来都很认真 (İşini hep titizlikle yapar). "从来"nın kattığı "geçmişten beri istisnasız" vurgusu, "都/总是" ile pekişir. Olumsuz biçimi (从来不/从来没) ayrı bir konudur; bu kalıp özellikle OLUMLU, değişmez bir gerçeği över ya da vurgular. Türkçedeki "her zaman, hep, öteden beri, baştan beri" karşılıklarına denk gelir.
