examples.zh: 这家老店的味道从来都没变过,几十年如一日。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diàn de wèi dào cóng lái dōu méi biàn guò, jǐ shí nián rú yí rì。
examples.en: This old shop's flavor has never changed in decades.

examples.zh: 她对待每一位客人从来都是笑脸相迎,热情周到。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì dài měi yī wèi kè rén cóng lái dōu shì xiào liǎn xiāng yíng, rè qíng zhōu dào。
examples.en: She always greets every guest with a smile, warm and attentive.

examples.zh: 爷爷从来都是天不亮就起床,几十年从没睡过懒觉。
examples.pinyin: Yé yé cóng lái dōu shì tiān bù liàng jiù qǐ chuáng, jǐ shí nián cóng méi shuì guò lǎn jiào。
examples.en: Grandpa always rises before dawn, never sleeping in for decades.

examples.zh: 在困难面前,他从来都是第一个站出来的人。
examples.pinyin: Zài kùn nán miàn qián, tā cóng lái dōu shì dì yí gè zhàn chū lái de rén。
examples.en: In the face of difficulty, he's always the first to step up.

examples.zh: 我们家从来都是有话直说,从不藏着掖着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā cóng lái dōu shì yǒu huà zhí shuō, cóng bù cáng zhe yē zhe。
examples.en: In our family we've always spoken frankly, never hiding things.

examples.zh: 他从来都对朋友很讲义气,谁有事都愿意帮一把。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái dōu duì péng yǒu hěn jiǎng yì qì, shuí yǒu shì dōu yuàn yì bāng yī bǎ。
examples.en: He's always loyal to friends, willing to help anyone in need.

examples.zh: 这位老师从来都是耐心地对待每一个学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī cóng lái dōu shì nài xīn de duì dài měi yí gè xué shēng。
examples.en: This teacher has always treated every student with patience.

examples.zh: 她从来都把家里收拾得干干净净,一尘不染。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái dōu bǎ jiā lǐ shōu shí de gān gān jìng jìng, yī chén bù rǎn。
examples.en: She always keeps the home spotlessly clean.

examples.zh: 面对表扬,他从来都很谦虚,说这是大家的功劳。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì biǎo yáng, tā cóng lái dōu hěn qiān xū, shuō zhè shì dà jiā de gōng láo。
examples.en: At praise, he's always modest, saying it's everyone's credit.

examples.zh: 这些年他从来都没有忘记过帮助过自己的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián tā cóng lái dōu méi yǒu wàng jì guò bāng zhù guò zì jǐ de rén。
examples.en: All these years he's never forgotten those who helped him.

examples.zh: 我对你的心意从来都没变过,以后也不会变。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì nǐ de xīn yì cóng lái dōu méi biàn guò, yǐ hòu yě bú huì biàn。
examples.en: My feelings for you have never changed, and never will.

examples.zh: 他花钱从来都很有分寸,不该花的一分也不花。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā qián cóng lái dōu hěn yǒu fēn cùn, bù gāi huā de yī fēn yě bù huā。
examples.en: He's always measured with money, not spending a cent unnecessarily.

examples.zh: 奶奶做的饭从来都那么香,是我最想念的味道。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi zuò de fàn cóng lái dōu nà me xiāng, shì wǒ zuì xiǎng niàn de wèi dào。
examples.en: Grandma's cooking is always so fragrant; it's the taste I miss most.

examples.zh: 这个团队从来都是团结一心,再难的任务也不怕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge tuán duì cóng lái dōu shì tuán jié yī xīn, zài nán de rèn wù yě bù pà。
examples.en: This team has always been united; no task is too hard.

examples.zh: 他对工作从来都一丝不苟,难怪领导那么信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōng zuò cóng lái dōu yī sī bù gǒu, nán guài lǐng dǎo nà me xìn rèn tā。
examples.en: He's always meticulous at work; no wonder the boss trusts him.

examples.zh: 不管遇到什么事,她从来都是那么镇定、从容。
examples.pinyin: Bù guǎn yù dào shén me shì, tā cóng lái dōu shì nà me zhèn dìng、 cóng róng。
examples.en: No matter what happens, she's always calm and composed.

examples.zh: 我们之间从来都是坦诚相待,没有一句假话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī jiān cóng lái dōu shì tǎn chéng xiāng dài, méi yǒu yī jù jiǎ huà。
examples.en: Between us it's always been honesty, not a single lie.

examples.zh: 这条河从来都是这个村子最重要的水源。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé cóng lái dōu shì zhè ge cūn zi zuì zhòng yào de shuǐ yuán。
examples.en: This river has always been the village's most important water source.

examples.zh: 他从来都很守时,约好的时间从不让人等。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái dōu hěn shǒu shí, yuē hǎo de shí jiān cóng bù ràng rén děng。
examples.en: He's always punctual, never keeping anyone waiting.

examples.zh: 父母从来都支持我的每一个决定,给了我很大的勇气。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ cóng lái dōu zhī chí wǒ de měi yí gè jué dìng, gěi le wǒ hěn dà de yǒng qì。
examples.en: My parents have always supported my every decision, giving me great courage.

examples.zh: 这么多年,他对读书的热情从来都没有减退过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián, tā duì dú shū de rè qíng cóng lái dōu méi yǒu jiǎn tuì guò。
examples.en: All these years, his passion for reading has never waned.

title: "结果" ile "sonuçta, neticede"
summary: "结果" (jiéguǒ) bir gelişmenin (çoğu zaman beklenmedik) SONUCUNU bağlar: 我等了很久,结果他没来 = Çok bekledim, sonuçta gelmedi.
explanation: "结果" bir olaydan sonra ortaya çıkan SONUCU tanıtır — çoğu zaman beklenenin tersi ya da sürpriz bir sonuç: "sonuçta, neticede, sonunda, meğer". 我准备了半天,结果会议取消了 (Uzun uzun hazırlandım, sonuçta toplantı iptal oldu), 他本来想省钱,结果花得更多了 (Para biriktirecekti, neticede daha çok harcadı). Cümlenin ikinci bölümünün başında, çoğu zaman virgülden sonra gelir ve önceki durumla bağlantılı bir SONUÇ/gelişme bildirir. Sık sık beklentinin boşa çıktığını vurgular. "结果" ayrıca isim olarak "sonuç, netice" anlamına da gelir (考试结果 = sınav sonucu). Türkçedeki "sonuçta, neticede, sonunda, bir de baktım ki" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir olayın nasıl bittiğini anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我在门口等了他一个多小时,结果他早就走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài mén kǒu děng le tā yí gè duō xiǎo shí, jié guǒ tā zǎo jiù zǒu le。
examples.en: I waited over an hour at the door; turns out he'd already left.

examples.zh: 本来打算周末去爬山,结果下起了大雨,只好在家待着。
examples.pinyin: Běn lái dǎ suàn zhōu mò qù pá shān, jié guǒ xià qǐ le dà yǔ, zhǐ hǎo zài jiā dài zhe。
examples.en: We planned to hike on the weekend, but it rained hard, so we stayed home.

examples.zh: 他为了省钱自己修车,结果越修越坏,花了更多钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le shěng qián zì jǐ xiū chē, jié guǒ yuè xiū yuè huài, huā le gèng duō qián。
examples.en: He fixed the car himself to save money, but made it worse and spent more.

examples.zh: 我以为这道题很简单,结果想了半天也没做出来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi zhè dào tí hěn jiǎn dān, jié guǒ xiǎng le bàn tiān yě méi zuò chū lái。
examples.en: I thought this problem was easy, but I pondered for ages and couldn't solve it.

examples.zh: 大家都劝他别去,结果他还是坚持去了。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu quàn tā bié qù, jié guǒ tā hái shì jiān chí qù le。
examples.en: Everyone advised him not to go, but in the end he insisted on going.

examples.zh: 他熬夜复习了一整晚,结果考试还是没通过。
examples.pinyin: Tā áo yè fù xí le yī zhěng wǎn, jié guǒ kǎo shì hái shì méi tōng guò。
examples.en: He stayed up all night reviewing, but still failed the exam.

examples.zh: 我特意早出门,结果路上堵车,还是迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tè yì zǎo chū mén, jié guǒ lù shàng dǔ chē, hái shì chí dào le。
examples.en: I left early on purpose, but traffic jammed and I was still late.

examples.zh: 本以为这次能中奖,结果一个号码都没对上。
examples.pinyin: Běn yǐ wéi zhè cì néng zhòng jiǎng, jié guǒ yí gè hào mǎ dōu méi duì shàng。
examples.en: I thought I'd win this time, but not a single number matched.

examples.zh: 他们吵了一架,结果谁也不肯先低头,冷战了好几天。
examples.pinyin: Tā men chǎo le yī jià, jié guǒ shuí yě bù kěn xiān dī tóu, lěng zhàn le hǎo jǐ tiān。
examples.en: They had a fight; neither would yield first, so they sulked for days.

examples.zh: 我劝他慢点开车,结果他不听,差点出了事故。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ quàn tā màn diǎn kāi chē, jié guǒ tā bù tīng, chà diǎn chū liǎo shì gù。
examples.en: I told him to drive slower; he didn't listen and nearly had an accident.

examples.zh: 原本说好一起去的,结果最后只有我一个人到了。
examples.pinyin: Yuán běn shuō hǎo yì qǐ qù de, jié guǒ zuì hòu zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí gè rén dào le。
examples.en: We agreed to go together, but in the end only I showed up.

examples.zh: 他想给大家一个惊喜,结果反而把大家吓了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi dà jiā yí gè jīng xǐ, jié guǒ fǎn ér bǎ dà jiā xià le yī tiào。
examples.en: He wanted to surprise everyone but ended up giving them a fright.

examples.zh: 我把闹钟定得很早,结果一觉睡到了大中午。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nào zhōng dìng de hěn zǎo, jié guǒ yī jiào shuì dào le dà zhōng wǔ。
examples.en: I set the alarm early, but ended up sleeping until midday.

examples.zh: 这道菜我照着菜谱做,结果味道还是差了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wǒ zhào zhe cài pǔ zuò, jié guǒ wèi dào hái shì chà le hěn duō。
examples.en: I followed the recipe for this dish, but it still turned out far off.

examples.zh: 他到处打听那本书,结果在自己家里找到了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào chù dǎ tīng nà běn shū, jié guǒ zài zì jǐ jiā lǐ zhǎo dào le。
examples.en: He asked around everywhere for the book, only to find it at home.

examples.zh: 我们满怀希望地去了,结果那家店已经关门了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men mǎn huái xī wàng de qù le, jié guǒ nà jiā diàn yǐ jīng guān mén le。
examples.en: We went full of hope, only to find the shop already closed.

examples.zh: 他答应帮我搬家,结果那天临时有事没来。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng bāng wǒ bān jiā, jié guǒ nà tiān lín shí yǒu shì méi lái。
examples.en: He promised to help me move, but had something come up and didn't show.

examples.zh: 本来只想买一件衣服,结果一口气买了三件。
examples.pinyin: Běn lái zhǐ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn yī fú, jié guǒ yì kǒu qì mǎi le sān jiàn。
examples.en: I meant to buy just one outfit, but ended up buying three.

examples.zh: 我以为他会生气,结果他不但没生气,还笑了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi tā huì shēng qì, jié guǒ tā bù dàn méi shēng qì, hái xiào le。
examples.en: I thought he'd be angry, but he not only wasn't, he laughed.

examples.zh: 孩子偷偷把花瓶藏起来,结果第二天就被发现了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi tōu tōu bǎ huā píng cáng qǐ lái, jié guǒ dì èr tiān jiù bèi fā xiàn le。
examples.en: The child secretly hid the vase, only to be found out the next day.

examples.zh: 我们绕了一大圈想走近路,结果反而更远了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men rào le yī dà quān xiǎng zǒu jìn lù, jié guǒ fǎn ér gèng yuǎn le。
examples.en: We took a big detour thinking it was a shortcut, but it was farther.

examples.zh: 他信心满满地去面试,结果紧张得说不出话来。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìn xīn mǎn mǎn de qù miàn shì, jié guǒ jǐn zhāng de shuō bù chū huà lái。
examples.en: He went to the interview full of confidence, but was too nervous to speak.

examples.zh: 大家你一言我一语地讨论了半天,结果还是没个定论。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā nǐ yī yán wǒ yī yǔ de tǎo lùn le bàn tiān, jié guǒ hái shì méi gè dìng lùn。
examples.en: Everyone discussed back and forth, but still reached no conclusion.

examples.zh: 我提前订好了餐厅,结果那天他们临时休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tí qián dìng hǎo le cān tīng, jié guǒ nà tiān tā men lín shí xiū xī。
examples.en: I booked the restaurant in advance, but they happened to be closed that day.

examples.zh: 他本想低调处理这件事,结果反而闹得人尽皆知。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn xiǎng dī diào chǔ lǐ zhè jiàn shì, jié guǒ fǎn ér nào de rén jǐn jiē zhī。
examples.en: He wanted to handle it quietly, but it ended up known to all.

title: Bir şeyin ne kadardır YAPILMADIĞI
summary: Bir eylemin ne kadar zamandır YAPILMADIĞINI anlatmak için süre "没"ten önce gelir: 我三天没睡好觉了 = Üç gündür iyi uyuyamıyorum.
explanation: Bir eylemin belli bir SÜREDİR yapılmadığını/gerçekleşmediğini anlatmak için, süre ifadesi "没"ten ÖNCE gelir: Süre + 没 + fiil (+ 了). 我三天没吃饭了 (Üç gündür (doğru dürüst) yemek yemedim), 他一个星期没来上课了 (Bir haftadır derse gelmiyor), 我们好久没见了 (Uzun zamandır görüşmedik). Bu, olumlu "süre" yapısının (Fiil + 了 + süre, bkz. ayrı konu) OLUMSUZ karşılığıdır — olumluda süre fiilden SONRA, olumsuzda "没"ten ÖNCE gelir. Cümle sonundaki "了" durumun HÂLÂ sürdüğünü (hâlâ yapılmıyor) belirtir. Türkçedeki "...-dır ...-madı / ...-alı ... oldu" yapısına denk gelir; bir aksamayı, özlemi ya da alışkanlığın kesilmesini anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我们好久没见了,你最近过得怎么样?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn le, nǐ zuì jìn guò de zěn me yàng?
examples.en: We haven't seen each other in a long time; how have you been?

examples.zh: 他病了,已经三天没来上班了,大家都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng le, yǐ jīng sān tiān méi lái shàng bān le, dà jiā dōu hěn dān xīn。
examples.en: He's ill and hasn't come to work for three days; everyone's worried.

examples.zh: 我都一个星期没好好睡觉了,累得眼睛都睁不开。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dōu yí gè xīng qī méi hǎo hǎo shuì jiào le, lèi de yǎn jīng dōu zhēng bù kāi。
examples.en: I haven't slept well in a week; I'm so tired I can barely keep my eyes open.

examples.zh: 这么多年没回老家了,不知道那里变成什么样了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián méi huí lǎo jiā le, bù zhī dào nà lǐ biàn chéng shén me yàng le。
examples.en: I haven't been home in so many years; I wonder how it's changed.

examples.zh: 他俩闹别扭,已经好几天没说话了。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎ nào biè niǔ, yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ tiān méi shuō huà le。
examples.en: The two of them fell out and haven't spoken for several days.

examples.zh: 我好久没运动了,今天爬两层楼就累得直喘气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo jiǔ méi yùn dòng le, jīn tiān pá liǎng céng lóu jiù lèi de zhí chuǎn qì。
examples.en: I haven't exercised in ages; two flights of stairs left me panting today.

examples.zh: 这台旧钢琴很久没弹了,琴键上落了一层灰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù gāng qín hěn jiǔ méi dàn le, qín jiàn shàng là le yī céng huī。
examples.en: This old piano hasn't been played in ages; dust has settled on the keys.

examples.zh: 孩子出国以后,我们已经半年没见到他了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi chū guó yǐ hòu, wǒ men yǐ jīng bàn nián méi jiàn dào tā le。
examples.en: Since the child went abroad, we haven't seen him for half a year.

examples.zh: 我好几个月没读书了,一拿起书就觉得亲切。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo jǐ gè yuè méi dú shū le, yī ná qǐ shū jiù jué de qīn qiè。
examples.en: I hadn't read a book in months; picking one up feels dear.

examples.zh: 这条路好久没修了,坑坑洼洼的,很不好走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hǎo jiǔ méi xiū le, kēng kēng wā wā de, hěn bù hǎo zǒu。
examples.en: This road hasn't been repaired in a long time; it's full of potholes.

examples.zh: 他戒烟以后,已经两年没碰过一根烟了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè yān yǐ hòu, yǐ jīng liǎng nián méi pèng guò yī gēn yān le。
examples.en: Since quitting, he hasn't touched a single cigarette in two years.

examples.zh: 我们家的那只猫,两天没吃东西了,是不是病了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā de nà zhǐ māo, liǎng tiān méi chī dōng xī le, shì bú shì bìng le?
examples.en: Our cat hasn't eaten in two days; could it be sick?

examples.zh: 我都一个多月没给爸妈打电话了,真是太不应该了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dōu yí gè duō yuè méi gěi bà mā dǎ diàn huà le, zhēn shì tài bù yīng gāi le。
examples.en: I haven't called my parents in over a month; that's really wrong of me.

examples.zh: 这么久没联系,他一定以为我把他忘了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me jiǔ méi lián xì, tā yí dìng yǐ wéi wǒ bǎ tā wàng le。
examples.en: After being out of touch so long, he must think I forgot him.

examples.zh: 我好长时间没吃到家乡菜了,做梦都想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo zhǎng shí jiān méi chī dào jiā xiāng cài le, zuò mèng dōu xiǎng。
examples.en: I haven't had hometown food in a long time; I dream about it.

examples.zh: 下了这么多天雨,我们都好几天没出门了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le zhè me duō tiān yǔ, wǒ men dōu hǎo jǐ tiān méi chū mén le。
examples.en: After so many days of rain, we haven't been out in days.

examples.zh: 这本书买回来半年了,我一直没时间看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū mǎi huí lái bàn nián le, wǒ yì zhí méi shí jiān kàn。
examples.en: I bought this book half a year ago and never had time to read it.

examples.zh: 他们分开以后,再也没见过面,一晃十年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā men fēn kāi yǐ hòu, zài yě méi jiàn guò miàn, yī huǎng shí nián le。
examples.en: After they parted, they never met again; ten years have slipped by.

examples.zh: 我好久没这么开心地大笑了,今天真是太痛快了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo jiǔ méi zhè me kāi xīn de dà xiào le, jīn tiān zhēn shì tài tòng kuài le。
examples.en: I haven't laughed so heartily in ages; today was truly delightful.

examples.zh: 这台机器很久没用了,得先检查一下能不能开机。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì hěn jiǔ méi yòng le, de xiān jiǎn chá yī xià néng bù néng kāi jī。
examples.en: This machine hasn't been used in a while; check if it still starts.

examples.zh: 我们全家已经好几年没一起旅行了,今年一定要去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men quán jiā yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ nián méi yì qǐ lǚ xíng le, jīn nián yí dìng yào qù。
examples.en: Our family hasn't traveled together in years; this year we must go.

examples.zh: 他忙得连着一个月没休息了,身体快撑不住了。
examples.pinyin: Tā máng de lián zhe yí gè yuè méi xiū xī le, shēn tǐ kuài chēng bú zhù le。
examples.en: He's been busy without a break for a month; his body can barely take it.

examples.zh: 这片田地荒了好几年没种了,长满了野草。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn tián dì huāng le hǎo jǐ nián méi zhǒng le, zhǎng mǎn le yě cǎo。
examples.en: This field has lain fallow for years, overgrown with weeds.

examples.zh: 自从搬了家,我们就再也没吃过那家的面条了。
examples.pinyin: Zì cóng bān le jiā, wǒ men jiù zài yě méi chī guò nà jiā de miàn tiáo le。
examples.en: Since we moved, we haven't eaten that shop's noodles again.

examples.zh: 好几天没下雨了,地里的庄稼都快旱死了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ tiān méi xià yǔ le, de lǐ de zhuāng jià dōu kuài hàn sǐ le。
examples.en: It hasn't rained in days; the crops in the field are nearly parched.

title: "互相" ile "karşılıklı, birbirine"
summary: "互相" (hùxiāng) bir eylemin KARŞILIKLI yapıldığını gösterir: 互相帮助 = birbirine yardım etmek.
explanation: "互相" bir eylemin iki (ya da daha çok) taraf arasında KARŞILIKLI, iki yönlü yapıldığını bildirir: "birbirine, karşılıklı, birbirini". 我们应该互相帮助 (Birbirimize yardım etmeliyiz), 他们互相尊重 (Birbirlerine saygı duyuyorlar), 邻居之间要互相照顾 (Komşular birbirini kollamalı). Bir zarf olarak fiilin önünde durur ve genelde iki heceli fiillerle kullanılır (互相理解, 互相支持, 互相学习). Öznenin çoğul/iki taraflı olmasını gerektirir. Türkçedeki "birbirine, karşılıklı olarak, karşılıklı" ifadelerine denk gelir. "彼此" (bǐcǐ = birbiri) ile anlamca yakındır; "互相" eylemin karşılıklılığını, "彼此" ise tarafları vurgular. Dostluk, yardımlaşma ve ilişkileri anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 同学之间应该互相帮助,一起进步。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xué zhī jiān yīng gāi hù xiāng bāng zhù, yì qǐ jìn bù。
examples.en: Classmates should help each other and progress together.

examples.zh: 他们俩性格很不一样,却能互相理解、互相包容。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ xìng gé hěn bù yí yàng, què néng hù xiāng lǐ jiě、 hù xiāng bāo róng。
examples.en: The two have very different personalities, yet understand and tolerate each other.

examples.zh: 邻里之间互相照应,遇到困难也不觉得孤单。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǐ zhī jiān hù xiāng zhào yìng, yù dào kùn nán yě bù jué de gū dān。
examples.en: Neighbors look out for one another, so hardships feel less lonely.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩这么多年,一直是互相扶持走过来的。
examples.pinyin: Fū qī liǎ zhè me duō nián, yì zhí shì hù xiāng fú chí zǒu guò lái de。
examples.en: The couple has supported each other through all these years.

examples.zh: 我们虽然是竞争对手,但也常常互相学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men suī rán shì jìng zhēng duì shǒu, dàn yě cháng cháng hù xiāng xué xí。
examples.en: Though we're competitors, we often learn from each other.

examples.zh: 一个好的团队,成员之间要互相信任、互相配合。
examples.pinyin: Yí gè hǎo de tuán duì, chéng yuán zhī jiān yào hù xiāng xìn rèn、 hù xiāng pèi hé。
examples.en: In a good team, members must trust and cooperate with one another.

examples.zh: 他们从小一起长大,互相了解得不能再了解了。
examples.pinyin: Tā men cóng xiǎo yì qǐ zhǎng dà, hù xiāng liǎo jiě de bù néng zài liǎo jiě le。
examples.en: They grew up together and couldn't understand each other more.

examples.zh: 遇到分歧的时候,双方要互相体谅,别急着争输赢。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào fēn qí de shí hòu, shuāng fāng yào hù xiāng tǐ liàng, bié jí zhe zhēng shū yíng。
examples.en: When disagreements arise, both sides should be considerate, not rush to win.

examples.zh: 这两个国家的人民一直互相往来,关系很密切。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè guó jiā de rén mín yì zhí hù xiāng wǎng lái, guān xì hěn mì qiè。
examples.en: The peoples of these two countries have long interacted closely.

examples.zh: 我们约好了以后要经常互相联系,别断了消息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yuē hǎo le yǐ hòu yào jīng cháng hù xiāng lián xì, bié duàn le xiāo xī。
examples.en: We agreed to keep in touch often and not lose contact.

examples.zh: 兄弟姐妹之间就该互相谦让,不能太计较。
examples.pinyin: Xiōng dì jiě mèi zhī jiān jiù gāi hù xiāng qiān ràng, bù néng tài jì jiào。
examples.en: Siblings should yield to one another and not be too calculating.

examples.zh: 他们在工作中互相帮助,渐渐成了很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā men zài gōng zuò zhōng hù xiāng bāng zhù, jiàn jiàn chéng le hěn hǎo de péng yǒu。
examples.en: They helped each other at work and gradually became good friends.

examples.zh: 两个班的同学互相交流学习经验,收获都很大。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng gè bān de tóng xué hù xiāng jiāo liú xué xí jīng yàn, shōu huò dōu hěn dà。
examples.en: Students from both classes exchanged study experiences and gained a lot.

examples.zh: 生活中难免有摩擦,重要的是能互相原谅。
examples.pinyin: Shēng huó zhōng nán miǎn yǒu mó cā, zhòng yào de shì néng hù xiāng yuán liàng。
examples.en: Friction in life is inevitable; what matters is forgiving each other.

examples.zh: 他们虽然分隔两地,却一直互相牵挂着对方。
examples.pinyin: Tā men suī rán fēn gé liǎng de, què yì zhí hù xiāng qiān guà zhe duì fāng。
examples.en: Though far apart, they've always cared for one another.

examples.zh: 好朋友之间不需要客气,可以互相开开玩笑。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo péng yǒu zhī jiān bù xū yào kè qì, kě yǐ hù xiāng kāi kāi wán xiào。
examples.en: Good friends need no formality and can joke with each other.

examples.zh: 这次活动让新老员工有机会互相认识、互相熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng ràng xīn lǎo yuán gōng yǒu jī huì hù xiāng rèn shí、 hù xiāng shú xī。
examples.en: This event let new and old staff get to know one another.

examples.zh: 面对灾难,人们互相鼓励、互相支持,共渡难关。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì zāi nàn, rén men hù xiāng gǔ lì、 hù xiāng zhī chí, gòng dù nán guān。
examples.en: Facing disaster, people encourage and support each other through hardship.

examples.zh: 我们应该互相尊重彼此的想法,而不是强求一致。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi hù xiāng zūn zhòng bǐ cǐ de xiǎng fǎ, ér bú shì qiǎng qiú yí zhì。
examples.en: We should respect each other's ideas rather than force agreement.

examples.zh: 两支球队赛后互相握手,展现了良好的风度。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng zhī qiú duì sài hòu hù xiāng wò shǒu, zhǎn xiàn le liáng hǎo de fēng dù。
examples.en: The two teams shook hands after the match, showing good sportsmanship.

examples.zh: 多年的老同事,大家早已习惯了互相照顾。
examples.pinyin: Duō nián de lǎo tóng shì, dà jiā zǎo yǐ xí guàn le hù xiāng zhào gù。
examples.en: Longtime colleagues have long been used to caring for each other.

examples.zh: 恋人之间除了相爱,更要学会互相包容。
examples.pinyin: Liàn rén zhī jiān chú le xiāng ài, gèng yào xué huì hù xiāng bāo róng。
examples.en: Beyond love, couples must learn to tolerate each other.

examples.zh: 这几个小国经常互相合作,共同发展经济。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè xiǎo guó jīng cháng hù xiāng hé zuò, gòng tóng fā zhǎn jīng jì。
examples.en: These small countries often cooperate to develop their economies.

examples.zh: 我们一家人有事就商量,从来都是互相支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yī jiā rén yǒu shì jiù shāng liáng, cóng lái dōu shì hù xiāng zhī chí。
examples.en: Our family discusses everything and has always supported one another.

examples.zh: 在困难时期,正是大家的互相帮助让人倍感温暖。
examples.pinyin: Zài kùn nán shí qī, zhèng shì dà jiā de hù xiāng bāng zhù ràng rén bèi gǎn wēn nuǎn。
examples.en: In hard times, it's mutual help that makes people feel warmth.
